## D444 — UNLEASH AND RIOT: `Unleash` (CR 702.98 — a +1/+1 counter as it enters or none, and it can't block while it has one) and `Riot` (CR 702.132 — a +1/+1 counter or haste as it enters) — one option on D136's entry prompt, the haste remembered on the object (2026-09-15)

**10,621 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,601
(+20: 14 the seam completed on its own — the keyword-only Rakdos Cackler, Carnival Hellsteed, Thrill-Kill Assassin,
Splatter Thug, Gore-House Chainwalker, Spawn of Rix Maadi, Dead Reveler, Rakdos Drake, Bloodfray Giant; Rampaging
Rendhorn, Zhur-Taa Goblin, Arcbound Slasher, Ghor-Clan Wrecker, Wrecking Beast — and 6 rows: Grim Roustabout, Hellhole
Flailer, Chaos Imps, Clamor Shaman, Frenzied Arynx, Burning-Tree Vandal, whose other line the row maker reads).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 6,852 → **6,858** (6 in; every suite green on the first port). The REFUSED ledger stays at **1,818**
(the select pool 0). Fixtures 7,629 → **7,640**. `scriptableToday` **1,903**; the ladder `[1903, 1909, 3292, 4913,
6229]`. Bot reach 4,382 → **4,384** from 318. An engine seam on Opus 5 by the user's choice — two keywords, one
prompt option, one instance field, one block rule; no new prompt kind, no new client mode.

### The measurement chose it — the entry choices, together

After D443 the keyword table read fabricate 16 / 10, unleash 14 / 9, riot 13 / 5: three entry choices the client had
no dialog for (D441's reportable). Unleash and riot are the SAME question — a +1/+1 counter, or the other thing — and
D136's `entersChoice` already asks a question of a permanent as it enters, with a queue, a handler, a bot answer, a
driver flip and two buttons on the bar. Fabricate is a TRIGGER (`When this creature enters, put N counters on it or
create N Servos`) whose choice is made on resolution — a branch prompt the engine does not have — and stays.

### The seam — an option on the entry prompt

- **`keywords.ts` / `oracle.ts`**: `unleash`, `riot` join CANON and `TIER2_KEYWORDS` — the derive carries them, the
  accounting takes the keyword line (`isKeywordLine`), and the fourteen keyword-only cards are the engine's with no
  script. **`state.ts`**: `entersChoice.option?: 'unleash' | 'riot'` (and on the queue entries); `CardInstance.riotHaste?`
  — the haste chosen, kept while the object stays on the battlefield (`clearBattlefieldFields` drops it: a new
  object chooses again). **`events.ts`**: `HasteChosen { card }`.
- **`triggers.ts`** (`withEntersTapped`, the entry funnel): a creature entering with either printed keyword pushes an
  asking entry with `life: 0` and the option — read off the printed face the way `entersTapped` is, because the object
  is not on the battlefield yet and there is nothing to derive; a seat out of the game is not asked.
- **`handlers.ts`** (`answerEntersChoice`): with an option, `pay` is the +1/+1 counter (`CountersChanged`, both
  keywords); declined, unleash takes nothing and riot takes haste (`HasteChosen`). Neither branch taps — the tap is the
  life price's decline only. **`derive.ts`**: `riotHaste` adds `haste` at layer 1 beside the printed keywords.
- **`combat.ts`** (`canBlock`): an unleash creature with a +1/+1 counter on it is refused as a blocker (`unleashed`,
  CR 702.98b) — the counter is what it chose, and the rule reads the counter, not a memory of the choice.
- **The bot**: the counter (a bigger body now; the block it gives up is unleash's price); riot takes haste on its own
  first main phase, when the creature can attack this turn, else the counter. **The driver**: a coin flip. **The
  harness**: declines (nothing / haste). **The client**: the two buttons read `A +1/+1 counter` and `No counter` /
  `Haste`, and the describe line says which keyword is asking.
- `src/engine/unleashRiot.test.ts` (+3): the keywords read and four keyword-only cards accounted; unleash's counter
  refused as a blocker (`canBlock` says `unleashed`, the declaration rejected) while the declined one blocks; riot's
  haste attacks the turn it entered, the counter's half is summoning sick, the bounced object loses the flag and is
  asked again; the replay hash.
- **Fuzz**: Rakdos Cackler ×3 (one hybrid mana) and Clamor Shaman ×3 ({2}{R}) a seat feeding `unleashAsked` and
  `riotAsked` (the floors) and `riotHastes` (reported): 16 / 5 / 3 at 60 seeds, 38 / 11 / 5 at 150, 111 / 22 / 13 over the gate's 500 — after
  Gore-House Chainwalker read 4 then 0 and Arcbound Slasher (misread as colourless; it is {4}{R}) none.

### The wave — 6 rows, 14 by the seam

The wide run (16,202 permanents whose leftover is lines alone) rowed 7; Devoted Crop-Mate's reanimation payload the
generator still refuses. Engine regression 142 files / 15,073 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 20 newly
complete (6 rowed, 14 by the seam), 0 regressed.

### Traps

- **AN ENTRY CHOICE IS NOT A PRICE**: the same prompt, but `pay` means the counter and the decline never taps. A
  branch that taps on decline (the life price's) reached by an option would tap every unleash creature that took no
  counter — the handler branches on the option before it looks at the price.
- **THE BLOCK RULE READS THE COUNTER, NOT THE CHOICE**: unleash's restriction is `as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on
  it` — a counter put later counts, a counter removed frees it. A flag remembering the answer would be wrong both ways.
- **A NEW OBJECT CHOOSES AGAIN**: `riotHaste` is cleared with the other battlefield fields when the card leaves; a
  bounced Zhur-Taa Goblin is asked again on the way back.
- **READ THE MANA COST BEFORE NAMING A STAPLE**: Arcbound Slasher was chosen as "the colourless riot Cat" and is
  {4}{R}; the 60-seed leg read 0 and the probe said why. The two-drop the driver can cast is the staple.

## D445 — BACKUP: `Backup N` (CR 702.165) — when the creature enters, N +1/+1 counters on target creature, and another creature gains the keywords printed below the line until end of turn; the reading is gated on those lines being keywords the engine can grant (2026-09-15)

**10,631 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,621
(+10, all by the seam: Gloomfang Mauler, Saiba Cryptomancer, Redcap Heelslasher, Fearless Skald, Cragsmasher Yeti,
Serpent-Blade Assailant, Consuming Aetherborn, Sigiled Sentinel, Boon-Bringer Valkyrie, Golden-Scale Aeronaut — the
keyword-only backup creatures).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` stays at **6,858** (the wide run rowed nothing: every other backup
card carries a line below the keyword the grant cannot carry, or a payload the vocabulary refuses). The REFUSED ledger
**1,818**. Fixtures 7,640 → **7,645**. `scriptableToday` **1,903**. Bot reach 4,384 → **4,388** from 318. A
keyword-trigger-table entry on Opus 5 by the user's choice — D440's modular one keyword over, with a parser gate.

### The measurement chose it — the biggest sole count that is not a free cast

After D444 the table read suspend 33 / 13, fabricate 16 / 10, backup 24 / 10. Suspend needs a cast without paying the
mana cost (305 cards print one; the engine has no free cast — the continuation seam's, with cascade), fabricate a
resolution-time branch prompt; backup is an ETB trigger the keyword table already knows how to run (modular's
targeted counters, D440) plus D194's until-end-of-turn keyword rider. Its one subtlety is WHICH abilities the target
gains: the ones printed below the Backup line (CR 702.165a) — on the ten sole cards, keywords; on Chomping Kavu a
static, on Voldaren Thrillseeker an activated ability, which no grant can carry.

### The seam — a gated reading and a table entry

- **`oracleParse.ts`** `parseBackup(oracleText)`: the `Backup N` line, then every line below it split on `, ` and
  canonicalised — each must be a Tier-2 keyword with no number or price; anything else (a trigger, an activated
  ability, a static, a keyword outside the table, `Swampcycling {2}`) refuses the whole reading. A `Flash` printed
  ABOVE the line is not granted (Saiba Cryptomancer grants hexproof alone). `OracleFace.backup: { n, grants } | null`;
  `parseKeywords` grants the keyword only when the reading stands (D439's echo gate, one keyword over), so a refused
  card keeps `Backup N` as a leftover line and its Tier-3 note.
- **`keywordTriggers.ts`** `backup`: an ETB trigger (`enteredThisEvent`) targeting a creature (`parseTargetClauses`
  over the reminder's own clause); at resolution N counters on the target, and when the target is ANOTHER creature a
  `PtModifiedUntilEndOfTurn` with no P/T and the read keywords — D194's rider, ended by cleanup with the rest.
- **The accounting**: `NUMBERED_TRIGGER_KEYWORDS` += `backup` (the line is the keyword's when `face.keywords` carries
  it); `tier3` keeps the note when the reading refused.
- `src/engine/backup.test.ts` (+2): the four readings (three grants, the Flash above, the static below refusing);
  Boon-Bringer Valkyrie's counter and three keywords on the Bears until cleanup, the second Valkyrie aiming at itself
  taking the counter and no grant, the replay hash.
- **Fuzz**: Sigiled Sentinel ×3 a seat feeding `backupsFired` (the floor) and `keywordGrants` (every keyword-only
  until-end-of-turn grant, any source — reported): 5 / 10 at 60 seeds, 20 at 150, 55 over the gate's 500 — under THE DRIVER RESHAPED (below).

### The wave — none

The wide run (16,186 permanents whose leftover is lines alone) rowed one card the generator refuses (Devoted
Crop-Mate's reanimation). Engine regression 143 files / 15,087 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 10 newly
complete (0 rowed, 10 by the seam), 0 regressed.

### The driver reshaped — D393's threaten canary, and the economy under every marginal floor

The first gate read `controlTaken` at 0 over 500 seeds (Act of Treason ×1: 3, 1, 2 at the three gates before, 0 at
every 60-seed leg since D443). Three copies read 0 too; so did aiming at random. A probe put in the driver said why:
the card was IN HAND and UNAFFORDABLE at every look, on one to four lands mid-game — the pool of ~300 dealt ONE basic
of each colour (eight percent land; a real deck is a third), and the driver's uniform pick over twenty usable actions
skipped most land drops. The mechanism (D180's third-rot rule), in three parts, all in the driver:
- **the land drop is taken first** — a `PlayLand` is played whenever one is offered (which land stays random);
- **ten basics of each colour a seat** in `FIXED_CORE` (a fifth of the pool) — three moved nothing;
- **targets are aimed at random** — a random legal candidate per required pick (`legalTargetsFor` over
  `candidatesFromState`); the harness's `simplestAnswer` takes the first, which is usually the caster's own oldest
  permanent, so a threaten aimed by it changed nothing. The harness keeps its deterministic minimum for the rules tests.
Every rate moved (D180's warning, again): `controlTaken` 0 → 9 at 60 seeds and 13 at 150; `exileMarks` (Lava Coil,
Anger of the Gods ×1) read 0 at 150 under the three-basic shape and 28 under the ten-basic one; Act of Treason ×3, Grim
Affliction ×2, Pack's Favor / Hooting Mandrills ×2 for the floors that read five or fewer. Over 150 seeds no floor
reads zero; the lowest are `damagePrevented` 2, `reducedCasts` 2, `fights` 3, `modeChoices` 4. The 60-seed leg runs
FASTER (74 s of tests a shard from 90): more lands, fewer rejected casts.

### The second gate — a token nobody had pinned

Run 2 was red on the fuzz's named-token canary: 795 named against 796 created. A probe named it — Trudge Garden's
Fungus Beast, made by the `If you do` branch of its pay prompt, a printing the fixtures never held: the port's token-pin
step pins every `tokenRef` a wave's modules name, and a token inside a pay prompt's branch is neither. The card landed
some two hundred decisions ago; the fuzz reached its `{2}` only under the new economy. A sweep of every module found
one more (a Plant). Both pinned (fixtures 7,647 = 7,479 + 168), and `src/data/tokenPins.node.test.ts` now reads every
module the way the fuzz would — every `tokenRef` key and every token the vocabulary resolves out of a payload, the
pay branches and the delayed lists included — and refuses a printing the fixtures lack.

### Traps

- **A ONE-COPY STAPLE THAT NEEDS THREE MANA OF A COLOUR WAS NEVER FUEL**: the pool's land share, not the copy count,
  was the ceiling; multiplying copies (D180's first two rots) could not reach a card the seat could not pay for. Read
  the driver's economy (lands on the battlefield at the probe) before multiplying.
- **A PROBE IN THE DRIVER, NOT A THEORY**: three theories (rejected targets, an unread spell, an unshuffled deck) were
  wrong; one `console.log` behind an env flag at the submit site, removed after the read, was right in twenty seeds.
- **THE GRANT IS THE LINES BELOW, NOT THE CARD'S KEYWORDS**: Scryfall's `keywords[]` is unordered; `Flash` above
  the Backup line is not granted, and only the printed order says so. The reader walks the text, not the array.
- **A GRANT THE ENGINE CANNOT CARRY REFUSES THE KEYWORD, NOT JUST THE GRANT**: half a backup (the counters without
  the abilities) is the half-execution D90 forbids; the gate is in `parseKeywords`, where echo's price gate is.
- **A "REPORTED" COUNTER MUST SAY WHAT IT COUNTS**: `backupGrants` read 10 against 5 backups fired - it was counting
  every keyword-only until-end-of-turn grant in the log. Renamed `keywordGrants` and labelled "all sources".

## D446 — THE TURN-CONDITIONED STATICS: `During your turn, this creature has first strike.` — the turn as a condition in the closed reader, the row maker's prefix beside `As long as`, a flavor word read past; no engine change (2026-09-16)

**10,658 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,631
(+27 rows: Blood Burglar, Jousting Lance, Javelin of Lightning, Knife, Fresh-Faced Recruit, Ahn-Crop Invader, Leech
Fanatic, Prickleboar, Pouncing Lynx, Sporeback Wolf, Wildwood Geist, Hookblade, Hookblade Veteran, Duelist of Deep
Faith, Daggersail Aeronaut, Hardy Veteran, Quick-Draw Katana, Street Riot, Spiteful Prankster, Spartan Veteran,
Spider-Girl, Legacy Hero, Bearer of Glory, Faithful Pikemaster, Null Group Biological Assets, Hexgold Halberd, Feisty
Spikeling — and Devoted Crop-Mate, whose reanimation payload the vocabulary reads after all).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS`
6,858 → **6,885** (27 in; every suite green on the first port). The REFUSED ledger **1,818** (the select pool 0).
Fixtures 7,647 → **7,674**. `scriptableToday` **1,903**; the ladder `[1903, 1909, 3272, 4893, 6209]`. Bot reach
4,388 → **4,400** from 319. A generator wave on Opus 5 — the row maker and the condition library, no engine change.

### The measurement chose it — the static tail's largest one-piece shape

The wide run's refusal histogram after D445 put `a line that is neither an activated ability nor a library trigger`
first (4,163 one-piece permanents), and inside it `During your turn, ...` at 64 — the largest shape that is a
condition on a body the static vocabulary already reads (`this creature has first strike` 12, `gets +N/+N` 4,
`has flying` 3, `has indestructible` 3, `has lifelink` 2, the equipped forms). Beside it: `~ costs {M} less to cast
[if ...]` 64 (conditions on a reduction), the `As this permanent enters, choose a creature type` family 44 (a chosen
type the consumers read — a client dialog and a memory), `You may choose not to untap` 35 (an untap-step option).

### The seam — one condition kind, one prefix, a flavor word

- **`gen146-cond.cjs`**: `parseCond` reads `during your turn` / `it's your turn` as `{ kind: 'yourTurn' }`; the helper
  the module emits is `ctx.state.turn.activePlayer === me` — off the turn record, nothing derived (D317). The stage is
  the inverse of every other condition's: it HOLDS on the armed board (turn 3 is p1's), so the suite breaks it first
  by walking to p2's turn 4 main phase (p2 holding priority under the holds), reads the static absent, then walks to
  p1's turn 5 and reads it present. No fixture, no mana.
- **`make-rows146.cjs`**: `During your turn, <body>.` is the `As long as <cond>, <body>.` shape with the turn as its
  condition — the body goes through the same reader (`~ has first strike`, `gets +N/+N`, the keyword lists, the
  equipped-creature statics), so the body vocabulary stays in one place. A FLAVOR WORD before the sentence (`Jump —
  During your turn, ~ has flying.`, `Leap Strike —`, `Bear Form —`; CR 207.2c, Universes Beyond's words with no rules
  meaning) is read past for this shape alone; the def's text stays the whole printed line, so the accounting is
  unchanged. Five such cards read their turn line and stay blocked on their other lines.
- **Fuzz**: no staple — a conditional static is layer-6 work the `layer6Sources` canary already counts, and every
  shipped script is dealt by the rotation.

### The wave — 27 rows

The wide run (16,186 permanents whose leftover is lines alone, the dump carried from D445) rowed 27; first port 27
green. Engine regression 143 files / 15,141 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 27 newly complete (27 rowed, 0 by the
seam), 0 regressed.

### Traps

- **A CONDITION THE ARMED BOARD MEETS IS PROVEN BY BREAKING IT FIRST**: the generator's `baselineMet` stage (D398)
  exists for exactly this - a `yourTurn` condition holds on turn 3; a suite that only staged "meet" would read the
  static present twice and prove nothing about the condition.
- **A FLAVOR WORD IS NOT AN ABILITY WORD, AND THE LIST CANNOT HOLD IT**: `TRUE_ABILITY_WORD` names the rules' ability
  words; Universes Beyond prints arbitrary flavor words before a dash. Read past `<Capitalized words> — ` for the one
  shape that needs it, never in general - `Choose one —` and `Threshold —` mean something.

## D447 — THE -1/-1 ENTRY COUNTERS AND THE ANY-KIND REMOVE-A-COUNTER COST: `This creature enters with two -1/-1 counters on it. {1}{W}, Remove a counter from this creature: Draw a card.` — the entry counter's kind read off the line; a cost that names no kind is a price after all (CR 704.5q keeps one kind on a permanent) (2026-09-16)

**10,669 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,658
(+11 rows: Gnarlbark Elm, Burdened Stoneback, Wickerbough Elder, Grim Poppet, Brambleback Brute, Deity of Scars,
Reaping Willow, Hovel Hurler, Bloodied Ghost, Etched Monstrosity, Moonlit Lamenter).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS`
6,885 → **6,896** (11 in; every suite green on the first port). The REFUSED ledger **1,818** (the select pool 0).
Fixtures 7,674 → **7,684**. `scriptableToday` **1,903**; the ladder `[1903, 1909, 3272, 4882, 6198]`. Bot reach
4,400 → **4,404** from 319. A small engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — the static tail's negative half, and the price beside it

The wide run's refusal histogram after D446 kept the static tail: `~ enters with N -1/-1 counters on it` was
read by the row maker as nothing at all - D371's entry-counter reader spelled `+1/+1` into its pattern - and 33
one-piece permanents carried the line (the Shadowmoor and Eventide hatchlings and elders). Reading the kind
rowed FIVE: the rest sat behind a second line, and nine of those behind ONE cost piece - `Remove a counter from
this creature` (no kind named), which D319 left in `unpaidCosts` on the ground that "the engine cannot enumerate
what it cannot represent". It can: `CounterKind` is +1/+1 and -1/-1 (D130) and the two annihilate in pairs as a
state-based action (CR 704.5q, `sba.ts` step 8), so a permanent carries ONE kind whenever a player has priority,
and the price is deterministic after all.

### The seam — `kind: null`, self only

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `Remove (a|two|...) counters? from this creature` with no kind between the count and
  the noun reads as `removeCounterCost: { kind: null, count, from: null }`; 26 activated lines became payable
  (`activated:nonManaCost` 2,835 → 2,809). The CHOOSER form (`from a creature you control`) still needs a kind
  to pick by and stays unpaid without one.
- **`legal.ts`**: `countersOfKind(counters, kind)` — the kind's count, or every kind's sum when the cost names
  none; the offer's "a cost you cannot pay is not offered" reads it, and the chooser's offer fields are built
  only with a named kind.
- **`handlers.ts`**: the activation check reads the same sum; the charge drains the kinds the permanent carries
  in a fixed (sorted) order until the count is met - an order that only matters in a state no player ever acts
  in. The narration drops the kind (`removes 1 counter from Moonlit Lamenter`).
- **`removeAnyCounter.test.ts`** (+5): the three parses; Moonlit Lamenter's generated script pays with the -1/-1
  counter it entered with, is refused with nothing left, then pays with a +1/+1 counter put by hand - the kind
  carried, whichever it is; the replay hash.
- **The generator**: `make-rows147.cjs` reads the entry counter's kind (`+1/+1` or `-1/-1`) and refuses by name
  a creature the -1/-1 counters would kill on entry (toughness not above the count); the any-kind cost takes the
  row's own entry kind (else the +1/+1 the suite seeds). `gen-oneshot147.cjs` asserts the kind's count and the
  signed P/T, and - `entryCovers` - does NOT seed a row whose unconditional entry counters already cover the
  price: a second -1/-1 helping would kill the creature the entry counters shrank.
- **Fuzz**: no staple — the eleven are dealt by the rotation; the self cost is D319's mechanism one kind over.

### The wave — 11 rows

The wide run (16,159 permanents whose leftover is lines alone, the dump remade on the post-D446 tree) rowed 11;
first port 11 green (32 tests). Engine regression 144 files / 15,168 green; bot / net / ui 301 green;
leftover diff 11 newly complete (11 rowed, 0 by the seam), 0 regressed.

### Traps

- **A COST THAT NAMES NO KIND IS STILL DETERMINISTIC WHEN THE KINDS CANNOT COEXIST**: D319's refusal reasoned
  from representation; the rules reason from the state-based action. Read what the engine can hold AND what the
  rules let coexist before calling a price a decision.
- **THE ENTRY COUNTERS ARE THE BASELINE, NOT A SEED**: a suite that loads `count` more -1/-1 counters onto a
  creature that entered with them kills it before the activation. `entryCovers` reads the row's own
  unconditional entry counters (kind and count) and seeds nothing when they pay.

## D448 — UNEARTH: `Unearth {1}{R}` — the keyword synthesized as an activated ability from the graveyard (CR 702.84a), resolved natively: the return, the haste, the exile at the next end step by a delayed trigger, the exile instead of leaving by the replacement funnel (2026-09-16)

**10,698 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,669
(+29: six by the seam alone — Fire-Field Ogre, Kathari Screecher, Etherium Abomination, Dregscape Zombie, Viscera
Dragger, Reconstructed Thopter — and 23 rows: Shambling Remains, Simian Simulacrum, First-Sphere Gargantua, Priest of
Fell Rites, Platoon Dispenser, Combat Courier, Hellspark Elemental, Vithian Stinger, Archfiend of Sorrows, Hell's
Thunder, Scrapwork Mutt, Rotting Rats, Scourge Devil, Ashnod's Harvester, Sedraxis Specter, Undead Leotau, Grixis
Slavedriver, Scrapwork Cohort, Scrapwork Rager, Molten Gatekeeper, Mishra's Juggernaut, Yotian Frontliner, Tocasia's
Onulet).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 6,896 → **6,919** (23 in; every suite green on the first port). The REFUSED ledger
1,818 → **1,821** (the mirror offered three the row maker refuses; the select pool 0). Fixtures 7,684 → **7,711**.
`scriptableToday` **1,906**; the ladder `[1906, 1912, 3278, 4888, 6207]`. Bot reach 4,404 → **4,410** from 319.
An engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — a keyword stripped, the rest rowed

D447's residue was a long tail: no one-piece static shape above 42, the conditional cost reductions spread over 45
wordings. So the measurement changed shape: `measure-kw.cjs` strips ONE keyword line from every leftover permanent
that prints it and rows the rest — what a keyword seam would land. Unearth came first at **29** (6 complete on the
seam, 23 rows), ahead of madness 20, suspend 19 and cascade 14 (both the free cast — Fable's), dash 16, fabricate
12, `You control enchanted creature` 12, ninjutsu 11, myriad 11, fading 10, vanishing 9, enlist 9, devour 7.

### The seam — the scavenge shape one keyword over

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `Unearth {cost}` synthesizes an ability (D440's scavenge shape): the printed mana as the
  cost, `activatesFromGraveyard: true`, `sorceryOnly: true`, no targets, the rule's own words as the effect,
  `unearth: { line }` for the accounting. 155 abilities across the database (`activated.lines` 43,644 → 43,799).
- **`legal.ts`**: the graveyard offer needs no def for a synthesized unearth (the scavenge gate, extended).
- **`loop.ts`**: `resolveAbility` runs it natively — if the card is still in the graveyard: `CardsMoved` to the
  battlefield under the activator's control, the new `Unearthed` event (the `unearthed` flag on the instance, cleared
  with the battlefield fields), and a `DelayedTriggerArmed` for the next end step (D402) whose one effect is the new
  `exileSelf` kind (`effectParse.unearthExileSpec()`; `effects.ts` exiles the source if it is still on the
  battlefield, else nothing).
- **`derive.ts`**: an unearthed object has haste (CR 702.84a), beside riot's.
- **`triggers.ts`**: `withUnearthedLeavingToExile` in the replacement funnel after D413's exile-instead-of-dying — a
  move from the battlefield to anywhere but exile of an unearthed object goes to its owner's exile (CR 702.84c).
- **`engineComplete.ts` / `tier3.ts`**: the Unearth line is the engine's own.
- **`unearth.test.ts`** (+6): the two parses; Dregscape Zombie (no script) returns with haste, attacks the turn it
  came back, is exiled at the end step and leaves the delayed list; a manual bounce sends it to exile instead of hand;
  sorcery speed refused in combat and refused again once on the battlefield; the replay hash.
- **Fuzz**: Dregscape Zombie ×3 a seat (`CANARY_STAPLES`); `unearths` (the `Unearthed` events, floored at gate size —
  5 at 60 seeds, 8 at 150) and `unearthExiles` (the riders' narrations, reported).

### The wave — 23 rows

The wide run remade on the post-seam tree (16,142 permanents whose leftover is lines alone) rowed 23; first port 23
green (50 tests). Engine regression 145 files / 15,220 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 29 newly
complete (23 rowed, 6 by the seam), 0 regressed. The mirror offered three the row maker refuses, ledgered by reason
(Chronomancer's ability-word activation, Corpse Connoisseur's search-to-graveyard payload, Kathari Bomber's
combat-damage head that also sacrifices).

### Traps

- **A KEYWORD'S YIELD IS THE REST OF THE CARD**: stripping the keyword line and rowing what remains
  (`measure-kw.cjs`) is the measurement; a keyword's card count is not. Unearth 55 cards, 29 landed; station 31
  cards, 0.
- **THE DELAYED TRIGGER IS ARMED WITH THE SOURCE, AND THE FIRE TOLERATES ITS ABSENCE**: `exileSelf` exiles the
  source only from the battlefield - the leave replacement may have exiled it first, and the end step then finds
  nothing, which is the rule (CR 702.84c), not a gap.

## D449 — EVOKE AND DASH: `Evoke {2}{U}` / `Dash {1}{R}` — the keyword alternative costs (CR 702.74, 702.109) as the face's alternative cost with a keyword, the mark riding the entry move, the evoke sacrifice from the keyword table, the dash return by a delayed trigger, the haste by the derive (2026-09-16)

**10,732 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,698
(+34: five by the seam — Mardu Scout, Alesha's Vanguard, Screamreach Brawler, Death-Greeter's Champion, Kolaghan
Skirmisher — and 29 rows: Vesperlark, Mulldrifter, Briarhorn, Mardu Shadowspear, Shriekmaw, Vaultbreaker,

The REFUSED ledger 1,821 → **1,825** (the mirror offered four the row maker refuses; the select pool 0). Fixtures
7,711 → **7,742** (169 tokens: a black Warrior pinned). `scriptableToday` **1,910**; the ladder
`[1910, 1916, 3283, 4894, 6216]`. Bot reach 4,410 → **4,419** from 319. An engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — two keywords on one seam

D448's keyword measurement (`measure-kw.cjs`, extended over the alternative-cost keywords) put evoke at 19 and dash
at 16 - and the two are ONE mechanism: an alternative cost printed as a keyword, elected at cast, with a rider the
engine runs off a mark. D408 built the alternative cost (the offer, the charge, the client's preview, the
fuzz driver's election); D403 built the mark that rides a resolving spell onto its permanent (`kicked`). The seam
is those two joined.

### The seam

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `parseAlternativeCost` reads `Evoke {cost}` / `Dash {cost}` on their own line as the
  face's `AlternativeCost` with `keyword: 'evoke' | 'dash'` (a printed `rather than pay` line found first wins;
  one alternative per face). `engineComplete` already claims `alternativeCost.line`; `parseKeywords` withholds the
  keyword when the line did not read (D439's gate); `tier3` says nothing when it did.
- **The mark**: `CardMove.altKeyword` from the resolving spell's `alternativePaid` and the face's keyword
  (`loop.ts`, beside `kicked`); the reducer sets `CardInstance.evoked` / `dashed` after the entry reset.
- **Evoke** (CR 702.74a): a keyword-table trigger — `enteredThisEvent` and `evoked` — sacrifices the permanent
  (`reason: 'sacrifice'` on the move). 'evoke' and 'dash' join the Keyword union so the table's walk sees them.
- **Dash** (CR 702.109a): the derive gives a dashed object haste (beside riot's and unearth's); the resolution arms
  a delayed trigger for the next end step (D402) whose one effect is `effectParse.dashReturnSpec()` — a self
  `bounce`, a subject gone by then gone (D373).
- **`evokeDash.test.ts`** (+6): the parses; Mulldrifter evoked is marked on entry and sacrificed, cast for its mana
  cost it stays, a short evoke payment is refused; Zurgo Bellstriker dashed has haste, attacks the turn it came,
  returns to hand at the end step and leaves the delayed list; cast normally it has no haste and stays; a dashed
  one binned before the end step stays in the graveyard; the replay hash. No scripts registered — the printed
  ETB and static are not what is under proof.
- **Fuzz**: Mulldrifter ×2 and Zurgo Bellstriker ×3 a seat; `evokedCasts` and `dashedCasts` floored at gate size
  (9 and 44 at 150 seeds), `evokeSacrifices` and `dashReturns` reported.

### The wave — 29 rows

The wide run remade on the post-seam tree (16,114 permanents whose leftover is lines alone) rowed 29; first port 29
green (61 tests). Engine regression 146 files / 15,284 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 34 newly
complete (29 rowed, 5 by the seam), 0 regressed. The mirror offered four the row maker refuses, ledgered by reason
(Glarewielder's and Reveillark's up-to-two clauses, Kolaghan's typed attack head, Riders of Rohan's token outside
`TOKEN_TABLE`).

### Traps

- **A KEYWORD PRINTED AS A COST IS THE COST GRAMMAR'S, NOT THE KEYWORD TABLE'S**: evoke and dash are elected at
  cast; what the keyword table sees is the MARK the cast left (`evoked`), never the keyword alone — a Mulldrifter
  cast for {4}{U} carries the keyword and owes no sacrifice.
- **THE ENTRY MOVE CARRIES THE ELECTION**: `alternativePaid` is the stack object's; the permanent learns it only
  through `CardMove.altKeyword` after the entry reset, exactly as `kicked` (D403) — a mark set any earlier is
  wiped by `clearBattlefieldFields`.

## D450 — VANISHING AND FADING: `Vanishing 3` / `Fading 3` — the counted-down keywords: time and fade counters from the entry built-in, the upkeep ticks and the sacrifices from the keyword table, which may now carry two triggers for one keyword (2026-09-16)

**10,749 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,732
(+17: six by the seam — Blastoderm, Calciderm, Skyshroud Behemoth, Skyshroud Ridgeback, Waning Wurm, Cloudskate —
and 11 rows: Four Knocks, Keldon Marauders, Aven Riftwatcher, Deep Forest Hermit, Woodripper, Deadwood Treefolk,
Jolting Merfolk, Rejuvenation Chamber, Phyrexian Prowler, Rusting Golem, Defender en-Vec).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS`
6,948 → **6,959** (11 in; two rowed cards were pulled before the port for a reason the row maker now names). The
REFUSED ledger 1,825 → **1,829** (the mirror offered four; the select pool 0). Fixtures 7,742 → **7,755**.
`scriptableToday` **1,914**; the ladder `[1914, 1920, 3287, 4901, 6225]`. Bot reach 4,419 → **4,431** from 319. An
engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — one mechanism under two keywords

The keyword measurement (D448's `measure-kw.cjs`) put vanishing at 9 and fading at 10 and the two are one thing: N
counters of a kind as the permanent enters, one removed at each of its controller's upkeeps, a sacrifice when they
run out — the modular built-in (D440) for the entry, the echo / cumulative-upkeep table entries (D439) for the
step, the counters map's open kinds (`time`, `fade`) for the rest.

### The seam

- **`triggers.ts` `withEntryCounters`**: `vanishing N` / `fading N` put N time / fade counters on the entering
  permanent, beside modular's (the number off the printed line; a bare `Vanishing` puts none - its own line says).
- **`keywordTriggers.ts`**: the map is keyed by a STRING and an entry may name the `keyword` that gates it, so a
  keyword may carry two triggers under two keys. `vanishing` (CR 702.63b): at its controller's upkeep, if it has a
  time counter, remove one. `vanishingLast` (702.63c, gated by `vanishing`): when a `CountersChanged` takes its
  last time counter — by the tick or by any other hand — sacrifice it. `fading` (702.32a): at its controller's
  upkeep remove a fade counter; with none to remove, sacrifice it. The walk in `triggers.ts` reads the gating
  keyword; the ref lookups take the key as printed.
- **`engineComplete.ts`**: vanishing and fading join `NUMBERED_TRIGGER_KEYWORDS` (D338's list) — a numbered line
  the engine runs from its table is accounted when `parseKeywords` granted the keyword. Without this the seam
  landed nothing: the first wide run rowed zero and the leftover did not move, which is the accounting doing its
  job (D90).
- **`vanishingFading.test.ts`** (+5): Calciderm (vanishing 4) enters with four, loses one at each own upkeep and
  none at the opponent's, is sacrificed as the last goes; a hand removal at the last is the sacrifice too;
  Blastoderm (fading 3) loses three and is sacrificed the upkeep it has none; the replay hash. No scripts.
- **The generator**: a vanishing / fading count the suite's own walk exhausts (put on turn 1; the upkeeps at
  turns 3 and 5 tick it) is refused by name — Soultether Golem and Lavacore Elemental (vanishing 1) die at the
  turn-3 upkeep before their heads fire — as is a time / fade counter payload whose baseline the ticks move; a
  first-main-phase draw head crosses the turn-5 draw step (`hand0 + 1 + 1`, Four Knocks).
- **Fuzz**: Calciderm ×2 and Blastoderm ×2 a seat; `vanishingTicks` and `fadingFires` floored at gate size (15 and
  6 at 150 seeds), `vanishingSacrifices` reported.

### The wave — 11 rows

The wide run remade on the post-seam tree (16,079 permanents whose leftover is lines alone) rowed 13; two were
pulled before the port (the refusal above) and 11 landed green (26 tests). Engine regression 147 files / 15,311
green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 17 newly complete (11 rowed, 6 by the seam), 0 regressed. The mirror
offered four, ledgered by reason (Crack in Time's two-head line, Dreamtide Whale's possessive filter, the two
vanishing-1 cards).

### Traps

- **A TABLE ENTRY IS NOT AN ACCOUNTING**: the keyword table ran vanishing and fading before `engineComplete` knew
  it - the first wide run rowed zero and the leftover did not move. A numbered keyword the table runs must join
  `NUMBERED_TRIGGER_KEYWORDS`; the leftover probe after a seam is the check, and it said so.
- **THE SUITE'S WALK IS AN UPKEEP OR TWO**: a card put on turn 1 and fired on turn 3 (or 5) has been through its
  controller's upkeep once (or twice); a counted-down keyword with fewer counters than that is dead before the
  fire. Refuse by count, by name.

## D451 — BLOODRUSH AND REINFORCE: `Bloodrush — {1}{R}, Discard this card: Target attacking creature gets +3/+1 until end of turn.` / `Reinforce 2—{1}{G}` — the hand activations with a discard-self cost, and the ATTACKING FIXTURE the generator lacked (2026-09-16)

**10,778 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,749
(+29: five by the seam — Bannerhide Krushok, Rustic Clachan, Mosquito Guard, Burrenton Bombardier, Brighthearth
Banneret — and 24 rows: Skarrg Goliath, Arbalest Elite, Scorchwalker, Ghor-Clan Rampager, Steel Wrecking Ball,
Rubblebelt Maaka, Wasteland Viper, Slaughterhorn, Lieutenant Kirtar, Dive Bomber, Zhur-Taa Swine, Dawnray Archer,
Gravel Slinger, Wrecking Ogre, Divebomber Griffin, Skinbrand Goblin, Scab-Clan Charger, Duergar Assailant, Harpoon
Sniper, Ultimo, Civilization's End, D'Avenant Healer, Soldier Replica, Expendable Troops, Viashino Shanktail).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 6,959 → **6,983** (24 in; thirteen rowed cards were pulled before the port by two refusals the row
maker now names). The REFUSED ledger 1,829 → **1,805**: the 24 rows had been REFUSED by earlier mirrors as
`hand-activated ability` and `a combat-role clause` — their class is built, and the stale-entry guard retired them
(the select pool 0). Fixtures 7,755 → **7,779**. `scriptableToday` 1,914 → **1,890**; the ladder
`[1890, 1896, 3263, 4877, 6201]`. Bot reach 4,431 → **4,448** from 321. An engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — two keywords whose line IS the row

The keyword measurement put bloodrush at 12 and reinforce at 6 as "on the seam" — and that reading was wrong in a
way worth recording: a bloodrush line is a printed ACTIVATED ability, so the seam makes it payable and a ROW makes it
run; only reinforce (synthesized, native) lands by the seam alone. Both need one price the engine did not take -
`Discard this card` - and one fixture the generator did not have - a creature that is ATTACKING when the fire runs.
The second turned out to be the larger half: 37 rows read once the fixture existed, and the refusal that trimmed
them to 24 names why (below).

### The seam

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `Discard this card` (or the card's own name on an older printing) in a cost is
  `discardsSelf: true` — a deterministic price, the ability activated from the HAND (CR 113.6); `Bloodrush` joins
  the ability-word list (its rule is printed whole); `Reinforce N—{cost}` is synthesized in the scavenge shape
  (`{cost}, Discard this card: Put N +1/+1 counters on target creature.`, `reinforce: { line, n }`). 90 activated
  lines became payable (`nonManaCost` 2,809 → 2,719); 15 reinforces synthesized.
- **`legal.ts`**: the hand loop offers a `discardsSelf` ability beside cycling's — past a registered def (D159), or
  natively for reinforce — with the sorcery, once-each-turn and activation-condition gates the battlefield loop has.
- **`handlers.ts`**: the zone check (the hand), the def gate for a printed one, the `from` stamp, and the discard
  charged in the cost batch as an ordinary hand→graveyard move with the discard reason — discard watchers see it,
  and the source sits in the graveyard before anything can respond.
- **`loop.ts`**: reinforce resolves natively — N counters on the target if the clause still admits it (CR 608.2b).
- **`engineComplete.ts` / `tier3.ts`**: the Reinforce line is the engine's own.
- **`bloodrushReinforce.test.ts`** (+6): Bannerhide Krushok reinforces from the hand (the discard, the counters);
  refused from the battlefield and with the mana short; Scorchwalker (an inline def, what a row registers) pumps
  the attacking Bears from the hand during combat and is discarded, is refused outside combat with nothing
  attacking; the replay hash.
- **Fuzz**: Bannerhide Krushok ×2 a seat; `handActivations` (an ability on the stack whose source was discarded
  from the hand a few events before) floored at gate size (4 at 60 seeds, 9 at 150).

### The generator — the attacking fixture

- **`gen151-vocab.cjs` `fixtureFor`**: a clause on an attacking creature (`combatRole` attacking, or attacking-or-
  blocking) is aimed at p1's own Grizzly Bears, put at the arm; `preFire` walks to turn 3's declare-attackers
  prompt, declares it, settles — the fire then runs in the declare-attackers step, and the mana comes after
  (a pool does not survive the walk into combat, CR 500.4). Under a TRIGGER head the fixture is refused: the
  head's own arm declares its attackers, and a co-attacker beside them is not this wave (12 rows — `Whenever
  this creature attacks, another target attacking creature ...` — read, ported, failed, and refused by name).
- **`make-rows151.cjs`**: `Discard this card` as a cost piece (`discardsSelf`), refused beside any other piece or a
  payload that reads the card on the battlefield (the graveyard activation's rules, one zone over); Bloodrush as a
  true ability word; a counted payload beside a counted STATIC refused — the static's witness is put at the arm for
  every row and moves the count (Rubblehulk's Forest under its bloodrush X).
- **`gen-oneshot151.cjs`**: a `discardsSelf` row starts in the HAND (`handWhich`, beside the graveyard rows') and is
  not moved onto the battlefield by the non-etb arm; after the fire the card is in the graveyard.

### The wave — 24 rows

The wide run remade on the post-seam tree (16,063 permanents) rowed 37; 13 were pulled after the first port by the
two refusals above and 24 landed green (51 tests). Engine regression 148 files / 15,365 green; bot / net / ui 301
green; leftover diff 29 newly complete (24 rowed, 5 by the seam), 0 regressed.

### Traps

- **A FIXTURE'S COMBAT IS THE FIRE'S COMBAT**: an attacking fixture declared in `preFire` serves an activation that
  fires in that same combat; a trigger head that walks to its own declaration finds the fixture no longer attacking
  (a `youAttack` head on turn 5, an `attacks` head declaring only itself) - `illegalTarget`, or a walk past the
  game's end. The refusal is by head, not by name.
- **A ROW'S FIRST PORT MAY BE PULLED, AND THE PULL IS BY HAND**: `land.cjs` registers every generated module; a
  row refused after the port owes the registry's import and entry, the WANTED line, the two files and the fixture
  title (`repair-451.cjs`). The stale-entry guard then says which ledger rows the wave retired.

## D452 — THE CO-ATTACKER AND CHANNEL: `Whenever this creature attacks, another target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn.` / `Channel — {1}{G}, Discard this card: ...` — the attacking fixture declared beside the head's own attacker; an ability word whose rule is printed whole (2026-09-16)

**10,799 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,778
(+21 rows: Pegasus Courser, Ghost-Lit Stalker, Mnemonic Sphere, Appa, Aang's Companion, Clammy Prowler, Shinen of
Fury's Fire, Malamet Brawler, Shinen of Stars' Light, Shinen of Flight's Wings, Ironhoof Boar, Shinen of Fear's
Chill, Gryffwing Cavalry, Aerial Guide, Phase Dolphin, Reinforced Ronin, Bamboo Grove Archer, Phyrexian Pegasus,
Ghost-Lit Redeemer, Bazaar Krovod, Colossal Skyturtle, Ghost-Lit Nourisher).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 6,983 → **7,004**
(21 in; one rowed card was pulled before the port by a refusal the row maker now names). The REFUSED ledger 1,805 →
**1,785**: twenty of the rows had been refused by earlier mirrors as combat-role clauses and hand-activated
abilities — the stale-entry guard retired them (the select pool 0). Fixtures 7,779 → **7,799**. `scriptableToday`
1,890 → **1,870**; the ladder `[1870, 1876, 3243, 4857, 6181]`. Bot reach 4,448 → **4,458** from 322. A generator
wave on Opus 5, with one word added to the engine's parser.

### The measurement chose it — D451's own residue

D451 read 37 rows for the attacking fixture and refused twelve by head: an attack head whose arm declares self
alone, with a clause on ANOTHER attacking creature - the fixture must attack in the same declaration. Beside it,
Channel: 38 lines, 15 one-piece, the rule printed whole after the word (`Channel — {cost}, Discard this card:
<effect>`, CR 207.2c) - D451's discard-self price with the word stripped. The two are one wave.

### The seam — one word

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `Channel` joins `ABILITY_WORD_RE` (its rule is printed whole, like Bloodrush); the
  discard-self price is D451's. 97 activated lines became payable (`nonManaCost` 2,719 → 2,622).

### The generator — the co-attacker

- **`gen152-vocab.cjs`**: a combat-role clause is admitted under the heads whose arm is the plain self declaration
  (`CO_ATTACK_HEADS`: attacks, combatDamagePlayer, dealsDamagePlayer, dealsDamageOpponent, attacksNotBlocked,
  combatDamageOpponent); `preFire` declares the fixture only for an activation; an attacking fixture is never
  tapped ahead of an untap payload (attacking taps it - a hand-tap would keep it home, Bazaar Krovod).
- **`gen-oneshot152.cjs` `fireLinesAnswering`**: for a vocab trigger row with an attacking fixture, the head's
  `attackers: [{ card: self, ... }]` becomes self AND the fixture - a head whose arm lacks the plain declaration
  is a generator error, never a silent miss. The discard-self price subtracts one from every hand assert
  (`retHandAdj`, the vocab's `handAdj`): a Channel draw is `hand0 + 1 - 1`.
- **`make-rows152.cjs`**: Channel in the true ability words; two payment prompts on one row refused (Ghost-Lit
  Warder - both abilities' pay lands sit on the payer's board and the payment taps whichever it finds first).

### The wave — 21 rows

The wide run on the post-D451 tree (16,039 permanents) rowed 22; one was pulled after the first port by the
two-payments refusal and 21 landed green (55 tests). Engine regression 148 files / 15,407 green; bot / net / ui 301
green; leftover diff 21 newly complete (all rowed), 0 regressed. No fuzz change: the co-attacker is the suite's
scaffold, and a Channel row is a hand activation `handActivations` (D451) already counts.

### Traps

- **THE FIXTURE JOINS THE HEAD'S DECLARATION, NEVER ITS OWN**: an attacking fixture under a trigger head is declared
  in the head's `DeclareAttackers` beside self; a separate declaration in `preFire` fires the head early or walks
  past the game (D451's twelve). The head list is closed and the replacement throws when the arm's declaration is
  not the plain one.
- **A PRICE TAKEN FROM THE HAND MOVES EVERY HAND ASSERT**: a discard-self cost is a card gone before the payload is
  read - `Draw a card.` from the hand is `hand0 + 1 - 1`, a graveyard return is `hand0 + 1 - 1`.

**Verified: `verify.cjs --full` (sharded) — ALL FIVE GATES: 7210 files, 34419

## D453 — THE CONTROL AURAS: `You control enchanted creature.` — a layer-2 control effect through a static, taken and given back by a state-based built-in (2026-09-16)

**10,810 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,799
(+11: six by the seam — Control Magic, Confiscate, Threads of Disloyalty, Mind Control, Persuasion, Lay Claim — and
5 rows: Yavimaya's Embrace, Binding Grasp, Corrupted Conscience, Vapor Snare, Spirit Away).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS`
7,004 → **7,009** (5 in; one rowed card was pulled before the port by a refusal the row maker now names). The
REFUSED ledger 1,785 → **1,787** (the mirror offered two; the select pool 0). Fixtures 7,799 → **7,806**.
`scriptableToday` **1,872**; the ladder `[1872, 1878, 3246, 4861, 6185]`. Bot reach **4,458** from 322 (unchanged).
An engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — the permanent control family's Aura half

The residue has carried "the permanent control family (20)" since D-early; the wide dump names 24 Auras printing
`You control enchanted creature` / `permanent`, six of them with no other line. Threaten (D393) built the
event and the summoning sickness; what an Aura needs is the same control change held for as long as the Aura
holds the permanent — a layer-2 continuous effect, which this engine keeps as STATE (the controller field) and so
must take and give back at the moments the Aura's attachment changes.

### The seam — one flag, one memory, one built-in

- **`oracleParse.ts` / `OracleFace.controlsEnchanted`**: one exact line on an Aura face; `engineComplete` claims
  the line off the flag.
- **`CardInstance.controlledVia`**: on the ENCHANTED permanent — the Aura, its entry stamp (a returned Aura is a
  new object, CR 400.7) and the controller to go back to. Cleared with the battlefield fields, hashed with the
  state.
- **`sba.ts`**: a pass beside the attachment rules — a permanent whose memory's Aura no longer holds it (gone,
  detached, falling off this very pass, a new entry) goes back (`ControlReverted`: the controller, the sickness
  of CR 302.6, the memory gone); one whose Aura changed hands follows its Aura; a permanent enchanted by a
  flagged Aura of another controller is taken (`ControlTakenByAura`: the controller, the sickness, the memory).
  Every road an Aura takes onto or off a permanent ends in that sweep, which is why it lives there and not at
  the cast, the attach or the leave.
- **`controlAuras.test.ts`** (+5): the flag on Mind Control and Control Magic and not on Pacifism; Mind Control
  resolves attached and p1 controls the Cyclops, summoning sick this turn and attacking next turn; the Aura
  leaving gives it back with the memory gone; an Aura on the caster's own creature takes nothing; the replay
  hash. No scripts.
- **Fuzz**: Control Magic ×2 a seat; `controlAuras` and `controlAuraReverts` REPORTED, not floored — the driver
  aims at random (D445), half its Auras land on its own creatures, and {2}{U}{U} is cast rarely: 1 take at 60
  seeds, 2 at 150. A floor would rot the day it was set.
- **The generator**: an Aura whose cast carries an additional chooser cost (D406 — `sacrifice a creature`) is
  refused by name: the cast arm names no pick (Grafted Identity).

### The wave — 5 rows

The wide run remade on the post-seam tree (16,012 permanents) rowed 6; one was pulled after the first port by the
additional-cost refusal and 5 landed green (13 tests). Engine regression 149 files / 15,422 green; bot / net / ui
301 green; leftover diff 11 newly complete (5 rowed, 6 by the seam), 0 regressed. The mirror offered two, ledgered
by reason (Grafted Identity's additional cost, Mark of the Oni's intervening if the armed board meets).

### Traps

- **A LAYER-2 EFFECT IN A STATE ENGINE IS TAKEN AND GIVEN BACK, AND THE SWEEP IS WHERE**: the controller is a
  field, not a derivation; the moments it must move are the moments an Aura's attachment changes, and every one
  of them ends in the state-based sweep. Put the rule there once rather than at the cast, the attach and each
  leave.
- **THE MEMORY CARRIES THE WAY BACK**: `revertTo` is whoever controlled the permanent when the Aura took it —
  not the owner. A stolen creature stolen again goes back one step, and a returned Aura is a new object that
  holds nothing (the entry stamp).

## D454 — THE ATTACHED QUOTED GRANTS: `Enchanted / Equipped creature has "..."` in the one-shot row maker — the granted activated and mana bodies through the D367 / D372 carriers (2026-09-16)

**10,821 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,810
(+11, all rows: Utopia Vow, Burning Anger, Fire Whip, Singing Bell Strike, Ocular Halo, Karametra's Favor, Dragon
Mantle, Evanescent Intellect, Screaming Shield, Malicious Intent, Ringing Strike Mastery).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS`
7,009 → **7,020**. The REFUSED ledger 1,787 → **1,782** (five rowed cards were ledgered as quoted grants in earlier
mirrors; the stale-entry guard named them and they are gone; the mirror offered nothing new). Fixtures 7,806 →
**7,817**. `scriptableToday` **1,867** (five of the rows counted there); the ladder `[1867, 1873, 3240, 4855, 6179]`.
Bot reach **4,461** from 322. A generator wave on Opus 5; no engine change.

### The measurement chose it — a fragment the leftover carried as a whole line

`engineComplete` reports a quoted grant as the FRAGMENT before the quote (`Enchanted creature has`, line −1) — the
quoted body is blanked before the lines are compared, so 144 cards sat in the leftover under a line the row maker
could never find among the printed ones. The carriers exist since D367 (`grantedActivated`, the `#g<n>` ref, the
`granted` def read by `legal.ts` off the recipient) and D372 (`grantedMana`, `pushGrantedMana`); what was missing was
the row maker's re-join and one row shape.

### The row maker — a re-join and one static shape

- **The re-join** (`make-rows154.cjs`): a leftover line at −1 that ends in `has` / `have` is looked up among the
  card's printed lines (reminder text stripped) by prefix, and the printed line takes its place.
- **`attachedStatic.grantQuoted`**: `(Enchanted|Equipped) creature (gets +N/+M and )?has "..."` — a mana body
  (`{T}: Add {X}` / one mana of any color / two of any one color) is `{ mana: true }`; any other body is split at
  `: `, its cost read by `parseCost` (mana and the tap only), its effect by the vocabulary (no ask, no random, no
  combat role) — `{ mana: false, cost, effect, v }`. A second row, `kind: 'vocab', granted: true` with the host
  (`who`), the host's own pump (`hostPt`), the cost's mana and tap, is pushed beside the static after the vocabulary's
  own refusal pass, so the granted body is proven by the same machinery as a printed vocab activation.
- **The module** (`gen-oneshot154.cjs`): `GRANT_<line> = grantedMana(printed quoted, name)` or
  `grantedActivated(printed quoted, \`${oracleId}#g<line>\`, name)` — the PRINTED body ("This creature"), where the
  row's `~` is the vocabulary's spelling; the attached static's `modify` pushes the production or
  `{ provider: self, ref, ability }`; the granted def carries `ref: GRANT.ref` and `granted: GRANT.ability` and
  resolves through the vocabulary (`VOCAB_G<line>`).
- **The suite**: the granted row's fire attaches first (the Aura cast onto the Bears, the Equipment equipped), finds
  the offer ON THE HOST (`legalActions` → `ActivateAbility` with a `grantRef`, `card === bearsB`) and submits it;
  the host is the subject of every self-aimed assert (`pt(g, bearsB)`, its tap, its untap) and the hand / board
  baselines count the Aura's own cast. The mana grant is proven by `derive(...).producesMana` naming the quoted
  text, a `TapForMana` on the host and the pool one mana richer (`poolTotal`).

### The wave — 11 rows

The wide run remade on the D453 tree (16,007 permanents) rowed 11 — activated bodies 9 (Burning Anger's bite,
Fire Whip's ping, Ocular Halo's draw, the two untaps, the two mills, Dragon Mantle's pump, Malicious Intent's
can't-block) and 2 mana grants (Utopia Vow, Karametra's Favor) — and all 11 landed green on the second port (40
tests; the first port's two misses were the generator's: the Aura's cast out of the hand and the `grantRef`
narrowing). Engine regression 149 files / 15,444 green; bot / net / ui green; leftover diff 11 newly complete, 0
regressed.

What the 144 leave behind, by shape: `Commander creatures you own have "..."` (25 — a scope outside the static
vocabulary), `Enchanted land has "{T}: ..."` (16 + 5 — an Aura on a LAND host; the suite has only the Bears),
two quoted bodies on one line (`has "A" and "B"`, 7), a keyword beside the quote (`has flying and "..."`, 12 — all
of them triggers, statics or an unattach cost), the quoted TRIGGER grants (~20 — D368's carrier, the bodies mostly
outside the vocabulary), `Unattach ~` / sacrifice / discard costs (12), the Sliver `have "..."` scope (20).

### Traps

- **THE LEFTOVER'S FRAGMENT IS A WHOLE LINE'S ADDRESS**: `engineComplete` blanks a quoted body before it compares
  lines, so a grant shows up as `Enchanted creature has` at line −1. The row maker re-joins it by prefix among the
  printed lines; a row that read the fragment as its line would claim a line the module never prints.
- **THE GRANTED ROW'S `~` IS THE HOST**: the recipient is the ability's source (CR 113.7a) — the Bears taps, pays,
  is pumped and untapped; the Aura is cast out of the hand in the same fire (the hand one fewer, the board one
  more). The module's readers want the PRINTED body ("This creature"); the vocabulary's `~` is its own spelling.

## D455 — THE LAND-HOST QUOTED GRANTS: `Enchanted land has "..."` — the Enchant land Auras proven on a Forest, and the harvester that asks for the quoted bodies (2026-09-16)

**10,830 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,821
(+9, all rows: Gift of Paradise, New Horizons, Abundant Growth, Unbridled Growth, Urban Utopia, Weirding Wood, Sunken
Field, Hostile Realm, Mystic Might).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,020 → **7,029**. The REFUSED ledger 1,782 → **1,779**
(three rowed cards were ledgered under earlier readings; the stale-entry guard named them and they are gone; the mirror
offered nothing new). Fixtures 7,817 → **7,826**. `scriptableToday` **1,864**; the ladder `[1864, 1870, 3237, 4852,
6176]`. Bot reach **4,467** from 322. A generator wave on Opus 5; no engine change.

### The measurement chose it — D454's residue, one host over

Of the 144 quoted-grant cards, 21 print `Enchanted land has "..."` — the same shape D454 read, on a host the suite
had no fixture for. The Enchant land Auras are cast onto a land, so the host is a Forest: put where the Bears is put,
dealt where the Bears is dealt, and read by the same asserts (there is no P/T to read on a land; the mana proof finds
the grant by its text, which the Forest's own `{T}: Add {G}. (Forest)` never matches).

### The row maker, the harvester, the generator

- **`make-rows155.cjs`**: `Enchanted land has "..."` reads through the D454 branch with `hostLand` on the static and on
  the granted row; the Aura marking accepts `Enchant land` only when every attached row is a land-host row (and
  `Enchant creature` only when none is), and stamps `hostLand` on every row of the card so the enters arms cast it
  onto the Forest too.
- **A quoted body that names the provider is refused** (`Trusty Boomerang`, `Hankyu`): inside the quote the card's own
  name is the granting permanent, while the vocabulary's `~` is the ability's SOURCE — the host (CR 113.7a). The two
  would be read as one, so the row is refused before the name is rewritten.
- **The harvesters** (`collect-payloads.cjs`, `collect-payloads-wide.cjs`): a leftover line at −1 ending in `has` /
  `have` is re-joined to its printed line off the database and the body right of the quoted cost's colon is asked of
  the vocabulary — a token grant's sentence is unique to its card and reached `vocab-ok.json` no other way (211 bodies
  asked in the wide run; the three token grants — Leafdrake Roost's two-colour Drake, Spawning Grounds' 5/5 Beast,
  Caribou Range's 0/1 Caribou — are descriptions `TOKEN_TABLE` refuses, and stay refused).
- **`gen-oneshot155.cjs`**: `HOST` — the Bears, or a Forest when a row carries `hostLand` — at the host's put and in
  the deck list.

### The wave — 9 rows

The wide run remade on the D454 tree (15,996 permanents) rowed 9 — six mana grants with their enters lines (gain 3
life, a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, draw a card twice, investigate, and Unbridled Growth's
sacrifice-to-draw), Hostile Realm's can't-block, Mystic Might's pump and Sunken Field's `Counter target spell unless its
controller pays {1}` — and all 9 landed green on the first port (28 tests). Engine regression 149 files / 15,462 green; bot / net / ui 301
green; leftover diff 9 newly complete, 0 regressed.

What the 21 leave behind: the token grants (3 — `TOKEN_TABLE` refuses the descriptions), the activate-only riders
inside the quote (Skygames, Friendly Neighborhood), the counters with a rider (Equinox), the discard / sacrifice
costs (Chamber of Manipulation, Animal Boneyard), the prevention (Security Blockade), the triggers and statics
(Farmstead, Urban Burgeoning), the spend restriction (Discreet Retreat), Tarmogoyf Nest's CDA token.

### Traps

- **THE HOST IS A PARAMETER, NOT A NAME**: the suite's host variable stays `bearsB` (every attached assert reads it) and
  only the card put there changes; a land host has no P/T and is never summoning sick, so nothing else moves.
- **A QUOTED BODY THAT NAMES THE PROVIDER IS TWO OBJECTS**: the printed name inside the quote is the Equipment or Aura,
  the vocabulary's `~` is the host; refuse before the name is rewritten, or the row reads them as one.

passed / 11 skipped · 500-seed gate, 6 shards, 444.9 s wall · build clean · probe
124/124 · battery 141/141.**

## D456 — THE QUOTED TRIGGER GRANTS: `Enchanted / Equipped creature has "Whenever ..."` in the one-shot row maker — the body read as the host's own trigger line through the D368 carrier (2026-09-16)

**10,838 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,830
(+8, all rows: Farmstead, Infinity Formula, Nurturing Presence, Pillory of the Sleepless, Candlestick, Inevitable End,
Sixth Sense, Iconic Shield).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,029 → **7,037**. The REFUSED ledger 1,779 → **1,773** (six rowed
cards were ledgered under earlier readings; the stale-entry guard named them and they are gone; the mirror offered
nothing new). Fixtures 7,826 → **7,834**. `scriptableToday` **1,858**; the ladder `[1858, 1864, 3231, 4846, 6170]`.
Bot reach **4,472** from 322. A generator wave on Opus 5; no engine change.

### The measurement chose it — the third quoted-grant body

D454 read the activated and mana bodies, D455 the land host; 46 of the 144 quoted grants open with a trigger head.
The carrier has been shipped since D368 (Commander's Authority): a layer-`ability` static pushes
`chars.grantedTriggered.push({ provider: self, ref })`, the trigger def lives on the PROVIDER's script under an
abilityId that starts with `gt` — the registry's granted index reads the marker — and the bus fires it with the
RECIPIENT as its source, which is exactly the printed trigger's own semantics on the host. So the body needs no
new reader: it is the host's trigger line.

### The row maker, the harvester, the generator

- **`make-rows156.cjs`**: a quoted body that opens with `When` / `Whenever` / `At` returns the attached static with
  `grantQuoted: { trigger: true }`; the walk then SPLICES the body behind the static with the same printed index
  (D380's way for compound heads), `this creature` spelled `~`, marked `granted` with the host, and the trigger
  library reads it like any printed line — every head, payload, optional and intervening-if rule as before. An
  attack head on a granted row attacks with the host, so the provider needs no creature body.
- **The harvesters** ask the vocabulary for a quoted trigger body's payload (behind the head comma; the `you may`
  peeled; the referent form) — 348 quoted bodies in the wide run.
- **`gen-oneshot156.cjs`**: the def is emitted as any trigger with `abilityId: 'gt<line>'`; the static pushes
  `grantedTriggered` with `GRANT_<line> = grantedTriggerRef(\`${oracleId}#gt<line>\`)`; the granted TRIGGER row stays
  OUT of the arming predicate (the Aura is cast onto the Bears in the arm, so the baselines count nothing), an
  Equipment is equipped before the fire, and every `self` the fire and the asserts name is the host (`hostSubject`).

### The wave — 8 rows

The wide run remade on the D455 tree (15,987 permanents) rowed 8 — the upkeep heads (Farmstead's pay-{W}{W}-for-1-life
on a Forest host, Pillory of the Sleepless's lose 1 life beside its can't-attack-or-block, Inevitable End's sacrifice
a creature), the attack heads (Infinity Formula's gain 2 life, Candlestick's surveil 2, Iconic Shield's indestructible
on another attacking creature — the D452 co-attacker rides the host's declaration), Nurturing Presence's pump when a
creature you control enters, Sixth Sense's optional draw on combat damage — and all 8 landed green on the first port
(29 tests). Engine regression 149 files / 15,478 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 8 newly complete, 0 regressed.

What the 46 leave behind: the payloads outside the vocabulary (`that many` — Sunbond, Light of Promise; `sacrifice ~
unless` — Pendrell Flux, Instill Furor; the referent shapes; X-counted pumps and damage — Idolized, Unquenchable Fury;
Necrotic Plague's return), the Backgrounds (`Commander creatures you own have` — a scope the static vocabulary lacks,
25), the Slivers (`All Sliver creatures have`, 20), Animal Friend's and Spare Dagger's bodies naming the provider.

### Traps

- **A GRANTED TRIGGER IS THE HOST'S LINE, AND ONLY ITS ID SAYS SO**: the def is the provider's, read at the bus with the
  recipient as `self`; nothing in its `matches` or `resolve` knows it is granted. The `gt` marker on the abilityId is
  the whole seam — drop it and the def is indexed under the provider alone, where the host's walk never finds it.
- **THE ARM CASTS, THE FIRE FIRES**: a granted ACTIVATION casts the Aura in its fire (the offer is on the host only once
  attached), a granted TRIGGER has the Aura cast in the arm — the two rows differ in where the attach lives, and the
  hand / board baselines only move for the first.

## D457 — EXHAUST: `Exhaust — <cost>: <effect>` — a once-per-object activation the permanent remembers (CR 702.178) (2026-09-16)

**10,844 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,838
(+6, all rows: Greenbelt Guardian, Skystreak Engineer, Stampeding Scurryfoot, Camera Launcher, Prowcatcher Specialist,
Hazard of the Dunes).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,037 → **7,043**. The REFUSED ledger 1,773 → **1,767** (the six rowed cards
were ledgered as exhaust lines; the stale-entry guard named them and they are gone; the mirror offered nothing new).
Fixtures 7,834 → **7,840**. `scriptableToday` **1,852**; the ladder `[1852, 1858, 3225, 4840, 6164]`. Bot reach
**4,476** from 322. An engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — a keyword printed in an ability word's shape

The wide dump holds 35 cards with an `Exhaust — ` line. The word sits where an ability word sits, but its rule is not
printed (activate it only once), so D342's list kept it off the strip deliberately — and every one of those lines
was an unpayable cost the engine never offered. The rule is small and local: a memory on the object, charged
behind the word, cleared when the object is new.

### The seam — one flag, one memory, one stamp

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `EXHAUST_RE` reads the word off the cost text into `ActivatedAbility.exhaust: true` and
  charges the cost behind it (`Exhaust — {3}{R}` is `{3}{R}` with the rule); `costText` keeps the printed word. 101
  more payable activated abilities.
- **`CardInstance.exhausted?: readonly AbilityRef[]`**: the refs THIS object has activated. Cleared with the
  battlefield fields (`clearBattlefieldFields`), so a new object — bounced and returned, CR 400.7 — may exhaust
  again. Hashed with the state.
- **`StackObject.exhaust?: true`**: the handler sets it from the ability as the activation is put on the stack; the
  reducer's `AbilityPutOnStack` stamps the source's memory off it — the reducer holds no oracle, so the object
  carries the fact.
- **`legal.ts`** withholds a used one at all three offer sites (the battlefield, the graveyard, the granted); **`handlers.ts`**
  refuses it beside the once-each-turn refusal, before any cost is looked at (`timingRestriction`).
- **`invariants.ts`**: an exhaust memory names each ref once and lives only on the battlefield — checked on every
  accepted intent by the fuzz's walker.
- **`exhaust.test.ts`** (+5): the parse; Prowcatcher Specialist with an inline def — two counters once, the memory
  stamped, the offer gone and the second attempt refused on the same turn and on the next; a bounced-and-returned
  copy offered again; the replay hash.
- **Fuzz**: Prowcatcher Specialist ×2 a seat; `exhaustActivations` REPORTED, not floored — {3}{R} the driver pays by
  chance: 3 at 60 seeds, 14 at 500. The invariant walker is the real teeth.
- **The row maker / generator**: `Exhaust — ` is read as the engine reads it (the cost behind the word, `exhaust` on
  the row); the proof is the once-each-turn plumbing — the second activation refused for the limit before any cost
  is looked at.

### The wave — 6 rows

The wide run remade on the seam tree (15,979 permanents) rowed 6 — four self-counter lines, Stampeding Scurryfoot's
counter-and-Elephant and Camera Launcher's counter-and-Thopter through the vocabulary — and all 6 landed green on the
first port (14 tests). Engine regression 150 files / 15,495 green after the D342 pin moved (Exhaust is payable now, its rule on the flag); bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 6 newly complete, 0 regressed.

What the 35 leave behind: the `Whenever you activate an exhaust ability` head (Afterburner Expert, Rangers' Refueler —
a head to add, with a scripted exhaust fixture in the suite), the payloads outside the vocabulary (a double strike
counter, `It gains double strike`, a loot beside a counter, haste to others), the X costs (Mindspring Merfolk,
Boommobile), the Vehicles' `becomes an artifact creature` (Rocketeer Boostbuggy, Marshals' Pathcruiser), the
bending keywords, the energy, Elvish Refueler's and Boom Scholar's statics, the saga.

### Traps

- **THE REDUCER HOLDS NO ORACLE, SO THE STACK OBJECT CARRIES THE FACT**: the memory is stamped as the ability goes
  on the stack, and the only way the reducer knows the ability is exhaust is the flag the handler put on the object.
  A refusal that read the oracle in the reducer would be a second parse.
- **A KEYWORD IN AN ABILITY WORD'S SHAPE IS NOT STRIPPED, IT IS READ**: D342's list stays closed; Exhaust joins the
  parser as its own reader with its own flag, exactly so the cost is charged AND the rule kept. Boast and Channel
  keep waiting the same way (Channel's discard-self price is D451's; Boast needs the attacked-this-turn memory).

## D458 — BOAST: `Boast — <cost>: <effect>` — activated only if this creature attacked this turn, once each turn (CR 702.142) (2026-09-16)

**10,853 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,844
(+9, all rows: Fearless Pup, Usher of the Fallen, Fearless Liberator, Goldmaw Champion, Duskwielder, Draugr
Recruiter, Tuskeri Firewalker, Hagi Mob, Battershield Warrior).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,043 → **7,052**. The REFUSED
ledger 1,767 → **1,758** (the nine rowed cards were ledgered as boast lines; the stale-entry guard named them and
they are gone; the mirror offered nothing new). Fixtures 7,840 → **7,849** (a Dwarf Berserker token pinned).
`scriptableToday` **1,843**; the ladder `[1843, 1849, 3216, 4831, 6155]`. Bot reach **4,479** from 322. An engine
seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — Exhaust's sibling, one memory over

The wide dump holds 17 cards with a `Boast — ` line — the second keyword D342 kept off the ability-word strip because
its rule is unprinted. Exhaust (D457) needed a memory on the object; Boast needs one on the TURN: which creatures
attacked. The record already counted them for Raid (`TurnMemory.attackers`, D348); it now names them.

### The seam — one flag, one list, two refusals

- **`activatedParse.ts`**: `BOAST_RE` reads the word off the cost text into `ActivatedAbility.boast: true`, sets
  `oncePerTurn` with it (the printed rule's second half), and charges the cost behind the word. 43 more payable
  activated abilities.
- **`TurnMemory.attackerIds`**: the ids the active player declared this turn, appended in the `AttackersDeclared`
  reducer beside the count, emptied with the record each turn.
- **`legal.ts`** withholds a boast whose source is not on the list at all three offer sites; **`handlers.ts`**
  refuses it beside the once-each-turn and exhaust refusals, before any cost (`timingRestriction`). The stack
  object says `boast` for the log and the gate's counter.
- **`boast.test.ts`** (+5): the parse; Fearless Pup with an inline def — refused in the main phase, offered and
  pumped once it attacked (the pool paid again in combat: CR 500.4 emptied it on the way), the second attempt
  refused for the once-each-turn half, the Bears attacking alone earning the Pup nothing, a later turn without an
  attack refusing it again with the record empty, the replay hash. The D342 pin moved (Boast payable, its rules on
  the flags).
- **Fuzz**: Fearless Pup ×2 a seat; `boastActivations` REPORTED, not floored — the driver must attack with the Pup
  and then pay {2}{R} in combat, and its default stops auto-pass its own combat unless something is on the stack: 0 at 60, 150 and 500 seeds.
- **The row maker / generator**: `Boast — ` is read as the engine reads it (`boast` + `oncePerTurn` on the row) and
  the attacked-this-turn rule is a turn-record condition the suite stages by ATTACKING with the card (the recipe
  `selfAttacked`: the third turn's declaration, the activation then running in combat); the early attempt on the
  empty record is refused for the rule, the second activation for the once-each-turn half. Battershield Warrior's
  by-name refusal retired.

### The wave — 9 rows

The wide run remade on the seam tree (15,973 permanents) rowed 9 — Fearless Pup's self pump, two tokens, Goldmaw
Champion's tap, Hagi Mob's ping, Duskwielder's drain, Draugr Recruiter's graveyard return, Tuskeri Firewalker's
exile-and-play, Battershield Warrior's anthem until end of turn — and all 9 landed green on the first port (20
tests). Engine regression 151 files / 15,518 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 9 newly complete, 0 regressed.

What the 17 leave behind: the `Whenever you activate a boast ability` head (Frenzied Raider), Dragonkin Berserker's
cost reduction, the searches (Varragoth, Horizon Seeker), Arni Brokenbrow's base-power choice, Broadside Bombardiers'
sacrifice-priced damage, Axgard Braggart's untap-and-counter (a per-item counter), Eradicator Valkyrie's keyword line,
Baron Helmut Zemo's connive head.

### Traps

- **A TURN RECORD THAT COUNTS IS NOT ONE THAT NAMES**: Raid's `attackers` counted the declaration; Boast asks WHICH
  creature attacked, so the record carries the ids beside the count. One reducer site, one event, both facts.
- **THE POOL EMPTIES ON THE WAY INTO COMBAT**: a boast is paid where it is activated - after the declaration, in
  combat (CR 500.4). The suite's mana lines ride the fire, past the recipe that attacks, never the main phase.

## D459 — FABRICATE: `Fabricate N` — the entry choice (N +1/+1 counters or N Servos) as a MODAL keyword trigger (CR 702.122) (2026-09-16)

**10,865 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 10,853
(+12: ten by the seam — Peema Outrider, Propeller Pioneer, Ambitious Aetherborn, Glint-Sleeve Artisan, Weaponcraft
Enthusiast, Maulfist Squad, Iron League Steed, Accomplished Automaton, Highspire Artisan, Visionary Augmenter — and 2
rows: Elegant Edgecrafters, Angel of Invention).** `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,052 → **7,054**. The REFUSED ledger 1,758 →
**1,759** (the mirror offered one — Marionette Apprentice — ledgered by reason: a compound subject the filtered-head
reader does not split). Fixtures 7,849 → **7,854** (the Servo token pinned). `scriptableToday` **1,844**; the ladder
`[1844, 1850, 3217, 4832, 6156]`. Bot reach **4,488** from 322. An engine seam and a generator wave on Opus 5.

### The measurement chose it — the largest on-seam keyword in the residue read

`measure-kw` on the D458 tree: fabricate 16 cards, 10 with no other line. The keyword is a triggered ability whose
resolution is a CHOICE — counters or tokens — which the keyword table had never carried; every other numbered entry
resolves to one thing. The mode machinery already existed for scripted triggers (D343), so the seam is the table
learning to declare modes.

### The seam — a keyword with two modes

- **`keywords.ts` / the `Keyword` union / `NUMBERED_TRIGGER_KEYWORDS`**: `fabricate` joins; `parseKeywords` reads
  `Fabricate N` and `engineComplete` claims the line off the keyword (D450's way).
- **`KeywordTrigger.modes?(ctx, self)` / `modeChoice?`**: a modal keyword trigger declares its modes; the bus pushes
  them onto the pending trigger exactly as a def's ride, and D343's prompt asks as the trigger goes on the stack.
- **The `fabricate` entry**: on this permanent's entry, two modes — `Put N +1/+1 counters on it` / `Create N 1/1
  colorless Servo artifact creature tokens` — read off `keywordAmount` (a granted fabricate with no number is 1);
  the resolution reads `obj.modes[0]`. The Servo is `TOKEN_TABLE`'s, pinned in `WANTED_TOKENS` beside afterlife's
  Spirit.
- **`fabricate.test.ts`** (+6): the parse and the table; Weaponcraft Enthusiast — the prompt on entry, the counters
  mode, the Servo mode (two tokens, no counter, the printing named), fabricate 1 on Peema Outrider, a creature
  without the keyword asking nothing, the replay hash.
- **Fuzz**: Weaponcraft Enthusiast ×2 a seat; `fabricateFired` / `fabricateServos` REPORTED, not floored — 3 / 0 at
  60 seeds and 6 / 0 at 150 while the driver fell back to the harness's first-mode answer, so the driver now answers a
  modal prompt AT RANDOM among the legal modes (every modal trigger's second mode was never played): 3 / 4 at 60 after, 30 / 29 at 500.
- **The row maker**: a card printing `Fabricate N` enters with N counters in every generated suite (the harness
  answers the prompt with its first mode), so the base its self asserts read is the printed one plus N.

### The wave — 2 rows

The wide run remade on the seam tree (15,964 permanents) rowed 2 — Elegant Edgecrafters' block restriction and Angel
of Invention's anthem (its own P/T read at the fabricated base) — green on the second port (4 tests; the first read
the Angel at its printed base). Engine regression 152 files / 15,528 green; bot / net / ui 301 green; leftover diff 12 newly complete (10 by
the seam, 2 rowed), 0 regressed.

What the 16 leave behind: Marionette Master's power-sized life loss, Cultivator of Blades' X pump, Cayth's granted
fabricate beside a populate / proliferate mode line, Marionette Apprentice's compound subject (ledgered).

### Traps

- **A KEYWORD TRIGGER MAY ASK, AND THE TABLE SAYS SO**: the modes are declared on the entry and ride the pending
  trigger like a def's; nothing downstream knows the trigger came from the table. The resolution reads the chosen
  mode and nothing else.
- **THE HARNESS PICKS THE FIRST MODE, SO A GENERATED SUITE READS THE FABRICATED BASE**: a card with `Fabricate N`
  enters with N counters in every suite the generator writes; its base is the printed one plus N, or the self
  asserts read a creature that does not exist.
