## D499 — THE BLOCKS-BY PREDICATES: the other creature of the block, read and sized (2026-09-18)

**11,706 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,696
(+10: 10 rows behind a blocks-by predicate outside the colour table or a flavour-named mode — Abomination, Arrogant Bloodlord, Deathgazer, Dread Specter, Dwarven Soldier, Rock Basilisk, Thicket Basilisk, Infernal Medusa, Inspiring Bard, Plundering Barbarian; no spell moved - the probe diff is the 10 rows alone, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,693 → **7,703**. The REFUSED ledger 1,784 → **1,774** (-11 +1: the blocks-by and flavour-named entries retired by exact line, Cockatrice back with D498's reason). Fixtures 8,636 →
**8,648**. `scriptableToday` 1,870 → **1,860**; the ladder `[1860, 1870, 3177, 4704, 5911]`. Bot reach **4,811** from **370**.
The eighth Opus wave of the tail: the residue D497 and D498 named, closed.

### The measurement chose it — the ledger's own reasons

The D498 measurement (`rows498-all.log`) and the D497 / D498 ledgers named the same small family: `Whenever ~ blocks
or becomes blocked by a nonblack creature` (Dread Specter, Deathgazer), `by a non-Wall creature` (Thicket Basilisk,
Cockatrice, Rock Basilisk, Infernal Medusa), `by a creature with power 1 or less` (Arrogant Bloodlord), `by one or
more Orcs` (Dwarven Soldier), `by a green or white creature` (Abomination) - the row maker's own colour table read
five colours and nothing else, and D497's delayed clauses behind them needed the other creature of the block sized so
the combat leaves it to read. Beside them, two modal cards refused for a flavour name the mode reader could not spell
(`Song of Rest —`, `Smash the Chest —`). One decision, eleven cards offered.

### The wave (`d499/filterlib.cjs`, `gen199-headfix.cjs`, `make-rows199.cjs`, `gen-oneshot199.cjs`, `gen199-modal.cjs`)

- **THE FILTER READER LEARNS THE NEGATED COLOUR AND SUBTYPE.** `nonblack` → `notColors`, `non-Wall` → `notSubtypes`
  (`readSubject`; `permConjuncts` emits `!colors.includes` / `!subtypes.includes`; `admits` refuses a fixture that has
  them; `isBare` counts them). The filtered heads read them at once (Infernal Medusa's `becomes blocked by a non-Wall
  creature`).
- **A BLOCKS-BY PREDICATE OUTSIDE THE COLOUR TABLE IS THE FILTER READER'S.** The `blocksOrBecomesBlockedBy` head keeps
  its colour table and hands the rest to `readSubject` (`byFilter` on the row); the def's matcher is the filter's
  conjuncts on the other creature of the block (`blocksByMatches`), attacker or blocker.
- **THE OTHER CREATURE OF THE BLOCK IS SIZED FOR A DELAYED CLAUSE, FROM THE WHOLE POOL.** `blocksByGift`: a quiet creature
  the predicate admits that can attack and block (no defender, no flying), with a toughness the row's power cannot
  kill when the clause is about the item (`destroy that creature at end of combat` - Staunch Shieldmate 1/3 for a 2-power
  Basilisk, Grizzled Leotau 1/5 for Rock Basilisk's 4) or a power the row's toughness survives when the clause is about
  the row's card (Memnite 1/1 for Arrogant Bloodlord's `destroy this creature at end of combat`), the plainest first;
  the colour table's own creatures are sized the same way (Abomination's green-or-white Bears gave way to the
  Shieldmate), and a filtered block head's creature too (Infernal Medusa's Memnite gave way to the Stag). The chosen
  creature's base rides the row (`giftPt`) into the item fixture and `delayedBlockGift`.
- **A FLAVOUR NAME MAY CARRY A FUNCTION WORD.** `FLAVOUR_NAME` reads `Song of Rest —`, `Smash the Chest —`, `Turn People
  into Dinosaurs —` (Inspiring Bard, Plundering Barbarian).
- Eleven ledger entries retired by exact line (the seven D497 blocks-by rows, Infernal Medusa, Dwarven Soldier, the
  two modal cards); Cockatrice refused again by name (a flier under a becomes-blocked head, D498's rule).

### The wave — ten rows, no spells

Eleven ledger entries retired by exact line made the family offerable (the seven D497 blocks-by rows, Infernal Medusa, Dwarven Soldier, Inspiring Bard, Plundering Barbarian); the row maker rowed 10 (13 abilities: seven blocks-by heads with a sized creature - Staunch Shieldmate 1/3 for the 2-power Basilisks and the nonblack pair, Grizzled Leotau 1/5 for Rock Basilisk, Memnite 1/1 for Arrogant Bloodlord's own delayed destroy, Orcish Captain for Dwarven Soldier's Orcs; Infernal Medusa's two halves with the Stag and the Shieldmate; the two flavour-named modal cards) and refused Cockatrice by name (a flier under a becomes-blocked head, D498's rule), ledgered with it (ledger499.cjs). The first row-maker run refused Arrogant Bloodlord (the reader appended `creature` to a predicate that already carried it) and Infernal Medusa (the filtered block head's Memnite unsized) - both fixed before the port; the port was green first time and the regeneration identical by name (port499b: 10 suites, 25 tests). The fuzz: no new staple (the standing staples read 9 delayed clauses armed with the previous clause objects and 9 fires that moved one over 60 seeds (fuzz60-499, canary499.out), 10 once-per-turn triggers, 2 looks onto the battlefield and 15 public reveals, 1 free cast, 1 spell copy, 1 populate, 2 token copies; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 10 newly complete (the rows), nothing regressed).

### Traps

- **THE OTHER CREATURE OF THE BLOCK IS SIZED FROM THE WHOLE POOL.** The colour table's five creatures were the wrong
  size for half the delayed clauses; `blocksByGift` reads the fixture pool (any quiet creature the predicate admits) and
  picks by the size the clause needs, or refuses.
- **A NEGATED COLOUR IS NOT A NEGATED TYPE.** `nonblack` reads before the `non<type>` branch that refused it as a type
  outside the list; `non-Wall` is the hyphenated print, a subtype.
- **A FLAVOUR NAME MAY CARRY A FUNCTION WORD.** A capitalised-words-only name missed `Song of Rest`.

## D500 — THE OBJECT VERBS: the immediate verbs on the previous clause's objects (2026-09-18)

**11,734 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,706
(+28: 10 rows whose payload taps, regenerates or evades the object of the clause before it - Icehide Troll, Iron-Shield Elf, Kappa Cannoneer, Razzle-Dazzler, Unrooted Ancestor, Vanguard of the Rose, Duskworker, Immersturm Predator, Necromancer's Familiar, Prognostic Sphinx - and 18 spells the parser alone now reads whole (Decision Paralysis, Adverse Conditions, Necrobite, Gleam of Resistance, Frost Breath, Snow Day, War Flare, Tenacity, Boon of Erebos, Said // Done, Sudden Storm, Butcher's Glee, Will of the Naga, Leo's Guidance, Unnatural Endurance, Rallying Roar, Rally to Battle, Frostveil Ambush; the probe diff is the 10 rows and the 18 spells, nothing regressed)).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,703 → **7,713**. The REFUSED ledger 1,774 → **1,769** (-9 +4: Snow Day and Duskworker retired by exact line before the select, the seven spells the parser now reads whole (Boon of Erebos, Decision Paralysis, Frost Breath, Sudden Storm, Frostveil Ambush, Unnatural Endurance, Will of the Naga) after the probe; the four refused rows added with the row maker's reasons). Fixtures 8,648 →
**8,658**. `scriptableToday` 1,860 → **1,854**; the ladder `[1854, 1864, 3161, 4685, 5892]`. Bot reach **4,819** from **370**.
The ninth Opus wave of the tail, and the last bounded parser seam D494's family had left: the verbs.

### The measurement chose it — D494's family, one verb over

D494 read the clause about the previous clause's objects for a GRANT (`It gains haste`) and the DELAYED moves
(`Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step`); the immediate verbs on the same objects were still refused
whole - `Tap it.` (17 cards behind it), `Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.` (8),
`Untap those creatures.` / `Untap them.` (4 + 4), `Regenerate it.` (4), `It can't be blocked this turn.` (3), `Those
creatures can't block this turn.` - and a SCOPED clause before them (`Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of
turn. Untap those creatures.`) produced nothing D494 could bind. One decision, the family whole: the parser reads the
six verbs as the plain kinds they are, planned aimless (`ofPrevious`, D494's path) and spliced in per object as they
run; the executor reads a scoped clause's permanents off the events it emitted.

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`)

- **THE OBJECT VERBS ARE THE PLAIN KINDS.** `OBJ_VERB_LEAD` (`Untap / Tap / Regenerate it | them | those creatures`)
  and `OBJ_VERB_SUBJ` (`It | They | Those creatures can't be blocked this turn | can't block this turn | don't untap
  during their controller's next untap step | their controllers' next untap steps`) produce `untap` / `tap` /
  `regenerate` / `cantBeBlocked` / `cantBlock` / `freeze` with `ofPrevious: true` and no aim; D494's splice binds each
  to the previous clause's objects as it runs, one ordinary aimed step per object (the branches unchanged).
- **A SCOPED CLAUSE PRODUCES ITS PERMANENTS.** `objectsRewrite` accepts a clause before with `scopes` (and
  `OBJ_MAKERS` gains `massPump`, `freeze`, `regenerate`, `cantBeBlocked`, `cantBlock`); the executor's `objectsOf`
  reads `PtModifiedUntilEndOfTurn`, `KeywordsGained`, `RegenerationShieldAdded`, `PermanentsTapped` and
  `PermanentsUntapped` among the clause's events, so `Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Untap those
  creatures.` untaps exactly the creatures the pump reached.
- **THE VERBS READ THE STATE BEFORE THE RESOLUTION.** The plain branches check the permanent against the state the
  resolution began in (a token made this resolution, a card returned this resolution, is not in it - `cantBeBlocked`
  would break silently, D90); so after a token maker, a return (`OBJ_LATE`) or a chain (`ofPrevious` before) the verb
  sentence is refused and the card stays assisted (`Create two 1/1 tokens. They can't be blocked this turn.`).
- Four seam tests in `previousObjects.test.ts`: the readings and the refusals; a scoped pump then `Untap those
  creatures` (the Eel and the Bears untap, the opponent's Bears stays tapped); `Tap up to two target creatures. Those
  creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.` (both tapped, both skip one untap step, both untap
  the turn after); `It can't be blocked this turn` after a counter on self and `Regenerate it` after a self pump (the
  entry and the shield land on the source); the replay hash on each.

### The wave (`d500/gen200-vocab.cjs`, `make-rows200.cjs`)

- **THE SUITE BINDS THE VERB TO WHAT IT CAN ENUMERATE.** `bindObjects` (the row maker calls it on every vocabulary
  reading) rewrites an aimless verb to the targeted form when the clause before targeted a fixture (its index), or to
  the self form when the clause before was a self clause whose aim is the source (a pump, a counter, an untap, a
  shield, an animation, an evasion - `OBJ_SELF_BEFORE`); the bound form rides the row, so every assert, the pre-fire
  tap and the regenerate killer read it as a targeted or a self clause. A verb still aimless at the refusal (a scoped
  clause before) is refused by name: the permanents a scope reached are not enumerated this wave (Jeskai Ascendancy,
  Essence of Antiquity).
- **THE SELF FORMS ASSERT ON THE CARD.** `tap` / `untap` / `cantBlock` / `cantBeBlocked` had no self assert outside
  a granted host; the row's own card is read now (`Tap it.` on Icehide Troll's activation, `It can't be blocked this
  turn` on Kappa Cannoneer's counter).
- **THE ROW MAKER'S SELF REWRITE CATCHES UP WITH THE CLASSIFIER.** `Regenerate it.` / `Tap it.` under a self head are
  the source's (`selfSubject`, D497, read them; the row maker refused Duskworker as "not a pump").
- **A LATE-ENTERING ROW CANNOT ATTACK ON TURN 3.** A row with a draw or step head enters in the third turn's main phase
  (D313) - summoning sick, so an arm that fires by attacking that turn waits forever (Dream Trawler's game ran to its
  end and the declaration was refused as `gameOver`); refused by name, the way the scaffold's other collisions are.
- Nine ledger entries retired by exact line (Snow Day and Duskworker before the select; the seven spells the parser now
  reads whole - Boon of Erebos, Decision Paralysis, Frost Breath, Sudden Storm, Frostveil Ambush, Unnatural Endurance,
  Will of the Naga - after the probe named them stale); four rows refused with the row maker's reasons.

### The wave — ten rows and eighteen spells

Two ledger entries retired by exact line made the family offerable (Snow Day, Duskworker); the select offered 14 and the row maker rowed 10 (15 abilities: eight self taps behind a self pump - the snow Troll, the Elf, the Ancestor, the Vanguard, the Predator, the Familiar, the Sphinx, Kappa Cannoneer's counter-then-evasion on both its heads, Razzle-Dazzler's on the second-spell head, Duskworker's regenerate on the becomes-blocked head) and refused four (Jeskai Ascendancy and Essence of Antiquity - a scoped clause before the verb; Popular Egotist - a sacrifice head beside its own sacrifice cost; Dream Trawler - a late-entering row beside an attack head), ledgered with the row maker's reasons (ledger500.cjs). The first port failed Dream Trawler alone (the attack arm's walk ran the game to its end - the refusal above); the re-port was green (port500b: 10 suites, 25 tests) and the regeneration identical by name. The spells: the object verb was the one unread sentence on eighteen instants and sorceries - the freeze after `Tap up to two target creatures` (Decision Paralysis, Adverse Conditions, Frost Breath, Snow Day, Said // Done, Sudden Storm, Will of the Naga, Frostveil Ambush), the regenerate after a pump (Necrobite, Boon of Erebos, Butcher's Glee, Unnatural Endurance), the untap after a mass pump (Gleam of Resistance, War Flare, Tenacity, Rallying Roar, Rally to Battle) or after counters on up to three targets (Leo's Guidance) - each reading checked against its oracle text before the port (d500/spells500.txt). The fuzz: no new staple (the standing staples read 14 clauses bound to the previous clause's objects and 14 that acted, 18 untap skips, 13 once-per-turn triggers, 1 look onto the battlefield and 21 public reveals, 1 free cast, 2 spell copies, 3 populates, 3 token copies over 60 seeds (fuzz60-500, canary500.out); seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 28 newly complete (the 10 rows and the 18 spells), nothing regressed).

### Traps

- **THE OBJECT VERBS READ THE STATE BEFORE THE RESOLUTION.** A token maker's or a return's objects are not in it, so
  the verbs after them are refused rather than run as a silent no-op; a chain's origin is unknown at the clause.
- **A SCOPED CLAUSE PRODUCES ITS PERMANENTS, READ OFF ITS EVENTS.** The pump, the grant, the shield, the tap and the
  untap each name the permanent they reached; nothing else does.
- **A LATE-ENTERING ROW CANNOT ATTACK ON TURN 3.** The suite puts a draw-head or step-head row onto the battlefield in
  the third turn's main phase; an attack arm on the same card has no attack to declare that turn.

## D501 — THE SPELL'S OWN FATE: exiled, shuffled in, or put on the bottom as it resolves (2026-09-19)

**11,745 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,734
(+11: 10 spells the seam completes - Restock, Flood of Recollection, Treasured Find, Vivid Revival, Beacon of Destruction, Beacon of Creation, Spell Crumple, White Sun's Zenith, Blue Sun's Zenith, Red Sun's Zenith - and 1 row the wave rowed behind it (Magus of the Bridge; the probe diff is the 10 spells and the 1 row, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,713 → **7,714**. The REFUSED ledger 1,769 → **1,771** (+2: Morgul-Knife Wound and The Balrog, Flame of Udûn with the row maker's reasons; nothing retired - the ten spells were never ledgered). Fixtures 8,658 →
**8,666**. `scriptableToday` 1,854 → **1,856**; the ladder `[1856, 1866, 3163, 4687, 5892]`. Bot reach **4,823** from **370**.
An ENGINE SEAM on Fable 5.1, by the model rule: bounded, with a spell yield - the first such seam the tail's
measurement had named since the object rows.

### The measurement chose it — the resolving spell's destination

Measured over the whole leftover (`d501-fate.json`, the sentence dropped and the rest asked): `Exile ~.` was the one
unread sentence on 4 spells (7 with the three Zeniths' X announced) and one of several on 84 more; `Shuffle ~ into
its owner's library.` on 2 first / 8 partial (the Beacons, the Zeniths); `Put ~ on the bottom of its owner's
library.` on 1 first / 4 partial. CR 608.2n puts a resolved instant or sorcery into its owner's graveyard; these
cards replace that with their own text, and the engine had no site for it: `resolveTop` computed the destination
from the face alone (a permanent, a flashback's exile, the graveyard) and the vocabulary refused the sentence. One
decision, one site: the fate parses as a self kind and `resolveTop` reads it off the face as the card leaves the stack.

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/loop.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`)

- **THE THREE FATES PARSE AS SELF KINDS.** `Exile ~.` → `exileSelf` (D448's unearth kind, printed at last),
  `Shuffle ~ into its owner's library.` → `shuffleSelf`, `Put ~ on the bottom of its owner's library.` →
  `bottomSelf` (the `this creature` / `this permanent` forms too, an optional `then`); the rest of the spell reads
  beside them (Restock's two returns, the Beacon's damage, Spell Crumple's counter with its bottom rider, the Zeniths'
  X).
- **`resolveTop` OWNS THE SPELL'S FATE.** `spellFateOf` reads the face's effects (the chosen modes' for a modal) for
  a self fate when no shipped def owns the card, the face is auto and not a permanent; `to` becomes exile or the
  owner's library (the bottom placement for `bottomSelf`), `StackResolved` carries `fate`, the card moves as it leaves
  the stack - the card is still on the stack while its clauses run (CR 608.2), so the executor leaves a source on the
  stack alone. Flashback still wins (CR 702.34a: exiled instead, whichever way it would leave); a fizzled spell never
  resolves and goes to the graveyard (CR 608.2b). Said out loud: `… is exiled as it resolves.` / `… is shuffled into its
  owner's library.` / `… is put on the bottom of its owner's library.`
- **THE FATE'S SHUFFLE IS OVER THE LIBRARY THE CARD JOINED.** The resolution's events so far are applied to a scratch
  state before the order is drawn (a draw or a search before the fate has already moved cards; Blue Sun's Zenith
  draws X first), one `LibraryShuffled`, the RNG threaded through the log as every shuffle is.
- **ON A PERMANENT THE SAME WORDS ARE THE EXECUTOR'S.** `exileSelf` already moved a battlefield source to exile;
  `shuffleSelf` / `bottomSelf` move it to its owner's library (the shuffle over the library it joined, the same
  scratch-state read), so a permanent's own `Exile this creature.` (Magus of the Bridge) runs and rows.
- Five seam tests in `spellFate.test.ts`: the readings; Restock exiled after returning two cards, and put into the
  graveyard when it fizzles; Beacon of Destruction shuffled in after its damage (one shuffle, a permutation of the whole
  library, the card among it); Spell Crumple on the bottom of its owner's library under the spell it countered
  there; the replay hash on each. The fuzz: `spellFates` counted off `StackResolved.fate`, a staple pair (two Treasured
  Finds and two Beacons of Creation a seat - Restock beside the Beacon was the first fuel and never cast over sixty
  seeds, a four- and a five-mana sorcery on four basics), the floor above zero.

### The wave (`d501/gen201-vocab.cjs`, `gen-oneshot201.cjs`)

- **`exileSelf` IS ASSERTED THE WAY `sacrificeSelf` IS:** the row's card in exile, the board one smaller;
  `shuffleSelf` / `bottomSelf` stay outside `ASSERTABLE` and refuse a row by name.
- **THE SHARED GRAVEYARD FIXTURE'S SEAT DECIDES THE BOARD DELTA.** A row with two graveyard heads deals one fixture
  for both (`gyFixNames` dedups by name; the seat the first head's, p1's board), and the opponent's arm moves that
  same card off p1's board into p2's graveyard: the board is one smaller for that arm too (`gySeatOf`; D378's rule
  held while the fixture sat on p2's side - Magus of the Bridge's second arm read the board one high).
- The select offered 3 permanents whose payload the seam made readable; the row maker rowed Magus of the Bridge and
  refused two (Morgul-Knife Wound - a payment branch with `exileSelf`; The Balrog, Flame of Udûn - `legendary` in a
  filtered head), ledgered with its reasons; nothing retired (the ten spells were never ledgered - spells are not
  rowed, they are read).

### The wave — ten spells and one row

The select offered 3 permanents whose payload the seam made readable (Morgul-Knife Wound, The Balrog, Flame of Udûn, Magus of the Bridge); the row maker rowed Magus of the Bridge (2 abilities: the nontoken-creature-to-your-graveyard token head and the creature-to-an-opponent's-graveyard head whose payload is `Exile this creature.` - `exileSelf`, asserted the way `sacrificeSelf` is) and refused two (Morgul-Knife Wound - a payment branch the suite cannot assert with `exileSelf` in it; The Balrog - `legendary` outside the filtered head's adjective list), ledgered with its reasons (ledger501.cjs); nothing retired. The first port failed the Magus's second arm alone (the board one high: the shared graveyard fixture dealt on p1's board leaves it for the opponent's graveyard - `gySeatOf` now decides the delta by the seat the fixture is dealt on); the re-port was green (port501b: 1 suite, 3 tests) and the regeneration identical by name. The spells: the fate was the one unread sentence on ten instants and sorceries - the exile after a graveyard return (Restock, Flood of Recollection, Treasured Find, Vivid Revival), the shuffle-in after damage, tokens, a draw or counters (Beacon of Destruction, Beacon of Creation, White / Blue / Red Sun's Zenith - the Zeniths with their X announced), the bottom after a counter with its own bottom rider (Spell Crumple) - each reading checked before the port (spellFate.test.ts, d501/zenith501.txt). The fuzz: one new staple (two Treasured Finds and two Beacons of Creation a seat) read 3 spells leaving the stack by their own fate over 60 seeds (fuzz60-501, canary501.out; the first fuel - Restock beside the Beacon, a four- and a five-mana sorcery on four basics - read 0 over the same sixty and was swapped); the standing staples read 14 clauses bound to the previous clause's objects and 14 that acted, 24 untap skips, 11 once-per-turn triggers, 4 looks onto the battlefield and 14 public reveals, 4 spell copies, 1 populate, 3 token copies; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 11 newly complete (the 10 spells and the 1 row), nothing regressed.

### Traps

- **THE SPELL'S OWN FATE IS `resolveTop`'s, NEVER THE EXECUTOR'S.** The card is on the stack while its clauses run;
  the executor's self cases act on a battlefield source only, and the one site that moves the resolving card reads the
  fate off the face. Flashback wins; a fizzle never reaches the fate.
- **THE FATE'S SHUFFLE IS OVER THE LIBRARY THE CARD JOINED.** The events so far applied to a scratch state, or a draw
  before the fate would put its cards back.
- **AN ASKING SPELL'S FATE LANDS BEFORE THE ANSWER.** The card leaves the stack at `resolveTop` whatever the
  destination (the engine's convention since the prompt continuation, D484); a library fate is applied before the
  search's own shuffle answers. Not one of the ten cards asks (Green Sun's Zenith and Beacon of Unrest stay assisted).

## D502 — THE EXTRA TURN: taken after this one, the most recent first (2026-09-19)

**11,756 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,745
(+11: 9 spells the seam completes - Temporal Manipulation, Capture of Jingzhou, Beacon of Tomorrows, Karn's Temporal Sundering, Time Warp, Time Stretch, Temporal Trespass, Rise of the Eldrazi, Savor the Moment - and 2 rows the wave rowed behind it (Teferi, Timebender, Magistrate's Scepter; the probe diff is the 9 spells and the 2 rows, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,714 → **7,716**. The REFUSED ledger 1,771 → **1,773** (+3: Time Sieve, Temporal Extortion and Temporal Mastery with the row maker's reasons; 1 retired - Time Stretch's `extra turns`, read whole now). Fixtures 8,666 →
**8,676**. `scriptableToday` 1,856 → **1,858**; the ladder `[1858, 1868, 3166, 4689, 5894]`. Bot reach **4,825** from **370**.
An ENGINE SEAM on Fable 5.1, by the model rule: bounded, with a spell yield - the turn loop's own seam, the first
the tail's measurement had named there.

### The measurement chose it — the turn after this one

Measured over the whole leftover (`d502/extra502.json`): 59 cards carry an extra-turn sentence in 35 shapes. `Take an
extra turn after this one.` was the one unread sentence on 8 spells (Temporal Manipulation, Capture of Jingzhou, Beacon
of Tomorrows, Karn's Temporal Sundering, Time Warp, Time Stretch, Temporal Trespass, Rise of the Eldrazi) and one of
several on 20 more (the lose-the-game rider - Final Fortune, Warrior's Oath, Last Chance, Chance for Glory - the coin
flips, the votes, the miracle and prowl riders); 28 permanents carry it under a cost or a head (Time Sieve, Magistrate's
Scepter, Timestream Navigator, Medomai the Ageless, the walkers' ultimates). CR 500.7: an extra turn is taken after the
current one, and the most recently created extra turn is taken first. The engine had no representation of it -
`beginNextTurn` walked the seating order and nothing could splice a turn in. One decision, one site: the turn loop keeps
a stack of extra turns and takes it before the succession resumes.

### The seam (`src/engine/types/state.ts`, `src/engine/reducer.ts`, `src/engine/loop.ts`, `src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`)

- **THE EXTRA TURNS ARE A STACK.** `GameState.extraTurns` holds one entry per turn granted (`ExtraTurn { player,
  skipUntap? }`); `ExtraTurnAdded` pushes, and `beginNextTurn` pops the newest first (CR 500.7) - two spells cast in
  one main phase are taken in the reverse of their casting. `TurnBegan.extra` marks the turn (`TurnState.extra`), said
  out loud: `(an extra turn)`.
- **THE SUCCESSION RESUMES AFTER THE INTERRUPTED REGULAR TURN.** `TurnState.regular` names the player whose regular
  turn the extra turns interrupted; the seating order continues from that seat, never from the extra turn's player
  (Time Warp on the opponent: p2 takes turn 4 as an extra turn and turn 5 as its own, then p1).
- **A DEPARTED PLAYER'S EXTRA TURN IS DROPPED.** An entry whose player has left the game is popped untaken
  (`ExtraTurnDropped`); the next entry, or the succession, follows.
- **THE READINGS.** `Take an extra turn after this one.` / `You take an extra turn after this one.` parse as
  `extraTurn` (self, amount 1); `Target player takes an extra turn after this one.` as the aimed form; `two extra turns`
  as amount 2; `Skip the untap step of that turn.` as `skipUntapThatTurn` only right after an extra-turn clause (Savor
  the Moment) - it marks the entry just added (`ExtraTurnUntapSkipped`), and the untap step's turn-based action is
  skipped for the marked turn alone, no permanent's own skip spent.
- Seven seam tests in `extraTurn.test.ts`: the readings; Temporal Manipulation's turn 4 between p1's turn 3 and p2's
  turn 5; Time Warp aimed at the opponent; Time Stretch's two; the LIFO order of two spells in one main phase; Savor the
  Moment's skipped untap (a tapped Bears stays tapped through it and untaps on turn 6); a departed player's turn dropped
  (a three-seat game, p3 at zero life); the replay hash on each. The fuzz: `extraTurnsAdded` / `extraTurnsTaken`
  counted off `ExtraTurnAdded` and `TurnBegan.extra`, one staple (two Savor the Moments a seat), the floor above zero.

### The wave (`d502/gen202-vocab.cjs`, `gen-oneshot202.cjs`)

- **`extraTurn` IS ASSERTABLE, AND THE TURN IS PROVEN BY A WALK.** The stack is read the moment the ability
  resolves (one entry per turn, for the player the clause names); the walk to the next turn's upkeep - last of every
  read, it leaves the fire turn - proves the extra turn is the very next one, its player active, marked extra, the
  stack shorter by one. A head the suite fires past turn 3, a conditional fire, a delayed form and `Skip the untap
  step of that turn.` refuse the row by name.
- The select offered 5 cards the seam made offerable; the row maker rowed 2 (Teferi, Timebender, Magistrate's Scepter) and refused three
  (Time Sieve - `Sacrifice five artifacts` as a cost; Temporal Extortion and Temporal Mastery - spells with a line
  outside the vocabulary), ledgered with its reasons; one retired (Time Stretch's `extra turns`, read whole now).

### The wave — nine spells and two rows

The select offered 5 cards the seam made offerable (Teferi, Timebender, Time Sieve, Magistrate's Scepter, Temporal Extortion, Temporal Mastery); the row maker rowed Teferi, Timebender (3 loyalty abilities: the +2 untap, the -3 life and cards, the -9 extra turn) and Magistrate's Scepter (2 abilities: the charge counter, and `{T}, Remove three charge counters from this artifact` whose payload is `Take an extra turn after this one.`) and refused three (Time Sieve - `Sacrifice five artifacts` as a cost; Temporal Extortion and Temporal Mastery - spells with a line outside the vocabulary), ledgered with its reasons (ledger502.cjs); Time Stretch's `extra turns` entry retired, read whole now. The first port failed the Scepter's extra-turn test alone (the walk to the next turn stood before the ability's own cost reads, and the extra turn's untap step had untapped the Scepter) and the typecheck refused an unused `no` in both suites (the bare word in an assert message, read as the `no` fixture by the destructuring filter): the walk now goes LAST of the test body (the `EXTRA_TURN_WALK` marker, moved after the cost asserts in gen-oneshot202.cjs) and the message names the stack instead; the re-port was green (port502b: 2 suites, 7 tests) and the regeneration identical by name. The spells: the extra turn was the one unread sentence on eight instants and sorceries (Temporal Manipulation, Capture of Jingzhou, Beacon of Tomorrows, Karn's Temporal Sundering, Time Warp, Time Stretch, Temporal Trespass, Rise of the Eldrazi) and, with its skipped untap step, on Savor the Moment - each reading checked before the port (extraTurn.test.ts). The fuzz: one new staple (two Savor the Moments a seat) read 1 extra turn added and 1 taken over 60 seeds (fuzz60-502, canary502.out; the floor above zero holds, thinly - a three-mana sorcery on the bot's basics, cast once in sixty games); the standing staples read 2 spells leaving the stack by their own fate and 37 untap skips; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 11 newly complete (the 9 spells and the 2 rows), nothing regressed.

### Traps

- **THE EXTRA TURNS ARE A STACK.** The most recently created extra turn is taken first (CR 500.7); `TurnBegan.extra`
  marks the turn, and the regular succession waits until the stack is empty.
- **THE SUCCESSION RESUMES AFTER THE INTERRUPTED REGULAR TURN.** `TurnState.regular` is the seat the order continues
  from; an extra turn's active player is not it.
- **A DEPARTED PLAYER'S EXTRA TURN IS DROPPED.** Popped untaken, said out loud; nothing waits on a dead seat.
- **SKIPPING THE UNTAP STEP SPENDS NO PERMANENT'S OWN SKIP.** The marked entry skips the step's turn-based action for
  that turn; `untapSkips` on the permanents are untouched, and the sentence reads only right after its extra-turn clause.

## D503 — THE FLAVOUR WORDS: a trigger head read past any word before it, and the classifier catches up again (2026-09-20)

**11,788 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,756
(+32: 32 rows the wave rowed over the whole leftover - Dwarven Patrol, Moon-Blessed Cleric, Squall, SeeD Mercenary, Screamer-Killer, Owlbear, Lokhust Heavy Destroyer, Sanguinary Priest, Circle of the Land Druid, Domri Rade, White Dragon, Undercity Dire Rat, Sage of the Falls, Monk of the Open Hand, Devoted Paladin, Thunderwolf Cavalry, Atalan Jackal, Skorpekh Destroyer, Vrock, Red Dragon, Air-Cult Elemental, Primaris Chaplain, Black Dragon, Flayed One, Flow of Maggots, Myconid Spore Tender, Venomcrawler, Valor Singer, Knight Paladin, Night Scythe, Winter Eladrin, Prosperity Tycoon, Lord of Change; the probe diff is the 32 rows, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,716 → **7,748**. The REFUSED ledger 1,773 → **1,814** (-3 +44: Dwarven Patrol, Sage of the Falls and Additive Evolution retired by exact line (the row maker rows the first two; the third returns with its new reason), and the 44 the mirrors made offerable and the row maker refused, with its reasons). Fixtures 8,676 →
**8,735**. `scriptableToday` 1,858 → **1,899**; the ladder `[1899, 1909, 3204, 4721, 5904]`. Bot reach **4,836** from **371**.
The eighth Opus wave of the tail: D424's measurement replayed over the whole leftover, the D498 way.

### The measurement chose it — the row maker over every line-only leftover card

The tail is flat (`d503/yield503.json`: 26,988 unread payloads, no shape lands more than 6 cards alone once the riders
the row maker peels are set aside - the once-per-turn rider 57, `Activate only as a sorcery` 55, `Any player may
activate this ability` 19; the second-order pairs top out at 3), so the pick was made the D424 way: the row maker run
over EVERY line-only leftover card (19,329; `d503/rows503-all.log`, `gaps503.json`). It rowed 8 cards the select had
never offered - three the classifier lagged (Domri Rade's quoted emblem line, Flow of Maggots's `non-Wall` blocker
predicate, Prosperity Tycoon's quoted token) and five it held in the ledger, three of them stale. Among the 1,100 heads
the library refused, 80 stood behind a word the row maker did not strip (Opus 10, Repartee 11, Vivid 10, Void 6, Imprint
23, and the Universes Beyond flavour words one by one - Chainsword, Phaeron, Rosarius, Martyrdom, Whirlwind); with the
word read past, the row maker rowed 35.

### The wave (`d503/make-rows203.cjs`, `patch503-classifier.txt`, primitives.ts)

- **ANY WORD BEFORE A TRIGGER HEAD HAS NO RULES MEANING OF ITS OWN** (CR 207.2c / 207.2d - an ability word or a
  flavour word), and the printed trigger after it is the whole meaning (a keyword printed this way - Job select - is
  DEFINED as that trigger): `FLAVOR_WORD` in the row maker asks the head library past it, any capitalisation, at most
  four words, only before `When` / `Whenever` / `At`; the def's text stays the printed line, so the accounting is
  unchanged. The classifier mirrors it (`FLAVOR_TRIGGER_WORD`, the raw line stripped alongside the scrubbed one).
- **A QUOTED PAYLOAD IS ASKED OF THE RAW LINE.** `scrub` blanks a quote in place, so every classifier reader saw
  `−7: You get an emblem with` and `create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with` end at the verb; the row maker reads
  the raw payload through the vocabulary (D473's token table, D475's emblem table). `quotedPayloadReads` asks the raw
  line the way `rowMakerReads` asks the scrubbed one - the head, the cost or the loyalty cost the row maker takes, the
  payload whole (Domri Rade, Prosperity Tycoon).
- **THE BLOCKER PREDICATE JOINS `ROW_STATICS`.** `~ can't be blocked by / except by <subject>` over filterlib's subject
  grammar (the closed adjectives, a type, a subtype, a keyword qualifier or an either-of pair) reads `scriptable`
  where the file said layer 6 since D466; the fixture the filter admits stays the suite's business, and the ledger
  holds a predicate no fixture satisfies (Eldrazi Scions, Saprolings).
- **A TRAILING `on it` AFTER A TOKEN CLAUSE IS THE TOKEN'S PRONOUN.** The self rewrite under a self head (D313) put
  Additive Evolution's three counters on the enchantment and the 0/0 Fractal died (the first port); the row maker
  refuses the shape by name until the object verb reads a counter on the previous clause's objects.
- Three stale ledger entries retired by exact line (Dwarven Patrol's `nonred` filter, Sage of the Falls's
  this-or-another head, Additive Evolution's token-then-counters payload - the last re-ledgered with its new reason);
  the generator skipped Goblin Engineer and Ayula again for the fixtures the suite already puts (ledgered since D498).

### The wave — thirty-two rows, no spells

The row maker over the whole leftover rowed 35 (8 before the flavour words - Dwarven Patrol, Domri Rade, Sage of the Falls, Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Queen Among Bears, Flow of Maggots, Additive Evolution, Prosperity Tycoon - and 27 behind an ability or flavour word: the Warhammer 40,000 and Dungeons & Dragons creatures - Screamer-Killer, Lokhust Heavy Destroyer, Sanguinary Priest, Skorpekh Destroyer, Thunderwolf Cavalry, Primaris Chaplain, Flayed One, Venomcrawler, Night Scythe, Lord of Change, Owlbear, White / Red / Black Dragon, Air-Cult Elemental, Winter Eladrin, Vrock, Myconid Spore Tender, Undercity Dire Rat, Circle of the Land Druid, Devoted Paladin, Knight Paladin, Valor Singer, Moon-Blessed Cleric, Monk of the Open Hand, Atalan Jackal - and Squall, SeeD Mercenary). The generator skipped Goblin Engineer and Ayula for the fixtures the suite already puts (their ledger entries stand), and the first port failed Additive Evolution alone (the counters on the enchantment, the 0/0 token dead): the row maker refuses a trailing `on it` after a token clause by name, the module was retired (retire503.cjs) and the card re-ledgered with its reason; the re-port was green (port503: 32 suites, 74 tests). The select after the three mirrors offered 44 more, every one refused by the row maker for its own reason and ledgered (the Repartee head - 9; the batched token head; `enters from a graveyard`; the this-or-another heads with a subtype; a blocker predicate no fixture satisfies; the sacrifice heads over a Clue, a Food, an Eldrazi; the Opus riders). The fuzz: no new staple (the wave is thirty-two permanents on library heads); the standing staples read 2 extra turns added and 2 taken, 1 spell leaving the stack by its own fate, 9 clauses bound to the previous clause's objects and 9 that acted, 11 once-per-turn triggers and 40 untap skips over 60 seeds (fuzz60-503, canary503.out); seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 32 newly complete (the 32 rows), nothing regressed.

### Traps

- **THE CLASSIFIER LAGS THE ROW MAKER, MEASURE IT THE D424 WAY.** Eight rowable cards sat outside the select's offer;
  a run over the whole leftover is the only measurement that finds them.
- **A FLAVOUR WORD IS NOT A HEAD.** The library is asked past ANY word before `When` / `Whenever` / `At`; the def's
  text keeps the printed line.
- **`scrub` BLANKS A QUOTE IN PLACE.** A reader that never sees the raw line sees a quoted payload end at its verb;
  ask the raw line (D384's rule, again).
- **A TRAILING `it` AFTER A TOKEN CLAUSE IS THE TOKEN'S.** The self rewrite must stop at a clause that made an
  object; the suite caught it (the token died), which is what the suite is for.

## D504 — THE PREVIOUS OBJECT'S CONTROLLER: `Its controller creates / mills / discards`, bound as the clause runs (2026-09-20)

**11,817 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,788
(+29: 27 spells the seam completes - Beast Within, Generous Gift, Pongify, Rapid Hybridization, Crib Swap, Countermand, Thought Collapse, Psychic Strike, Dismal Failure, Didn't Say Please, Get Lost, Afterlife, Incubation // Incongruity, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Resculpt, Bovine Intervention, Stroke of Midnight, Glacial Grasp, Desecrated Earth, Funeral Pyre, Reduce to Memory, Buy Your Silence, Zuko's Exile, Assassin's Strike, Secure the Scene, Angelic Ascension, Emergency Eject - and 2 rows the wave rowed behind it (Ajani, Inspiring Leader, Zulaport Duelist; the probe diff is the 27 spells and the 2 rows, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,748 → **7,747** (+2 rows, −3 spell scripts retired: Last Breath, Misfortune's Gain and Nature's Claim - the vocabulary reads their `Its controller / owner gains 4 life` whole now, and D187's rule retires a def the vocabulary has outgrown, D398's tool). The REFUSED ledger 1,814 → **1,818** (+4: Gallows at Willow Hill, Cavalier of Dawn, Ovinomancer and Commander Sofia Daguerre with the row maker's reasons; nothing retired - the 27 spells were never ledgered). Fixtures 8,735 →
**8,742**. `scriptableToday` 1,899 → **1,903**; the ladder `[1903, 1913, 3209, 4727, 5885]`. Bot reach **4,851** from **371**.
A BOUNDED seam on Opus 5 by the refinement of the model rule (a precedent in the tree - D494's `objectsOf`, D500's object
verbs - built in the D168 pattern: six real cards proven with break-tests, the ledger left to drain).

### The measurement chose it — the largest one-sentence family in the whole leftover

Measured over the whole leftover (`d503/yield503.json`, the yield-if-built probe): `Its controller <does X>` / `That
creature's controller <does X>` / `Its owner <does X>` after a clause about an object was the ONE unread sentence on
69 cards over 51 shapes - the largest family the probe had left once the riders the row maker peels are set aside
(`Its controller mills N cards` 6, `Its controller discards a card` 3, the token makers - a 3/3 green Beast, a 3/3
green Ape, a 3/3 green Frog Lizard, a 1/1 white Spirit with flying, a Treasure, a Clue, a Map, an Elephant, an Ox, a
Bird, an Angel - some twenty-five, `Its controller gains N life` 1; the rest a search the referent player is asked
(7), life equal to a power or a toughness (last known information), a manifest, an incubate). The clause before it
produces an object the engine already tracks (D494's `objectsOf`); what was missing was the PLAYER that object belongs
to, as the clause before found it.

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/engine/types/oracle.ts`, `events.ts`)

- **THE BODY IS THE PLAYER-AIMED CLAUSE THE VOCABULARY ALREADY READS.** `controllerRewrite` reads `Its controller mills
  four cards.` as `Target player mills four cards.` and `Its controller creates a 3/3 green Beast creature token.` as
  the caster's `Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.` done by that player (`creates` / `gains` conjugated back);
  the spec is planned aimless (`ofPreviousPlayer: 'controller' | 'owner'`, `targetIndex: -1`) so `parseTargetClauses`
  never asks for a player target the card does not print. A body that asks, pays, scopes or waits stays unread; a
  rider that acts on nothing (`It can't be regenerated.`, Pongify) is stepped over to the object clause before it.
- **THE PLAYER IS THE OBJECT'S AS THE CLAUSE BEFORE FOUND IT** (CR 608.2h). The executor records, on every step with a
  card aim, the aim's controller and owner BEFORE the step moves the object (`produced[at].known`), and a stack aim's
  controller; the referent clause reads the record of the clause before (past a rider), dedups the players, drops one
  who has left the game, says `nothing ... to act on` when nothing was known (the target gone before the clause ran),
  and splices one ordinary player-aimed step per player - `mill`, `draw`, `loseLife` and `discard` already honour a
  player aim; `gainLife` and `createToken` now do (the token's controller and owner are the aimed player's). A marker
  event (`ReferentPlayerBound { player, text }`) says who, for the fuzz and the log.
- **A COUNTERED SPELL'S CONTROLLER IS THE SPELL'S OWN** (Countermand, Dismal Failure, Thought Collapse): the stack aim's
  `controller`, recorded as the counter step ran.
- **A TRIBAL SPELL'S `Changeling` LINE IS NO CLAUSE** (Crib Swap): dropped with the priced lines, the keyword the
  card's own.
- Six seam tests in `previousController.test.ts`: the readings (and the sentence refused with no object before it);
  Beast Within on the opponent's Bears (the Beast p2's, the Bears in p2's graveyard, nothing on p1's side); Generous
  Gift on p1's own Bears (the Elephant p1's); Countermand on p1's own spell (p1 mills four, p2's library untouched);
  Dismal Failure (the discard asked of the countered spell's controller); Crib Swap on a Bears p1 took with Act of
  Treason (the Shapeshifter p1's - the controller as last known - the Bears exiled); the replay hash on each. The fuzz:
  `referentPlayers` counted off the marker, a staple pair (two Beast Withins and two Generous Gifts a seat), the floor
  above zero.

### The wave (`d504/gen204-vocab.cjs`)

- **THE SUITE READS THE CLAUSE ON THE PREVIOUS FIXTURE'S SIDE.** A mill or a life change done by the previous object's
  controller reads p2's graveyard or life when the fixture before it is p2's (`refPlayerFixture`); a token or a
  discard on the opponent's side is refused by name (the suite reads p1's board alone, and p2's discard is an ask it
  does not answer this wave).
- The select offered 6 permanents the seam made offerable; the row maker rowed Ajani, Inspiring Leader (the +2 life and
  counters, the −3 exile with the controller's 2 life, the −10 mass grant) and Zulaport Duelist (the -2/-0 with the
  controller's mill) and refused four (Gallows at Willow Hill, Cavalier of Dawn, Ovinomancer - a token on the
  opponent's side; Commander Sofia Daguerre - `That permanent's controller creates a Junk token` under an `up to one`
  target the row maker reads as no pump), ledgered with its reasons.

### The wave — twenty-seven spells and two rows

The select offered 6 permanents the seam made offerable (Ajani, Inspiring Leader, Commander Sofia Daguerre, Gallows at Willow Hill, Zulaport Duelist, Cavalier of Dawn, Ovinomancer); the row maker rowed Ajani, Inspiring Leader (3 loyalty abilities: the +2 life and counters, the -3 exile whose rider is `Its controller gains 2 life` - read on p2's life, the -10 mass grant) and Zulaport Duelist (the -2/-0 whose rider is `Its controller mills two cards` - read on p2's graveyard) and refused four (Gallows at Willow Hill, Cavalier of Dawn, Ovinomancer - a token on the opponent's side the suite cannot read; Commander Sofia Daguerre - `That permanent's controller creates a Junk token` under an up-to-one target the row maker reads as no pump), ledgered with its reasons (ledger504.cjs); nothing retired. The port was green first time (port504: 2 suites, 6 tests). The spells: the referent was the one unread sentence on 27 instants and sorceries - the token makers (Beast Within, Generous Gift, Pongify, Rapid Hybridization, Crib Swap, Get Lost, Afterlife, Incubation // Incongruity, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Resculpt, Bovine Intervention, Stroke of Midnight, Funeral Pyre, Reduce to Memory, Buy Your Silence, Zuko's Exile, Secure the Scene, Angelic Ascension, Emergency Eject), the mills behind a counter or a shrink (Countermand, Thought Collapse, Psychic Strike, Glacial Grasp), the discards behind a counter (Dismal Failure, Didn't Say Please, Desecrated Earth, Assassin's Strike) - each reading checked before the port (previousController.test.ts). The fuzz: one new staple (two Beast Withins and two Generous Gifts a seat) read 6 clauses bound to the previous object's controller over 60 seeds (fuzz60-504, canary504.out); the standing staples read 3 spells leaving the stack by their own fate, 2 extra turns added and 2 taken, 6 clauses bound to the previous clause's objects and 6 that acted; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 29 newly complete (the 27 spells and the 2 rows), nothing regressed.

### Traps

- **THE PLAYER IS RECORDED BEFORE THE MOVE.** A destroyed permanent is in its owner's graveyard when the referent
  clause runs; the controller it had is last known information (CR 608.2h) and lives only in the step record.
- **A RIDER THAT ACTS ON NOTHING SITS BETWEEN THE CLAUSES.** `It can't be regenerated.` is a `noop` self clause; both
  the parser and the executor step over it to the object clause before.
- **THE REFERENT IS NOT A TARGET.** The body is read through `Target player ...` for its kind alone; the placed spec
  carries `targetIndex -1`, or every such spell would demand a player the card never asks for.
- **THE TOKEN'S MAKER IS THE AIMED PLAYER.** `createToken` was the caster's alone; a player aim now names the maker,
  and nothing else aims a token clause at a player.

## D505 — THE MASS VERBS OVER A SCOPE: a counter on each, all tapped, all untapped (2026-09-20)

**11,845 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,817
(+28: 20 spells the seam completes - Cryptic Command, Bond of Discipline, Duty Beyond Death, Gideon's Battle Cry, The Crystal's Chosen, Ensnare, Inspiring Roar, Strength of the Pack, Vastwood Surge, Liliana's Influence, Strength of the Coalition, Flying Crane Technique, Join Shields, Basri's Solidarity, United Front, Methods of the Mighty, Titania's Boon, Darkness Descends, Pledge of Unity, Blinkmoth Infusion - and 8 rows the wave rowed behind it (Archfiend of Ifnir, Greenbelt Radical, Roaring Slagwurm, Subjugator Angel, Village Bell-Ringer, Ultimecia, Temporal Threat, Veteran Beastrider, Mu Yanling; the probe diff is the 20 spells and the 8 rows, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,747 → **7,749** (+8 rows, −6: the spell scripts the vocabulary outgrew retired - Vitalize, Mobilize, To Arms!, Dramatic Reversal, Metal Fatigue, Thoughtweft Gambit - D187's rule, their suppression pins red at the gate). The REFUSED ledger 1,818 → **1,849** (+33: the 33 the seam made offerable and the row maker refused, with its reasons (Action News Crew among them, its first port red); Ensnare and Blinkmoth Infusion retired by exact line - the select's stale-refusal pin named them, read whole now). Fixtures 8,742 →
**8,754**. `scriptableToday` 1,903 → **1,935**; the ladder `[1935, 1946, 3240, 4725, 5879]`. Bot reach **4,870** from **372**.
A BOUNDED seam on Opus 5 (the scope grammar and `scopeMembers` the precedent - D383's mass pump, D434's mills; three
real cards proven with break-tests, the ledger left to drain).

### The measurement chose it — the largest family the vocabulary refused even in its plain form

Measured over the whole leftover (`d505/yield505.json`, `gaps505.json`): `Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you
control.` was the most frequent gap sentence the vocabulary refused (41 occurrences in the two capitalisations, 6 the
only unread sentence on a card), beside `Untap all creatures you control.` (15), `Tap all creatures your opponents
control.` (5), `Put a stun counter on each of them` (6 - the object verb's, not this seam's), `each other creature you
control` (6), `each other Dragon creature you control` (5), `all lands you control` (6) - 28 cards landable by the
family alone. The vocabulary read `Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn` (D383) and `Destroy all
creatures` but not a counter on each of them, and not a tap or an untap over any scope at all.

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/engine/types/oracle.ts`, `events.ts`)

- **THE WIDE SCOPE.** `readWideScope`: `each` / `all`, an optional `other`, an optional capitalised subtype, the noun
  (creatures; lands, artifacts, enchantments, permanents; `nonland permanents`; attacking creatures) and a controller
  phrase (`you control`, `your opponents control`, `you don't control`); `BoardScope` gains `other`, `subtype` and
  `nonland`, and `scopeMembers` reads them (the source left out of an `other` scope, the subtype off `derive`, a land
  out of `nonland`). `target player controls`, `the chosen type` and an X count stay unread.
- **THREE KINDS, ONE WALK EACH.** `massCounters` (the counter kind and the count on every member, one
  `CountersChanged`), `massTap` (one `PermanentsTapped` over the untapped members), `massUntap` (one
  `PermanentsUntapped` over the tapped ones); a `ScopeWalked { verb, members, text }` marker beside each, for the fuzz
  and the log. The scope is walked over the state the clauses BEFORE it left (The Crystal's Chosen's four Heroes are
  creatures it controls) - the events so far applied to a scratch state, the derive cache set aside for it. The
  members ride the events for the object verbs after the clause (D500's `objectsOf` reads them).
- **THE CAPTURES EXCLUDE `each of ...`.** `matchRule` is first-match, and a rule whose regex matches but whose reader
  refuses returns null for the sentence: `each of up to two target Merfolk you control` (Vineshaper Mystic's shipped
  row) and `each of them` (the object verb's) are the counted-target rules' and stay theirs (the D90 guard on the
  select caught it at load).
- Four seam tests in `massVerbs.test.ts`: the readings (and the shapes refused); Vitalize untapping p1's tapped Bears
  and leaving p2's tapped Cyclops alone; Bond of Discipline tapping p2's creatures and none of p1's, the lifelink
  granted beside it; The Crystal's Chosen putting a counter on each of p1's creatures including the four Heroes it just
  made and none on p2's; the replay hash on each. The fuzz: `scopesWalked` counted off the marker, a staple pair (two
  Vitalizes and two Bonds of Discipline a seat), the floor above zero.

### The wave (`d505/gen205-vocab.cjs`)

- **THE WITNESS THE SCOPE REACHES.** An `opponents` / `any` scope is proven on the Cyclops the suite deals on p2's
  side (the counter on it, the tap, the untap - a -1/-1 counter that kills it read as its graveyard); a `you` scope on
  the row's own creature (the counter on it, the untap), the opponent's witness untouched beside it. A subtype, an
  `other`, a `nonland`, an attacking or a keyword scope, a permanent scope without a witness, a `you` scope on a row
  whose card is not a creature or whose cost sends it away (Action News Crew's Channel - the first port put the row's
  card in the graveyard before the counter came), and a mass tap of your own creatures are refused by name.
- The select offered 41 permanents the seam made offerable; the row maker rowed 8 (Archfiend of Ifnir, Greenbelt
  Radical, Roaring Slagwurm, Subjugator Angel, Village Bell-Ringer, Ultimecia, Temporal Threat, Veteran Beastrider,
  Mu Yanling) and refused 33 with its reasons (the Dragons' `each other Dragon creature you control`, the `Tap all
  other creatures` Mares, the lands - Beledros Witherbloom, Wilderness Reclamation, Chimeric Idol, Silt Crawler - the
  Myr, the Fractals, the Zombies, the Plants; Action News Crew), ledgered.

### The wave — twenty spells and eight rows

The select offered 41 permanents the seam made offerable; the row maker rowed 8 - Archfiend of Ifnir (the cycle-or-discard head's -1/-1 counter on each creature your opponents control, read on the Cyclops), Greenbelt Radical, Roaring Slagwurm (the attack head's `Tap all creatures your opponents control`), Subjugator Angel (the enters head's), Village Bell-Ringer (the flash creature's `Untap all creatures you control`), Ultimecia, Temporal Threat, Veteran Beastrider, Mu Yanling (the -10: the mass tap and the extra turn, D502's walk last) - and refused 33 with its reasons: the scopes the suite has no witness for (`each other Dragon creature you control` on the Dragons, `Tap all other creatures` on the Mares, the Myr, the Fractals, the Zombies, the Plants, the nonland permanents), the land scopes (Beledros Witherbloom, Wilderness Reclamation, Chimeric Idol, Silt Crawler, Troublesome Spirit), a `you` scope on a non-creature (Domri, City Smasher, Felidar Retreat) or on a card its cost sends away (Action News Crew's Channel - the first port put the row's card in the graveyard before the counter came; retired with retire505c.cjs and re-ledgered), three heads the library lacks, Sky Hussar's Forecast; ledgered (ledger505.cjs). Vitalize's spell script retired (retire505b.cjs) - its suppression pin went red the moment the vocabulary read its sentence. The re-port was green (port505b: 8 suites, 20 tests) and the regeneration identical by name. The spells: the mass verb was the one unread sentence on twenty instants and sorceries - Cryptic Command's modes among them, the counter-on-each spells (Duty Beyond Death, Gideon's Battle Cry, The Crystal's Chosen, Strength of the Coalition, Vastwood Surge, Basri's Solidarity, United Front, Methods of the Mighty, Titania's Boon, Pledge of Unity, Join Shields, Inspiring Roar, Strength of the Pack), the taps (Bond of Discipline, Ensnare, Flying Crane Technique, Darkness Descends), the -1/-1 counters on each creature you don't control (Liliana's Influence), Blinkmoth Infusion's untap - each reading checked before the port (massVerbs.test.ts). The fuzz: one new staple (two Vitalizes and two Bonds of Discipline a seat) read 7 scopes walked over 60 seeds (fuzz60-505, canary505.out); the standing staples read 7 clauses bound to the previous object's controller, 2 spells leaving the stack by their own fate, 1 extra turn added and 1 taken; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 28 newly complete (the 20 spells and the 8 rows), nothing regressed.

### Traps

- **A FIRST-MATCH RULE MUST NOT MATCH WHAT IT WILL NOT READ.** A wide capture that its reader then refuses returns
  null for the whole sentence and steals it from the rule after it; the D90 guard on a shipped row's payload is what
  caught it. Narrow the regex (`(?!of )`), never widen the reader to compensate.
- **THE SCOPE IS WALKED OVER THE STATE THE CLAUSES BEFORE IT LEFT.** A token made a clause earlier is a creature you
  control by the time the counter comes; the scratch state (the events so far applied) is the one to walk.
- **THE SPELL READ WHOLE TURNS ITS SUPPRESSION PIN RED.** Vitalize's script (D187's era) went red the moment the
  vocabulary read its one sentence; retire the def, re-pin the length, re-run the gate (D504's lesson, again).
- **A DUPLICATE FIXTURE NAME IS TWO EXPORTS.** `make-engine-fixtures` does not dedup its list; a name already there
  (Vitalize, since D338) added again breaks every suite at transform.

## D506 — THE WITNESSES THE SCOPES LACKED: a mass verb over your own side proven on a card the suite puts there (2026-09-20)

**11,870 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,845
(+25: 25 rows the wave rowed - Beledros Witherbloom, Domri, City Smasher, Acid-Spewer Dragon, Action News Crew, Belltoll Dragon, Biomathematician, Chimeric Idol, Citizen V, Helmut Zemo, Copperhorn Scout, Githzerai Monk, Havengul Runebinder, Herdchaser Dragon, Shieldhide Dragon, Shrieking Mogg, Silt Crawler, Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Stormwing Dragon, Thundermare, Timbermare, Troublesome Spirit, Unstoppable Plan, Wilderness Reclamation, Avenger of Zendikar, Myr Galvanizer, Felidar Retreat; the probe diff is the 25 rows, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,749 → **7,774**. The REFUSED ledger 1,849 → **1,824** (-33 +8: the 33 mass-verb rows D505 ledgered retired by exact line (25 land now), and the 8 still refused back with their D506 reasons - Aragorn and Arwen, Wed's counted life gain under an enters-or-attacks head, Urtet's timing on a late-entering row, three heads the library lacks (a creature connives, an opponent discards or mills, you tap an opponent's creature), Sky Hussar's Forecast, Camellia's `one or more Foods`, Kumena's tap cost of the scope subtype). Fixtures 8,754 →
**8,782**. `scriptableToday` 1,935 → **1,910**; the ladder `[1910, 1921, 3215, 4700, 5854]`. Bot reach **4,883** from **375**.
A generator wave on Opus 5 (the D505 ledger drained the D168 way: build the witness, prove the rows, ledger the rest).

### The measurement chose it — the largest refusal D505 left

D505's wave refused 33 of the 41 rows the seam made offerable, 25 of them for one reason: the suite had no WITNESS
for a `you` scope (the Cyclops it deals is the opponent's), for a subtype scope (`each other Dragon creature you
control` on five Dragons, the Myr, the Fractals, the Zombies, the Plants, the Villains), for an `other` scope (`Tap all
other creatures` on three Mares, `each other creature you control` on Aragorn and Arwen, Spider-Man, Copperhorn Scout)
or for a land scope (`Tap / Untap all lands you control` on five). One witness on the row's own side lands them all.

### The wave (`d506/gen206-vocab.cjs`, `gen-oneshot206.cjs`, `collect-payloads.cjs`; `src/engine/effects.ts`)

- **THE WITNESS ON THE ROW'S OWN SIDE.** `ownWitnessFor` names it: a Runeclaw Bear for a creature scope (never a name
  the suite puts for anything else), the quietest fixture of the subtype the scope names (the row's own card left out -
  Alpha Myr for the Myr, Gutter Skulk for the Zombies, Esix, Fractal Bloom for the Fractals, Black Tom Cassidy for the
  Villains, Dragonborn Looter for the Dragons), Wastes for a land scope, the Bear for `nonland permanents`; dealt on
  p1 before the baseline (`ownWitnesses` rides the decks, the vars and the puts beside the opponent's witnesses), tapped
  before the fire for an untap (`preFire` - never the row's own card, whose {T} would find it tapped), read after it.
- **THE BASELINE BEFORE THE FIRE.** A compound head (`Whenever Spider-Man enters or attacks`) fires at the arm and again
  in the arm under test, so the witness's and the row's own counters are read against `ownC0` / `selfC0` captured in
  `preFire` - the first port read two counters where it expected one.
- **THE OBJECT VERBS AFTER A MASS VERB.** `Those creatures gain trample until end of turn` after `Put a +1/+1 counter on
  each creature you control` binds to the witnesses the scope reached (`scopeVars`: the own witness and the row's own
  creature for a `you` scope, the row's card left out of an `other` scope, the opponent's witness for the rest) - the
  suite's `objectsOf` used to bind it to the row's card alone (Domri, City Smasher's trample went to the walker); and the
  engine's `objectsOf` reads the counters event now (D505's promise: the members ride the events).
- **THE PAYLOAD HARVESTER READS PAST A FLAVOUR WORD.** `Psychic Defense — When this creature enters, tap all creatures
  you don't control.` (Githzerai Monk) never reached the vocabulary's table: `collect-payloads` asked the head regex of
  the printed line, flavour word and all, so the row maker read nothing (D503 taught the row maker, not the harvester).
- **A TIMING CONDITION ON A LATE-ENTERING ROW IS A SKIP, NOT A CRASH.** Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch's sorcery-speed
  counter threw inside the generator and took the whole run down; it is the row's own limit, skipped by name.
- The 33 D505 entries retired by exact line; the 25 rows landed (the Dragons - Acid-Spewer, Belltoll, Herdchaser,
  Shieldhide, Stormwing - the Mares - Shrieking Mogg, Thundermare, Timbermare - the lands - Beledros Witherbloom,
  Wilderness Reclamation, Chimeric Idol, Silt Crawler, Troublesome Spirit - Aragorn and Arwen's cousin rows, Copperhorn
  Scout, Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Biomathematician, Citizen V, Havengul Runebinder, Avenger of Zendikar, Myr
  Galvanizer, Unstoppable Plan, Domri, City Smasher, Felidar Retreat, Action News Crew, Githzerai Monk); the 8 still
  refused re-ledgered with their reasons (Aragorn and Arwen, Wed's counted life gain under an enters-or-attacks head,
  Urtet's timing, three heads the library lacks, Sky Hussar's Forecast, Camellia's `one or more Foods`, Kumena's tap
  cost of the scope subtype).

### The wave — twenty-five rows, no spells

The pool was the 33 rows D505 ledgered; with the witness on the row's own side the row maker rowed 26 and the generator 25 (Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch skipped by name: a timing condition on a late-entering row): the five Dragons' `each other Dragon creature you control` on a Dragonborn Looter, the three Mares' `Tap all other creatures` on the Cyclops with the row's own card left untapped, the five land rows' `Tap / Untap all lands you control` on a Wastes (tapped before the fire for an untap), the Myr, the Zombies, the Fractals, the Plants and the Villains on the quietest fixture of their subtype, Copperhorn Scout's and Spider-Man's `other` scopes on a Runeclaw Bear with the row's card left out, Domri, City Smasher's and Felidar Retreat's non-creature rows on the Bear, Action News Crew's Channel on the Bear alone, Githzerai Monk once the harvester read past its flavour word. The first port failed three suites alone: the object grant after a mass counter asserted on the row's card (Domri's trample on the walker) and Spider-Man's compound head fired twice on the suite's board (two counters where one was read) - the objects of a mass verb are the witnesses it reached (`scopeVars`) and a counter reads against the baseline before the fire (`ownC0` / `selfC0`); the re-port was green (port506b: 24 suites, 56 tests; Githzerai Monk's own port: 25 suites, 58 tests). The 33 D505 entries retired by exact line; the 8 still refused re-ledgered with their reasons (ledger506.cjs). The fuzz: no new staple (the wave is twenty-five permanents on library heads); the standing staples read 4 scopes walked, 4 clauses bound to the previous object's controller, 8 clauses bound to the previous clause's objects and 7 that acted over 60 seeds (fuzz60-506, canary506.out); seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so every floor holds by construction. The leftover diff: 25 newly complete (the 25 rows), nothing regressed.

### Traps

- **THE WITNESS IS ON THE SIDE THE SCOPE NAMES.** A `you` scope proven on the opponent's Cyclops proves nothing; a
  witness of the subtype, the type or the `other`-ness the scope names, on the row's own side, is the only honest read.
- **A COMPOUND HEAD FIRES TWICE ON THE SUITE'S BOARD.** Read a counter against the baseline taken before the arm's own
  fire, never against zero.
- **THE OBJECTS OF A MASS VERB ARE ITS MEMBERS, NOT THE SOURCE.** The generator's `objectsOf` read a `self: true` spec
  as the row's card; a scoped clause's objects are what the scope reached.
- **THE HARVESTER AND THE ROW MAKER MUST READ THE SAME HEAD.** A word the row maker strips (a flavour word) the
  harvester must strip too, or the payload never reaches the vocabulary's table and the row maker refuses a sentence
  the vocabulary reads.

## D507 — THE REFERENT SEARCH: the previous object's controller asked to find a basic land (2026-09-20)

**11,881 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,870
(+11: 5 spells by the parser alone - Path to Exile, Erode, Cleansing Wildfire, Geomancer's Gambit, Avengers Disassembled - and 6 rows - Ghost Quarter, Sandworm, White Orchid Phantom, the seam's own, and Carnifex Demon, Chaos Terminator Lord, Plasmancer, which the whole-leftover row maker rowed beside it; the probe diff is the 11, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,774 → **7,780**. The REFUSED ledger 1,824 → **1,822** (-2: Chaos Terminator Lord's and Plasmancer's D503 entries retired by exact line - their payloads read now and their suites are green; the wave refused no row). Fixtures 8,783 →
**8,795**. `scriptableToday` 1,910 → **1,908**; the ladder `[1908, 1919, 3213, 4697, 5851]`. Bot reach **4,887** from **375**.
A BOUNDED engine seam on Opus 5 (D504's referent player with the search as its body, built the D168 way: the seam, four proofs, the rows).

### The measurement chose it — the whole leftover is flat; the residue with a spell yield and three staples on it

The row maker over every line-only leftover card (19,215; `d507/rows507-all.log`) rowed 6, five of them ledgered, and
the yield probe's top shapes were artifacts of its own reader (`Activate only as a sorcery.` 58 and `This ability
triggers only once each turn.` 58 are riders the row maker peels and the probe does not - the mirror still lacking).
Of the residues the D506 measurement listed, the referent search (`Its controller may search their library for a basic
land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.`) was the one with a spell yield and three Commander
staples on it (Path to Exile, Assassin's Trophy, Ghost Quarter): 7 cards with it as their only unread line, 11 more
touched (`d507/measure507-cands.cjs`).

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`; `src/engine/previousController.test.ts`)

- **THE READING.** `controllerRewrite` (D504) reads a third body: `may search their library for ...` is the caster's
  own `You may search your library for ...` with its person changed (`searches ... puts ... then shuffles` the same
  sentence in the third person), `search` joining `PLAYER_REF_KINDS`; the spec is the search rule's own (`optional`,
  the destination, `tapped`, the shuffle) with `self: false` and `ofPreviousPlayer: 'controller'`. Nothing before it,
  and the sentence stays unread.
- **THE SEARCHER.** The executor's `search` case reads the aimed player - the library read and revealed, the prompt
  raised with `player: searcher` - so the bound player answers (`answerSearchLibrary` keys on `awaiting.player`; the
  bot's `searchLibrary` case waits when it is not its search and accepts the offer when it is) and finds in their OWN
  library; the found card enters on their side.
- **THE SPLICED STEP'S OWN INDEX.** A step spliced in as a clause runs (D494's objects, D504's player) is a copy
  `effects.indexOf` did not find (-1), so a question it raised carried the WHOLE list as its continuation - a referent
  search would have exiled again and asked again after every answer (D504's referent discard re-ran the list once and
  narrated once). The step carries `at` now; the continuation is the clauses after the search (Cleansing Wildfire's
  `Draw a card.` runs once the answer is in, and the ask is raised once).
- **THE PROOFS.** The readings (the may form, the third person, the sentence refused with no object before it); Path to
  Exile on the opponent's Bears (p2 asked - the offer, then the reveal stage - finds a Forest that enters tapped on p2's
  side, nothing on p1's); Path to Exile declined (nothing found, nothing asked twice); Cleansing Wildfire on the
  opponent's Forest (the Swamp found, then p1 draws; two prompts, one binding); the replay hash on each. The fuzz:
  `referentSearches` (a `ReferentPlayerBound` with a search text) counted, Path to Exile a rotating staple, two a seat.

### The wave — six rows, five spells

The select offered the three rows whose whole leftover was the seam's sentence (Ghost Quarter's sacrifice-and-destroy,
Sandworm's and White Orchid Phantom's enters-and-destroy); the generator deals the search fixture into the bound side's
deck, answers the ask as that player and reads that player's library and battlefield (`gen207-vocab.cjs`: the D504
refusal admits a search on the opponent's side; the ask's `side`); the row maker over the whole leftover rowed three
more whose D503 payloads the vocabulary reads now (Carnifex Demon's -1/-1 counter on each other creature, Chaos
Terminator Lord's double strike on another creature, Plasmancer's basic Swamp search), ported beside them - 6 suites,
13 tests green first time; the two D503 entries retired by exact line. The parser alone landed Path to Exile, Erode,
Cleansing Wildfire, Geomancer's Gambit and Avengers Disassembled (the modal); Assassin's Trophy and Price of Freedom
stay - `target permanent an opponent controls` is a target predicate the effect reader does not read on a destroy (a
measured residue now). The fuzz: Path to Exile joins the rotating staples (two a seat) and reads 7 referent searches over 60 seeds (fuzz60-507, canary507.out); the standing staples read 9 clauses bound to the previous object's controller, 5 scopes walked, 8 clauses bound to the previous clause's objects and 8 that acted, 2 spell fates, an extra turn added and taken; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so the floor above zero holds by construction.

### Traps

- **A SPLICED STEP CARRIES ITS CLAUSE'S INDEX.** A copy of a spec is not in `effects`; a question it raises must carry
  the clauses after its clause, never the list again - the second pass narrates, exiles or asks twice.
- **THE SEARCHER IS THE AIMED PLAYER.** The library read, the reveal and the prompt all name the searcher; a
  `controller` left in any of the four asks the caster to find in the opponent's library.
- **THE SEARCH FIXTURE RIDES THE SEARCHER'S DECK.** The suite's answer names a card in the bound side's library; a
  fixture dealt to p1 for a p2 search is a search that finds nothing and passes either way.
- **THE YIELD PROBE COUNTS PAYLOADS, NOT CARDS.** Its top shapes were riders the row maker peels; a card's landing is
  the row maker's whole-leftover run and the sole-line count, never the probe's first-order figure alone.

## D508 — THE HAND PUT: a card put from the hand onto the battlefield, asked over the chooser's own hand (2026-09-20)

**11,916 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,881
(+35: 8 spells by the parser alone - Growth Spiral, Eureka Moment, Lessons from Life, Embrace the Paradox, Swell of Growth, Broken Bond, Dramatic Entrance, Joint Exploration - and 27 rows - Stoneforge Mystic, Elvish Piper, Sakura-Tribe Scout, Walking Atlas, Akul the Unrepentant, Arboreal Grazer, Copper Gnomes, Elvish Pioneer, Firebrand Ranger, Gaea's Touch, Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant, Gretchen Titchwillow, Krosan Wayfarer, Llanowar Scout, Loam Dweller, Master Transmuter, Norwood Priestess, On the Trail, Planebound Accomplice, Quicksilver Amulet, Root Elemental, Scaled Herbalist, Skyshroud Ranger, Terrain Generator, Warren Instigator, White Tiger, Amulet Keeper, Horizon of Progress; the probe diff is the 35, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,780 → **7,807**. The REFUSED ledger 1,822 → **1,824** (+2: Burgeoning and Nicanzil, Current Conductor, by the row maker's own reason - a trigger head the library lacks; nothing retired). Fixtures 8,795 →
**8,827**. `scriptableToday` 1,908 → **1,910**; the ladder `[1910, 1924, 3220, 4704, 5858]`. Bot reach **4,911** from **379**.
A BOUNDED engine seam on Opus 5 (a `chooseFromZone` question over the hand whose picks arrive as permanents - D491's
free cast and D493's look-to-battlefield as its precedents, built the D168 way: the seam, five proofs, the rows).

### The measurement chose it — the largest bounded family with a spell yield

The D507 measurement (`d507/measure507-hand.cjs`, over the line-only leftover) found `put <count> <noun> card(s) from
your hand onto the battlefield( tapped)?` on 118 cards, 56 with it as their only unread line (`land card` 29 and 14
tapped, `creature card` 18, `permanent card` 5, `artifact card` 5, the subtypes and colours after); across the whole
database (`d508/hand-forms508.cjs`) the family is 19 shapes, the `you may` form 131 printings, the tapped form 19, the
mandatory forms all `up to N` (Patron of the Moon, The World Spell). The tail is flat (D507: 6 rowable of 19,215), and
this was the residue with a spell yield and a staple on it (Stoneforge Mystic's `{1}{W}, {T}`).

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/engine/handlers.ts`, `src/bot/awaiting.ts`; `src/engine/handPut.test.ts`)

- **THE READING.** `putFromHandRule`: `(You may) put <count> <noun> card(s) from your hand onto the battlefield (tapped).`
  - the count `a` / `an` / one..four exact, `up to N` and `any number of` optional (the player's to stop short); the
  noun the look grammar's (the negations `LOOK_NON` reads become `none`; `lookFilter` over the rest; a bare `card`
  unrestricted); the sentence must end there (`tapped and attacking`, `face down`, `for each free vote`, `X`, `non-Saga`
  stay unread). The spec rides `look` (`take`, `filter`, `none`, `optional`, `to: 'battlefield'`, `tapped`, `rest:
  'hand'` - the unchosen stay where they are) under the new kind `putFromHand`, an asking kind in `OBJ_ASKS`,
  `PAY_BODY_REFUSED` and `DELAY_ASKS` (so a referent clause after it, Sneak Attack's `That creature gains haste`, stays
  unread rather than binding to nothing across the answer).
- **THE EXECUTOR.** What the noun admits in the hand (`handChoiceAdmits`, D416's reader): nothing admitted asks nothing
  (D141 - a question with no legal answer is not raised); a MANDATORY put with no more admitted than it takes moves them
  unasked (CR 701.8a); otherwise the prompt over the hand with `to: 'battlefield'`, `min` 0 under `you may` / `up to`,
  the filter and the negations riding it (printed), never the candidates (D137).
- **THE ANSWER.** `answerChooseFromZone`'s hand branch beside D491's free cast: the picks the noun admits leave the hand
  for the battlefield under the chooser's control (tapped when the line says so), named first by the `PutFromHand`
  marker the fuzz counts; an empty answer puts nothing and the effect goes on (the continuation, D484). The move is an
  ordinary entry - the entry funnel and the enters triggers run as for a look's battlefield pick.
- **THE BOT.** The hand put's pick: its own hand through the bound (D416's reader on the view), the most expensive
  first, up to the count; nothing admitted under `you may` puts nothing. The harness's auto-answer reads the same bound.
- **THE PROOFS.** The readings (the may form, the tapped form, the up-to count, the bare card, the negation, the
  mandatory form; five sentences left unread); Growth Spiral (the draw, then the ask - a creature refused, the Forest
  put untapped, the marker, the hash); declined (nothing moves, nothing asked twice); Swell of Growth with no land in
  hand (the pump lands, nothing is asked); Lessons from Life (three drawn, the Forest put tapped). The fuzz: `handPuts`
  counted, Swell of Growth a rotating staple, two a seat. ⚠️ A printed activated ability runs only through its row's
  script (Tier 3 otherwise), so Sakura-Tribe Scout's and Patron of the Moon's abilities are proven by the rows' suites,
  not by the seam test - the first draft activated them by hand and read the cleanup discard as the ask.

### The wave — twenty-seven rows, eight spells

The select offered 29 rows whose whole leftover was a hand put (17 activated puts, three enters puts, two draw-then-put activations, a cast-Spirit-or-Arcane head, a second-card head, a turned-face-up head, a combat-damage head, Stoneforge Mystic's enters search beside its put, Akul's sacrifice-three activation); the row maker rowed 27 and refused 2 (Burgeoning's `an opponent plays a land`, Nicanzil's `a creature you control explores a land card` - heads the library lacks); the generator built all 27 - 27 suites, 56 tests, green on the third port (the staging's scope and the harness's answer on the first two). The generator (`d508/gen208-vocab.cjs`): the fixture the noun admits (`handPutFixture` - the look's reader,
a Forest for a bare card, a Bears for `nonland`) dealt twice and staged into p1's hand before the fire, the hand baseline
RE-MEASURED after the staging (`let hand0` when a fire re-measures - a variable declared inside the fire is out of the
asserts' scope, which the first port's 27 `tsc` errors said), the ask answered with it and read on the battlefield
(tapped when the line says so); the oneshot stops a trigger's fire at the prompt; the vocab hand and board adjustments
read a RETURN cost now (Master Transmuter's `Return an artifact you control` beside its put - the returned Sol Ring is
one more in hand and one fewer on the board). Two rows join the ledger with their reasons; nothing retires.
