### Traps

- **A PRINTED ACTIVATED ABILITY RUNS ONLY THROUGH ITS ROW.** The engine charges every printed activation and resolves
  the keywords it knows (equip, cycling, unearth ...); a printed effect text is the row's script or nothing (Tier 3). A
  seam test that activates by hand proves nothing - it read the cleanup discard as the ask.
- **A VARIABLE DECLARED IN THE FIRE IS OUT OF THE ASSERTS' SCOPE.** `armed()` returns its baselines; a staging's hand
  cost is a re-measure of `hand0` (declared `let` when a fire re-measures), never a `let` in the fire.
- **THE HARNESS ANSWERS WHAT THE HOST ADMITS.** The replay test's `advanceUntil` answers prompts by itself; a hand prompt
  with a printed noun must be answered through `handChoiceCandidates`, or the first card in hand is a Forest offered to
  a creature put and the replay throws.
- **A RETURN COST IS ONE MORE IN HAND AND ONE FEWER ON THE BOARD** after the baseline; the vocab adjustments read it now.

- **ASSEMBLE THE DOCS APPLIER AFTER THE FILL.** D507's closeout ran an applier assembled before the number fill and wrote four literal
  holes into the handoff table (found at D508's dry run); the applier refuses to run while its own text carries a hole.

**8,861**. `scriptableToday` 1,910 → **1,921**; the ladder `[1921, 1935, 3229, 4703, 5856]`. Bot reach **4,929** from **381**.
A parser widening on Opus 5 under an enforcement already in place (D407's reader, D139's order), built the D168 way: the
macro, three proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — a yield-if-admitted probe over the whole leftover

The sole-line count for a controller-restricted target was 684 leftover cards (`d507/measure507-cands.cjs`'s family
reader), but most of those lines carry more; the honest measure was a yield probe (`d509/zz-ctrl509.node.test.ts`):
for every unread line with `target <adjectives> <noun> (you control | an opponent controls | you don't control)` on a
noun the effect parser's table knew only bare, delete the word and ask whether the sentence reads whole - 40 cards
(8 spells) every unread line of which reads that way, the shapes led by `creatures you control` 7, `artifact or
enchantment an opponent controls` 6, `instant or sorcery spell you control` 6, `artifact or creature you control` 5,
`artifact creature you control` 4, `creature or Vehicle you control` 4, `creature or planeswalker you don't control` 4.
The tail is flat (D507: 6 rowable of 19,215); this was the bounded pick with a spell yield and two staples on it
(Assassin's Trophy, Eerie Interlude).

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`; `src/engine/controllerTarget.test.ts`)

- **THE MACRO.** `TARGET` admits an optional `CONTROLLER` after ANY noun of its table - `(?: (?:you control|an opponent
  controls|you don't control))?` between the noun and the qualifier - admitted ONLY because `targetParse` has read the
  controller off every noun since D407 (`readController`) and `specAdmits` enforces it on every candidate, the stack
  included (D139's order: enforce first, then admit the wording). The D407 entries that spell the word per noun stay
  (longest first); `artifact or land` joins the noun table (Price of Freedom, Wreak Havoc, Volcanic Submersion,
  Violent Impact - the target parser reads the list per alternative).
- **THE PROOFS.** The readings (the three words on nouns the table spelled only bare - `permanent`, `artifact or
  land`, `artifact creature`, `nonbasic land`, `artifact`, `creature or Vehicle`; the qualifier after the word; the
  referent search after it; a subtype noun is the tribal target; a noun outside the table - `battle` - still unread);
  Assassin's Trophy aimed at p1's own Bears refused at the cast and at p2's Bears destroying them and asking p2 to
  search (D507's referent); Price of Freedom on p2's Forest (destroyed, the search declined at the reveal stage, then
  p1 draws); the replay hash on each. The fuzz: no new staple (a parser widening under an enforcement the targeting
  layer's own tests pin; the seam test is the pin).

### The wave — thirty-one rows, twelve spells

The select offered 47 rows whose whole leftover carried a controller-restricted target the macro reads now (enters counters and pumps on `creature you control`, bounces and destroys on `artifact or enchantment an opponent controls`, the animate-and-untap lands on `land you control`, a tap-and-freeze on `creature an opponent controls`, Demolition Field's destroy beside its two searches); the row maker rowed 31 and refused 16 by its own reasons (four copy-spell payloads - Rootha, Mirrorpool, Naru Meha, Nivix Guildmage; two combat-only scoped shields - Ebony Horse, Elvish Scout; two clauses with no fixture - Avalanche Caller's snow land, Sea Drake's counted lands; Dual Casting's quoted body, Hope-Ender Coatl's payer, Masked Vandal's payment branch, Mobile Garrison's Vehicle attack head, Silvanus's Invoker's ability word, Witch Enchanter's layout, Fey Steed's head, Geistblast's any-target line); the generator built all 31 - 31 suites, 73 tests, green on the first port. Sixteen rows join the ledger with their reasons; three spells retire (their artifact-or-land destroy reads now). The fuzz: no staple for the seam itself (a parser widening under an enforcement the targeting layer's own tests pin), but the first gate run fell on D508's `handPuts` floor - 0 over 3,000 seeds (2 at D508's gate): the driver plays a land the moment it draws one, so a put with something to put is a coincidence of two lands drawn together (7 Grazer entries and 21 Walking Atlas activations over 20 seeds put nothing), and the driver's hand pool offered the whole hand to a land put (a refused answer). The floor is the CLAUSE now: the executor names a hand put it ran with an empty `PutFromHand` marker when nothing is admitted (D505's `ScopeWalked` with no members), `handPutClauses` counts them (42 over 60 seeds, canary509d.out), `handPutAsks` the questions, `handPuts` the cards; the fuel is Arboreal Grazer and Walking Atlas, two a seat; the driver answers a hand put through `handChoiceCandidates`. The same run turned five shipped spell scripts' suppression pins red (Bite Down, Demolish, Hard-Hitting Question, Master's Rebuke, Victorious Destruction - the controller word reads them whole now): retired (retire509b.cjs), `SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,838 -> 7,833 before the gate re-ran.

### Traps

- **ADMIT A WORD ONLY WHERE THE TARGETING LAYER ENFORCES IT** (D139, D289, D407 - and now for a word on every
  noun). The controller word could go on the macro because `specAdmits` refuses a candidate of the wrong controller
  for every kind, the stack included; a word the target parser leaves in `unenforced` must stay out of the macro, or
  a card reads whole over a restriction nothing checks.
- **A SUBTYPE NOUN IS ALREADY IN THE TABLE.** `target Saga an opponent controls` reads through D479's tribal marker;
  a negative reading test must use a noun the table truly lacks (`battle`).
- **THE FAMILY READER OVERCOUNTS; THE YIELD PROBE COUNTS.** 684 sole-line cards carried a controller-restricted
  target; 40 read once the word was admitted. Measure the yield by re-parsing, never by the family's presence.
- **A FUZZ FLOOR MUST BE FUEL THE DRIVER ACTUALLY BURNS.** D508's floor was 2 puts over 3,000 seeds - a coincidence,
  not a proof: the driver plays every land it draws, so a hand put resolves over a landless hand. Count the clause
  (an empty marker says it ran) and pick fuel the driver casts and activates on its own (a one-drop with the clause on
  its entry, a colourless tap); measure the fuel per seed before pinning (a 20-seed run, the canary), never trust a 2.
- **GREP THE SHIPPED SPELL SCRIPTS BEFORE THE GATE.** A parser widening reads spells the scripts still carry; their
  suppression pins go red at the gate (five here). The retire tool first, then the gate.

## D510 — THE UNTAP CHOICE, THE MASS CAN'T-BLOCK AND THE WHEEL: three bounded seams with a spell yield, bundled (2026-09-20)

**11,983 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,959
(+24: 16 spells by the parser alone - Frantic Search, Snap, Rewind, Unwind, Timetwister, Time Reversal, Echo of Eons, Time Spiral, Falter, Seismic Stomp, Magmatic Chasm, Tectonic Rift, Fire of Orthanc, Sundering Eruption // Volcanic Fissure, Order // Chaos, Destructive Tampering - and 8 rows - Cloud of Faeries, Great Whale, Peregrine Drake, Seismic Elemental, Treachery, Palinchron, Champion of Rhonas, Grafted Growth; the probe diff is the 24, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,833 → **7,841**. The REFUSED ledger 1,837 → **1,831** (+1: Midnight Clock, by the row maker's own reason - a trigger payload outside the row kinds (an hour counter on the artifact); -7: Rewind, Snap, Time Reversal, Time Spiral, Timetwister, Unwind and Echo of Eons retired by exact line - the three seams read them whole now). Fixtures 8,861 →
**8,876**. `scriptableToday` 1,921 → **1,915**; the ladder `[1915, 1929, 3223, 4697, 5850]`. Bot reach **4,931** from **381**.
A mechanical wave of three bounded seams on Opus 5, each with a precedent in the tree (D390's queue, D505's walk,
D501's shuffle), built the D168 way: the seams, seven proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose them — the whole leftover is flat; three sentences with a spell yield and staples on them

The row maker over every line-only leftover card (19,126; `d510/rows510-all.log`) rowed 5, three of them ledgered
(Champion of Rhonas and Grafted Growth the other two - rowed beside this wave); the yield probe's top shapes are the
riders it does not peel (D507's artifact) and then `Any player may activate this ability` 19 (payloads outside the row
kinds), the Ring 9 (Fable's), and a run of small sentences. Measured by the family reader (`d510/measure510.cjs`, sole
unread lines): `Untap up to N lands` 8 (Frantic Search, Snap, Rewind, Peregrine Drake, Cloud of Faeries, Treachery, Time
Spiral, Unwind), `Creatures (without flying) can't block this turn` 14 (7 the flying form), the wheel 5 (Timetwister,
Time Reversal, Echo of Eons, Time Spiral, Day's Undoing) - three sentences, one wave.

### The seams (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/engine/handlers.ts`, `src/bot/awaiting.ts`)

- **THE UNTAP CHOICE** (`untapChoice.test.ts`). `Untap up to N lands.` / `You untap up to six lands.` is the queue's fifth
  verb (`untap`, D390's shape): the caster alone is asked to choose up to N permanents the noun admits - ANY controller's
  (CR: any lands; an untapped pick a legal no-op, so the candidates are every match) - and they untap in one
  `PermanentsUntapped`; the prompt carries `min` 0 (`PendingAsks.optional`, threaded through `queueAsks` and
  `advanceAsks`), and a board with no more than N candidates goes whole and unasked (the queue's rule). The bot picks
  its tapped ones (an optional battlefield choice is this verb's). Proven: the readings (the `you control` form left
  unread - not printed on the shape); Snap on p2's Bears with four tapped lands (the bounce, then the ask with `min` 0
  and the land filter; two chosen untap, the rest stay; a creature and three picks refused); declined; Frantic Search's
  two questions in order (the discard, then the untap); the replay hash on each.
- **THE MASS CAN'T-BLOCK** (`massCantBlock.test.ts`). `Creatures (without flying | with flying) can't block this turn.` is
  the `cantBlock` rider over every creature the scope reaches (D505's `BoardScope`, the keyword-absent form), planned
  aimless (`self: true`, the kind outside `SELF_AIMED`), the marker `ScopeWalked` with verb `massCantBlock` first.
  Proven: the readings (the three forms; `Nonartifact creatures` left unread); Falter with a Bears and an Angel on each
  side (the Bears cannot block, the Angels can, the walk counts two); the replay hash.
- **THE WHEEL INTO THE LIBRARY** (`wheelShuffle.test.ts`). `Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their
  library, then draws N cards.` (the `you` form scopes the caster alone): every player in APNAP order - the hand and the
  graveyard into the library, one shuffle each off the seeded generator (the RNG rides the batch as D501's shuffle fate
  does), N drawn off the shuffled order; the marker `WheelShuffled` per player. Proven: the readings; Timetwister with a
  stocked graveyard on each side (fresh sevens, empty graveyards, the libraries hold the rest, Timetwister itself in
  p1's graveyard after resolving - it left the stack after the wheel); the replay hash.
- **THE FUZZ.** `untapChoices` (an `AsksResolved` with the untap verb), `massCantBlocks` (the walk's marker), `wheels`
  (the marker per player); Snap, Falter and Timetwister two a seat (4 / 6 / 16 over the first 60 seeds - Time Reversal at
  five mana wheeled nobody, `canary510.out`), floors above zero pinned on all three.

### The wave — eight rows, sixteen spells

The select offered 7 rows whose whole leftover was one of the three sentences (the five enters-untap creatures and Auras - Cloud of Faeries, Peregrine Drake, Great Whale, Palinchron, Treachery; Seismic Elemental's enters can't-block; Midnight Clock's hour counter); the row maker rowed 6 and refused Midnight Clock (a payload outside the row kinds), and the whole-leftover row maker's two (Champion of Rhonas's exert put, Grafted Growth's Aura) rode beside them; the generator built all 8 - 8 suites, 18 tests, green on the second port (the first staged exactly N lands and never saw the question). One row joins the ledger with its reason; seven spells retire (the seams read them whole now). The fuzz: Snap, Falter and Timetwister join the rotating staples (two a seat) and read 4 untap choices, 6 mass can't-blocks and 16 wheels over 60 seeds (fuzz60-510, canary510b.out - Time Reversal at five mana wheeled nobody and was swapped for Timetwister); the hand-put clauses 55; seeds 0-59 are the gate first sixty, so the three floors above zero hold by construction.

### Traps

- **A `let` DECLARED IN THE FIRE IS OUT OF THE ASSERTS' SCOPE - STILL** (D508's lesson, met again). The untap choice's
  staged lands are RE-FOUND in the asserts (the tapped basics on p1's side), never carried by name from the fire.
- **AN `UP TO` QUEUE ASKS ONLY WITH MORE THAN N CANDIDATES.** The queue's rule (a board with no more than N goes whole
  and unasked) is right for a sacrifice and benevolent for an untap, and a suite that stages exactly N lands never sees
  the question: stage N+1, answer N, read the one past the count still tapped.
- **A MASS RIDER IS PLANNED AIMLESS WITH `self: true`.** A scoped clause with `self: false` and no target is planned as
  a missing aim and skipped; D505's mass verbs set `self: true` for a kind outside `SELF_AIMED`, and so does this one.

## D511 — BOLSTER: the queue's sixth verb, with computed candidates (2026-09-20)

**11,997 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,983
(+14: 7 spells by the parser alone - Map the Wastes, Honor's Reward, Abzan Advantage, Cached Defenses, Pinion Feast, Enduring Victory, Dromoka's Gift - and 7 rows - Abzan Skycaptain, Aven Tactician, Dromoka Captain, Echoes of the Kin Tree, Sandcrafter Mage, Sandsteppe Mastodon, Sandsteppe Scavenger; the probe diff is the 14, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,841 → **7,848**. The REFUSED ledger 1,831 → **1,830** (+2: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit (a bolster under a head the staged creature would fire - the generator's reason) and Dromoka, the Eternal (`Whenever a Dragon you control attacks` - a head the library lacks); -3: Honor's Reward, Pinion Feast and Enduring Victory retired by exact line - the tie is the queue's ask now, not a script-raised prompt). Fixtures 8,876 →
**8,887**. `scriptableToday` 1,915 → **1,914**; the ladder `[1914, 1928, 3222, 4697, 5850]`. Bot reach **4,945** from **381**.
One bounded seam on Opus 5 with a precedent in the tree (D390's queue, D510's `optional` and `amount` riders on
`PendingAsks`), built the D168 way: the seam, four proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — the whole leftover is flat; one keyword action with a spell yield and a staple on it

The family reader over the D510 true leftover (`d510/measure510.cjs` and the D511 family probe, sole unread lines)
put `Bolster N` at 20 sole-line / 23 touched (Map the Wastes, Honor's Reward, Abzan Advantage, Dromoka the Eternal,
Anafenza, Sandsteppe War Riders, Dromoka Captain, Cached Defenses, Pinion Feast, Echoes of the Kin Tree, Enduring
Victory, Dragonscale General, Sandsteppe Mastodon, Scale Blessing ...) - a keyword action (CR 701.37) whose only
question is a tie among the caster's least-toughness creatures; the additional combat phase (15 sole / 29 touched)
is the next seam and the turn loop's. The whole-leftover row maker (19,102 line-only rows, `d511/rows511-all.log`)
rowed the three it always rows (Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Urtet - ledgered generator refusals) and nothing else: the
tail is flat, and this wave is the bolster family alone.

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/engine/handlers.ts`, `src/bot/awaiting.ts`)

- **BOLSTER** (`bolster.test.ts`). `Bolster N.` is `bolster` with `amount` N, planned aimless (`self: true`): the
  queue's sixth verb, and the first whose candidates are COMPUTED rather than read off a noun -
  `leastToughnessCreatures(state, deps, player)` (every creature the player controls whose toughness is the least among
  them, under layers). One candidate is chosen unasked, none does nothing (said - "no creature to bolster"), a tie is
  asked of the caster alone through `queueAsks` with `amount` riding `PendingAsks` into `askBatch`; the prompt says
  `pick: 'leastToughness'` (a printed rule, never ids - the host validates the answer against the same computation),
  and the chosen creature gets N +1/+1 counters in one `CountersChanged`. The marker `Bolstered` (player, card or null,
  amount) is written on EVERY path - the asked, the sole and the empty one - because the unasked paths raise no
  `AsksResolved` and a clause that ran must be countable. The harness answers the tie with the computed set's first;
  the bot picks its least-toughness creature (the prompt's `pick`). Proven: the readings (the count; `Bolster X` and
  the `, then` form left unread); Cached Defenses with a Bears and an Angel (the Bears alone is least and gets three
  counters unasked); with two Bears (the tie asked, the Angel refused as an answer, the chosen Bears gets the counters
  and the other none); Honor's Reward with no creature (the life first, then nothing, said); the replay hash on each.
- **THE FUZZ.** `bolsters` (a `Bolstered` marker per clause); Cached Defenses and Abzan Advantage two a seat (4 over the first 60 seeds, canary511 - 1 with Cached Defenses alone over 20);
  the floor above zero pinned.

### The wave — seven rows, seven spells

The select offered 9 rows whose whole leftover was a bolster line (the four enters bolsters - Aven Tactician, Sandcrafter Mage, Sandsteppe Mastodon, Sandsteppe Scavenger; Abzan Skycaptain's dies; Dromoka Captain's attacks; Echoes of the Kin Tree's sorcery-speed activation; Anafenza's another-creature-enters; Dromoka, the Eternal's Dragon-attacks); the row maker rowed 7 and refused two by name (Dromoka, the Eternal - a head the library lacks; Anafenza - the generator's own refusal, a head the staged Goblin's entering would fire); the whole-leftover row maker (19,102 line-only rows, `d511/rows511-all.log`) rowed the three it always rows (Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Urtet - ledgered generator refusals) and nothing else; the generator built all 7 - 7 suites, 14 tests, green on the first port. Two rows join the ledger with their reasons; three spells retire (the seam reads them whole now). The generator (`d511/gen211-bolster.cjs`): two Raging Goblins are dealt on p1's side and one is
staged onto the battlefield before the fire (a 1/1 - always among the least toughness; the hand and the board
baselines re-measured after it), the fire stops at the prompt or settles, a prompt with the printed pick is answered
with the Goblin, and its +1/+1 counters read N; a head a p1 creature's entering would fire (Anafenza's
`anotherCreatureEnters`) is refused by name, because the staging itself would run the bolster once before the fire.

### Traps

- **A QUEUE VERB THAT NEVER ASKS STILL NEEDS ITS MARKER.** The sole-candidate and the empty paths of a queued verb raise
  no `AsksResolved`; a fuzz counter or a test on the ask alone reads them as "never ran". `Bolstered` is written on
  every path (the null-card form for the empty one) and is what the fuzz and the suites count.
- **A PRE-FIRE STAGING HIDES THE FIRE'S LEADING PUT.** The vocab pre-fire staging is prepended to a trigger's fire, so
  D424's `remeasureHand` (the hand re-measured after a fire whose FIRST statement puts a fixture) no longer saw the
  fire's own leading put once a staging stood in front of it - since D508's hand-put staging. The fire is re-measured
  on its own first, then the staging goes in front (`gen-oneshot211.cjs`).
- **A STAGED CREATURE FIRES THE ENTERS HEADS.** A Goblin staged onto p1's battlefield before the fire is itself a
  creature entering: a bolster under `anotherCreatureEnters` would run once before the fire and the assert would read
  N+1. The generator refuses those heads by name (Anafenza ledgered) rather than staging into them.
- **A GENERATED BLOCK'S LOCAL MUST NOT BE AN ARMED NAME.** `armed()`'s destructure is built from every armed variable
  the asserts mention (`gob` is the mentor Goblin's); a block-local `const gob` in the asserts pulled a name the arm
  never returned into the destructure (a `tsc` error, not a wrong test). Block locals take names outside the armed set.

## D512 — THE ADDITIONAL COMBAT PHASE: the turn loop's seam beside the extra turn (2026-09-20)

**12,003 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 11,997
(+6: 4 spells by the parser alone - Relentless Assault, Seize the Day, Response // Resurgence, Fury of the Horde - and 2 rows - Aggravated Assault, Hellkite Charger; the probe diff is the 6, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,848 → **7,850**. The REFUSED ledger 1,830 → **1,833** (+4: Aurelia, the Warleader and Raphael, Tag Team Tough (`for the first time each turn` heads the library lacks), Éomer, Marshal of Rohan (a filtered head with an adjective outside the closed reader - `attacking`), Full Throttle (`two additional combat phases`); -1: Seize the Day retired by exact line - the seam reads it whole now). Fixtures 8,887 →
**8,892**. `scriptableToday` 1,914 → **1,917**; the ladder `[1917, 1931, 3224, 4699, 5852]`. Bot reach **4,945** from **381**.
One bounded seam on Opus 5 with a precedent in the tree (D502's extra turn - the turn loop consuming a queue the
executor filled), built the D168 way: the seam, four proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — the whole leftover is flat; one turn-structure sentence with a spell yield and a staple on it

The family reader over the D511 true leftover (sole unread lines) put `additional combat phase` at 19 sole-line / 24
touched (Relentless Assault, Aggravated Assault, Aurelia, Seize the Day, Fury of the Horde, Hellkite Charger, Scourge
of the Throne, Combat Celebrant, Godo, Karlach, Port Razer ...) - the turn loop's seam beside D502's extra turn (CR
500.8: phases added directly after the specified phase, the most recently created first). The whole-leftover row maker
(19,088 line-only rows, `d512/rows512-all.log`) rowed the three it always rows (Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Urtet -
ledgered generator refusals) and nothing else: the tail is flat, and this wave is the family alone. Most of the family
is gated by OTHER seams - the `for the first time each turn` heads (Aurelia, Godo, Raphael, Scourge of the Throne), the
`if it's the first combat phase of the turn` condition (Finest Hour, Raiyuu, Karlach, Hexplate Wallbreaker, Genji
Glove), the can't-attack-again statics (Port Razer, Bloodthirster) - so the yield is the four spells and the two rows.

### The seam (`src/engine/turn.ts`, `src/engine/loop.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/data/effectParse.ts`)

- **THE ADDITIONAL COMBAT PHASE** (`extraCombat.test.ts`). `After this main phase, there is an additional combat phase
  followed by an additional main phase.` is `extraCombat` with `extraPhases: ['combat', 'main']` after `main`; `After
  this (combat) phase, there is an additional combat phase.` is `['combat']` after `current` (the phase the clause
  resolves in - a combat phase, else the next main phase). The executor pushes an entry on `TurnState.extraPhases`
  (`ExtraPhasesAdded`, said out loud). `nextStep` consults the queue at every phase end (a main step or `endCombat`):
  the pending entries added after this kind of phase are prepended to `insertedPhases` in creation order (so the most
  recently created runs first, CR 500.8), the head begins - a combat at `beginCombat`, a main phase as a postcombat main
  (CR 505.1a) - and the regular step that would have followed is remembered once (`resumeStep`); an inserted phase
  whose end finds the queue empty hands the turn back to that step (`ExtraPhasesConsumed` records the queue before
  every such `StepBegan`). A combat inserted after the precombat main runs BEFORE the regular combat; one added during
  an inserted phase runs before the resume. `Untap all creatures that attacked this turn.` is a mass untap over a scope
  that reads the turn record (`attackedThisTurn`, `TurnMemory.attackerIds`). The compound `Untap all attacking
  creatures and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.` (Hellkite Charger, Combat Celebrant) is ONE
  clause - the mass untap with the phase riding it (`extraPhases` on the massUntap spec) - so a payment body (`If you
  do, ...`, one sentence by D369's rule) reads it whole; the rider fires whatever the walk found. Proven: the readings
  (the two forms, the compound as one clause and inside a payment, the attacked-this-turn scope; `two additional
  combat phases` and the first-combat condition left unread); Relentless Assault in the postcombat main after the Bears
  attacked (the Bears untaps, a second combat follows and it attacks again, a second postcombat main, then the end
  step; the pending entry consumed, the queue empty, the next turn as ever); the same spell in the precombat main (the
  inserted combat and main come before the regular combat - the whole step list of the turn pinned); two Relentless
  Assaults in one main phase (three combats, three postcombat mains - the third asks nothing of a tapped Bears); the
  replay hash on each.
- **THE FUZZ.** `extraCombats` (an `ExtraPhasesAdded` per clause), `insertedPhases` (an `ExtraPhasesConsumed` with a
  resume step per inserted phase begun); Seize the Day and Relentless Assault two a seat (2 clauses / 3 inserted phases over the first 60 seeds, canary512 - Relentless Assault alone was cast by nobody over 20); floors above zero.

### The wave — two rows, four spells

The select offered 6 whose whole leftover was an additional-combat line (Aggravated Assault's sorcery-speed activation; Hellkite Charger's attack trigger with its price; Aurelia's and Raphael's first-time-each-turn heads; Éomer's attacking-legendary die head; Full Throttle's two phases); the row maker rowed 2 and refused four by name (two first-time heads the library lacks, a filtered head with an adjective outside the list, a spell with two additional combat phases); the whole-leftover row maker (19,088 line-only rows, `d512/rows512-all.log`) rowed the three it always rows (Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Urtet - ledgered generator refusals) and nothing else; the generator built both - 2 suites, 5 tests, green on the first port. Four cards join the ledger with their reasons; one spell retires (the seam reads it whole now). The generator (`d512/gen212-extra.cjs`) asserts the clause's marker with its phases, reads the
compound's rider on a mass untap in a payment branch off the walk's marker (`ScopeWalked` iff paid), and proves the
phase itself by a walk to the next turn's upkeep LAST of all (the fire turn began one combat more per clause, nothing
pending into the next turn); a conditional fire, a delayed form and a scope read off the turn record are refused by name.

### Traps

- **A COMPOUND'S RIDER STAYS ON ITS CLAUSE.** Splitting `... and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase`
  into two sentences (the `, then proliferate` precedent) would have carried the phase OUT of a payment body - D369
  reads one sentence after `If you do,` - so Hellkite Charger's phase would have come whether the price was paid or not.
  The phase rides the mass untap's spec (D399's rider shape) and the executor fires it beside the walk.
- **THE FIRST MATCHING RULE'S NULL BUILD ENDS THE MATCH.** `matchRule` returns null when the first regex that matches
  builds nothing, so a rule more specific than another whose regex would swallow its tail (`[^.]+?` takes `... and after
  this phase, there is an additional combat phase` for a scope) must stand BEFORE it in the table.
- **A WALK TO A PROMPT OVERSHOOTS A COMBAT WITH NOTHING TO DECLARE.** A combat whose active player has no creature able
  to attack raises no `declareAttackers` prompt (the no-prompt-with-nothing-to-decide rule), so `advanceUntil(... awaiting
  declareAttackers)` walks into the NEXT turn's combat and reads that board. Walk to the step, and read `combat.attackers`.

## D513 — THE FIRST-TIME-EACH-TURN HEAD: the once-per-turn gate as a head's suffix (2026-09-21)

**12,013 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,003
(+10: 10 rows - Emberheart Challenger, Aurelia, the Warleader, Attended Healer, Vanguard Seraph, Fear of Missing Out, Mouse Trapper, Cleric of Life's Bond, Seedglaive Mentor, Vengeful Warchief, Whiskerquill Scribe; the probe diff is the 10, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,850 → **7,860**. The REFUSED ledger 1,833 → **1,831** (-15: the nine rows that landed (Aurelia, Emberheart Challenger, Attended Healer, Vanguard Seraph, Mouse Trapper, Cleric of Life's Bond, Seedglaive Mentor, Vengeful Warchief, Whiskerquill Scribe) and six whose stale reason named the first-time head (Deathless Knight, Veteran Guardmouse, Valiant Rescuer, Axgard Artisan, Raphael, Whispering Snitch), retired by exact line; +13: those six rejoin with the row maker's current reason (a graveyard-zone head, a pump with a scry beside it, a first-time head with no turn record - cycling, a counters-put head, an attacking scope with no witness, a surveil head) beside Whiskervale Forerunner, Jetting and Shimmering Glasskite, Scourge of the Throne, Erdwal Illuminator, Leech Collector, Mindlink Mech). Fixtures 8,892 →
**8,902**. `scriptableToday` 1,917 → **1,908**; the ladder `[1908, 1922, 3215, 4690, 5843]`. Bot reach **4,948** from **382**.
A row-maker seam on Opus 5 with a precedent in the tree (D492's once-per-turn gate at the bus, enforced since; no engine
change), built the D168 way: the peel, the exact matchers, four proofs on the landed rows' own scripts, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — the whole leftover is flat; one suffix over twenty heads

The family reader over the D512 true leftover (sole unread lines) put `for the first time each turn` at 20 sole-line /
19 touched - a suffix on heads the library mostly holds (`attacks`, `becomes the target of a spell or ability`, `you
gain life`, `you lose life`, `is dealt damage`) and on Valiant's `becomes the target of a spell or ability you control`,
which it lacked. The whole-leftover row maker (19,082 line-only rows, `d513/rows513-all.log`) rowed 13 with the peel in
place - the three it always rows and ten of the family - and the select offered nothing at all (the family had been
ledgered, or its heads are outside the classifier's list): the D424 way found the wave the classifier could not.

### The seam (`d513/make-rows213.cjs`, `d513/gen-oneshot213.cjs`; `firstTimeEachTurn.test.ts`)

- **THE PEEL.** `Whenever <subject> <verb> for the first time each turn, <payload>` is the head without the suffix with
  D492's once-per-turn gate on the def (`oncePerTurn`, enforced at the bus: the first event of the turn triggers it and
  later ones do not); a batched subject under the suffix is the singular head, as under the rider. About the source
  itself the gate is EXACT - a creature cannot have attacked or been targeted before it existed. The two player heads
  with a turn record, `you gain life` and `you lose life`, carry an exact matcher beside the gate (`youGainLifeFirstTime`
  / `youLoseLifeFirstTime`, `looksBack`: the record BEFORE the event says whether the player already gained or lost
  life this turn, whether or not the source was there to see it; two gains in one batch both match and the gate keeps
  one). Any other player head under the suffix (cycling, surveilling, investigating - no turn record) is refused by name
  rather than approximated. `becomesTargetedByYou` is Valiant's head - the by-opponent head's mirror, fired by p1's own
  Giant Growth like the plain form, the spell half and the ability half two defs on one line.
- **THE PROOFS** (`firstTimeEachTurn.test.ts`, on the landed rows' own scripts). The defs carry the gate and the life
  heads look back; Aurelia attacking in the regular combat of turn 5 fires once and adds a combat (D512's seam), attacking
  again in the inserted combat fires nothing (two combats, not three), and her next turn fires again; Vanguard Seraph is
  asked once for two gains in one turn and NOT asked for a gain after one it did not see (it left and returned between
  them - the gate alone would have fired); Vengeful Warchief's one counter for two losses; the replay hash on each.

- **THE FUZZ.** No new counter - the rows ride the per-seed pools. But the gate went red once: the Onulet floor (`diesTriggers`,
  D158/D175 - the one trigger that looks back) read 0 over the 500 seeds, its first red since D175, after 60-seed canaries
  of 2 / 2 / 0 / 1 / 0 across D510-D513: the pools' kill density decays as the scripted names grow. The staple carries
  its own killer now (five Doom Blades a seat beside the five Onulets - a Bolt would double-count FIXED_CORE's; 2 over 60
  seeds, fuzz60-513d), and the D512 pair went to three a seat (0 over 60 after the rotation moved; 6 clauses / 12 phases
  with three).

### The wave — ten rows, no spells

The select offered NOTHING (the family had been ledgered or never offered - its heads are outside the classifier's list); the whole-leftover row maker (19,082 line-only rows, `d513/rows513-all.log`) rowed 13 with the peel in place: the three it always rows (Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Urtet - ledgered generator refusals) and ten of the family - three self heads (Aurelia's attack, Fear of Missing Out's delirium attack, the Valiant heads of Emberheart Challenger, Mouse Trapper, Seedglaive Mentor, Whiskerquill Scribe) and the life heads (Attended Healer, Vanguard Seraph, Cleric of Life's Bond, Vengeful Warchief); the generator built all ten - 10 suites, 34 tests, green on the first port. Thirteen cards of the family join the ledger with their reasons; fifteen stale entries retire (nine landed, six re-reasoned).

### Traps

- **THE SELECT'S OFFER IS NOT THE MEASUREMENT.** The classifier offered nothing while the whole-leftover row maker rowed
  ten: a family ledgered under an older reason, or whose heads the classifier's list lacks, never reaches `batch.json`.
  The D424 run over every line-only row is the measurement; the select is one reader of it.
- **A FIRST-TIME HEAD IS EXACT ONLY WHERE THE RECORD ANSWERS.** The gate counts what the source saw; a player head with no
  turn record would fire on a later event after an earlier one the source missed. The life heads read the record; the
  rest are refused by name.
- **A FLOOR'S FUEL DECAYS AS THE POOLS GROW.** A canary staple with no killer of its own (Onulet, five a seat since D175)
  dies less each decision as the rotating names dilute the pools' removal: 2 / 2 / 0 / 1 / 0 over the 60-seed canaries,
  then 0 over a 500-seed gate. A floor's staple carries what its counter needs (Doom Blade beside Onulet), never borrows
  it from the rotation; and a killer already in FIXED_CORE cannot be a staple (the accounting is exact).

## D514 — THE OBJECT'S STAT AS LAST KNOWN: a creature's toughness read where the sentence finds it (2026-09-22)

**12,023 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,013
(+10: 3 spells by the parser alone - Sheltering Word, Heal the Scars, Vraska's Stoneglare - and 7 rows - Brightmare, Verdant Sun's Avatar, Wolverine Riders, Ambuscade Shaman, Orchard Warden, Engulfing Slagwurm, Angelic Chorus; the probe diff is the 10, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,860 → **7,867**. The REFUSED ledger 1,831 → **1,844** (+14: the family's cards the row maker refused by its own reasons - the dies heads with no memo of the dying creature's stat (Proper Burial, South Wind Avatar, Grim Feast), the combat-damage head's item (Ikra Shidiqi), the asks' chosen creature (Doomgape, Tribute to Hunger, Consuming Vapors), Trostani's populate (the suite cannot assert it), Righteous Valkyrie's condition, Death Watch's two referents, Noxious Gearhulk's conditional, Paladin of Atonement's second head, Abattoir Ghoul's filtered head, Garruk's battle clause; -2: Heal the Scars and Vraska's Stoneglare retired by exact line - the seam reads them whole now). Fixtures 8,902 →
**8,911**. `scriptableToday` 1,908 → **1,907**; the ladder `[1907, 1921, 3213, 4688, 5841]`. Bot reach **4,956** from **382**.
One bounded seam on Opus 5 with precedents in the tree (D392's referent, D494's previous objects, D504's `known`),
built the D168 way: the rule, the possessive referent, the executor's read, three proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — the whole leftover is flat; one sentence over twenty-seven cards

The sole-line shapes over the D513 true leftover (`d513/shapes513.cjs`: 9,741 rows in 9,047 shapes - the top ones the
quoted-ability grants of Backgrounds, Auras and Slivers, then cascade, banding, myriad) left `You gain life equal to
that creature's toughness` the largest sentence with an engine seam of its own: 15 sole-line / 27 touched (Sheltering
Word, Heal the Scars, Angelic Chorus, Verdant Sun's Avatar, Proper Burial, Orchard Warden, Trostani, Wolverine Riders,
South Wind Avatar, Grim Feast, Ikra Shidiqi, Engulfing Slagwurm, Tribute to Hunger, Doomgape ...). The whole-leftover
row maker (19,072 line-only rows, `d514/rows514-all.log`) rowed 10 once the possessive referent reached the item path;
the select offered 2 of them.

### The seam (`src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`; `lkiStat.test.ts`)

- **THE RULE.** `You gain life equal to target creature's (power|toughness).` is `gainLifeStat` (`stat` on the spec) -
  a creature-only phrase, never the general target macro: `target opponent` would have matched it through the referent
  and aimed a stat read at a player. `Gain life equal to ...` is the optional trigger's peeled form.
- **THE POSSESSIVE REFERENT.** `... its toughness.` / `... that creature's toughness.` after a target clause is D392's
  referent with an apostrophe-s: `REFERENT_STAT` hands `referentRewrite` the previous phrase as the stat's owner, and
  the clause shares the previous target (a player phrase does not match the rule, so `Target opponent sacrifices a
  creature ... that creature's toughness` stays unread - the ask's chosen creature is a later seam). Under an item head
  the row maker's rewrite does the same (`ITS_STAT`, admitted beside `ANY_REF`, which excludes the apostrophe forms).
- **THE READ.** The executor derives the aimed creature's stat where it finds it: on the battlefield after the clauses
  before it (`now` - a pump before the read counts), or, once it has left, off the state before this resolution
  (`state` - CR 608.2h's last known information: the destroyed creature's toughness). A negative number is zero (CR
  107.1b); a target that stopped being a creature has no stat, and the clause says so. The marker `StatRead` (card,
  stat, value, `lastKnown`) sits beside the `LifeChanged`. Proven: the readings; Sheltering Word on a Bears (+2, read
  live) and on a Bears with two +1/+1 counters (+4); the executor on a real stack object with the destroy-then-read text
  (the Angel in the graveyard, the read last known, +4) and the pump-then-read text (+7, read live); the replay hash.
- **THE FUZZ.** `statReads` (the marker) and `lastKnownReads` (the marker with `lastKnown`); Sheltering Word two a seat
  (7 stat reads over the first 60 seeds with three a seat, fuzz60-514b - 2 with two; no last-known read in the pools); the floor on the reads above zero (the last-known read has no cheap spell and is the executor test's).

### The wave — seven rows, three spells

The select offered 2 (Brightmare, Engulfing Slagwurm); the whole-leftover row maker (19,072 line-only rows, `d514/rows514-all.log`) rowed 10 with the possessive referent admitted to the item path: the three it always rows (Goblin Engineer, Ayula, Urtet - ledgered generator refusals) and seven of the family - the enters heads (Angelic Chorus, Verdant Sun's Avatar, Wolverine Riders, Orchard Warden's optional form), Brightmare's targeted tap, Engulfing Slagwurm's destroy-then-read on the blocked creature (the stat as last known), and Ambuscade Shaman, which the new item head unlocked beside them; the generator built all seven - 7 suites, 15 tests, green on the first port. Fourteen cards of the family join the ledger with their reasons; two spells retire (the seam reads them whole now). The tooling (`d514/gen214-stat*.cjs`): the item heads read `its (power|toughness)` and `that
creature's (power|toughness)` as the item's (the possessive is the referent when nothing else names one, and the row
maker's gate admits it beside `ANY_REF`); `this creature or another creature you control enters` is an item head (the
entering creature - the suite's fire puts the Bears); the harvester asks for the item forms of a peeled optional payload
(Orchard Warden's `you may gain life ...`); the generator sizes the life by the fixture's printed base (the stat as
last known when an earlier clause destroyed it, as it stands otherwise) and refuses a read on a fixture with no base.

### Traps

- **A GENERAL TARGET MACRO REACHES A PLAYER THROUGH THE REFERENT.** The referent rewrite hands a rule the previous
  phrase whatever it named: with `${TARGET}` in the stat rule, `Target opponent sacrifices ...` made `target opponent's
  toughness` an auto reading aimed at a player, and the executor would have stepped over it in silence. A rule whose
  amount is a creature's names the creature.
- **THE VOCAB PROBE IS A SNAPSHOT.** `vocab-ok.json` is the parser's answer at the time the probe ran: a parser widening
  after it leaves the row maker reading the old answer (Orchard Warden stayed unread through two runs). Re-collect the
  payload forms and re-run the probe after every parser change, before the row maker.
- **THE HARVESTER MUST ASK FOR EVERY FORM THE ROW MAKER LOOKS UP.** The row maker peels `you may` and then rewrites the
  item; the harvester asked for the peeled form and the item form, never the item form OF the peeled form.

## D515 — THE STAT FAMILY'S REMAINDER: the dying creature's number and the ask's chosen creature (2026-09-22)

**12,028 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,023
(+5: 1 spell by the parser alone - Tribute to Hunger - and 4 rows - Doomgape, Necropolis Regent, South Wind Avatar, Proper Burial; the probe diff is the 5, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,867 → **7,871**. The REFUSED ledger 1,844 → **1,846** (+7: Patron of the Vein (a payload acting on the creature that died), the five item referents under filtered combat-damage heads, Consuming Vapors (re-reasoned - its ask reads now, its rebound does not); -5: Doomgape, South Wind Avatar, Proper Burial, Tribute to Hunger retired by exact line (landed) and Consuming Vapors' old reason). Fixtures 8,911 →
**8,916**. `scriptableToday` 1,907 → **1,907**; the ladder `[1907, 1921, 3213, 4687, 5840]`. Bot reach **4,957** from **382**.
Two bounded seams on Opus 5 with precedents in the tree (D476's memo, D484's continuation, D494's previous objects),
bundled as D514's remainder and built the D168 way: the memo, the answered objects, five proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — D514's ledger, read back

D514 left the stat family's cards ledgered by three reasons: the dies heads (no memo of the dying creature's stat - a
graveyard card's printed values are not its last known ones), the asks (the sacrificed creature is the answer's, and the
resumed frame had no objects to bind), the combat-damage head (not an item head). The whole-leftover row maker
(19,062 line-only rows, `d515/rows515-all.log`) rowed 13 once the dies heads and the combat-damage head became item
heads - and the select offered nothing.

### The seams (`src/engine/effects.ts`, `src/engine/loop.ts`, `src/engine/scripts/api.ts`, `src/data/effectParse.ts`)

- **THE DYING CREATURE'S NUMBER** (`diesStat.test.ts`). A dies head looks back (CR 603.10a), so the bus matches it
  against the board the creature left - and a def whose payload reads the item's stat carries a `memo` of that stat,
  read there per item (D476's number, `(ctx, _self, _ev, item) => ctx.derive(item).toughness`). The stat read takes it
  for an aim that has left, ahead of the state before the resolution (which holds the graveyard card's printed values).
  The item is a REFERENT the head named, not a target: `ctx.vocabulary(..., unchecked)` skips CR 608.2b's re-check,
  which would drop a graveyard card. Proven on Proper Burial's landed script: a Bears with a +1/+1 counter dying gains
  three (a printed read would say two); an Angel after it, four more; the replay hash.
- **THE ASK'S CHOSEN CREATURE** (`askedStat.test.ts`). `Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. You gain
  life equal to that creature's toughness.` reads the possessive referent after a queued sacrifice as the `ofPrevious`
  stat read (the parser's `objectsRewrite`, before its refusal of asking clauses). `resumeContinuation` names what the
  answer sacrificed (`CardsMoved` with the sacrifice reason) and their stats as the answer found them - the board
  before its moves (`AnsweredObjects`) - and the resumed frame's first clause binds its previous objects to them; the
  stat read takes the recorded stat. Proven: the readings; Tribute to Hunger against a Bears with two +1/+1 counters
  beside an Angel (p2 asked, answers with the Bears; four life - the counters counted; the Bears in the graveyard);
  against an empty board (nothing sacrificed, nothing read, said); the replay hash on each.
- **NO FUZZ CHANGE.** The reads ride D514's counter; the rows ride the per-seed pools.

### The wave — four rows, one spell

The select offered nothing; the whole-leftover row maker (19,062 line-only rows, `d515/rows515-all.log`) rowed 13 with the dies heads and the combat-damage head as item heads - the three it always rows, the stat family's three (Doomgape's queued sacrifice, Proper Burial's and South Wind Avatar's dying creature) and seven the new item heads unlocked beside them; of those seven Necropolis Regent landed (the unfiltered combat-damage head), Patron of the Vein was refused (its payload exiles the card that died - a graveyard card is read this wave, never acted on) and five under FILTERED combat-damage heads (Impostor Syndrome, Exsanguinator Cavalry, Rakish Heir, Aveline de Grandpré, White Widow) were refused after their suites failed: under a filtered head the creature the event names is the filter's fixture, not the item head's; the generator built the four - 4 suites, 9 tests, green. Seven cards join the ledger with their reasons; five entries retire (four landed, one re-reasoned). The tooling (`d515/gen215-stat2.cjs`, `patch515-b.cjs`): the dies heads
(`creatureYouControlDies`, `anotherCreatureDies`, `aCreatureDies`, `anyOtherCreatureDies`) and `creatureCombatDamagePlayer`
are item heads (the dying creature; the creature that connected - `bearsB`, the Bears the fire attacks with); a looks-back
item head with a stat read emits the item memo and the `unchecked` vocabulary call, and admits only a payload that READS
the card; a filtered head keeps its own fan-out (D467's `perItemCode`) and its own fixture, so the item path is not
taken under one; a stat read about the queue's sacrificed fodder (Doomgape) is sized by the fodder's printed base.

### Traps

- **A DEAD ITEM IS A REFERENT, NOT A TARGET.** The item path aims the vocabulary at the item as a target, and CR 608.2b's
  re-check drops a card in the graveyard: Proper Burial's suite read forty life, its clause "no legal target left". A
  looks-back head's item goes to the vocabulary unchecked, and a payload that would ACT on the graveyard card (exile
  it) is refused until an executor case moves a card from where it is.
- **A FILTERED HEAD'S CREATURE IS THE FILTER'S FIXTURE.** `Whenever a Vampire you control deals combat damage to a
  player, put a +1/+1 counter on it`: the filtered path attacks with the filter's fixture (a Reaver) and fans out per
  source already; the item head's fixture (the Bears) is a different creature, and its fan-out a duplicate property.
  The item path is not taken under a filtered head this wave.
- **A ROW REFUSED AFTER A PORT LEAVES ITS FILES AND ITS REGISTRY LINES.** The port copies and lands; nothing unlands. Six
  rows generated, ported and then refused had to be removed by hand (the modules, the suites, two registry lines each,
  their WANTED names and a derived fodder) before the fixtures and the pin were right.

## D516 — THE ITEM UNDER A FILTERED HEAD, and the card that died acted on (2026-09-22)

**12,034 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,028
(+6: 6 rows - Impostor Syndrome, Patron of the Vein, Exsanguinator Cavalry, Rakish Heir, Aveline de Grandpré, White Widow, Yelena Belova; the probe diff is the 6, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,871 → **7,877**. The REFUSED ledger 1,846 → **1,841** (+1: Stalking Vengeance (the dead creature as a damage SOURCE - `it deals damage equal to its power` - its power last known; not this wave); -6: the five item referents under filtered combat-damage heads and Patron of the Vein, retired by exact line (landed)). Fixtures 8,916 →
**8,923**. `scriptableToday` 1,907 → **1,907**; the ladder `[1907, 1921, 3213, 4683, 5834]`. Bot reach **4,957** from **384**.
One bounded seam on Opus 5 with a precedent in the tree (D436's graveyard exile, D515's unchecked referent), bundled
with the tooling D515 measured for and built the D168 way: the executor case, three proofs, the rows.

### The measurement chose it — D515's ledger, read back

D515 left six cards ledgered by two reasons: five item referents under FILTERED combat-damage heads (the filtered path
attacks with the filter's fixture and fans out per source; the item head's fixture was another creature) and Patron of
the Vein (its payload exiles the card that died - a graveyard card was read that wave, never acted on). The
whole-leftover row maker (19,057 line-only rows) rowed the six again once the item path opened under a filtered head -
and the select offered nothing.

### The seam (`src/engine/effects.ts`)

- **THE CARD THAT DIED, ACTED ON** (`diedExile.test.ts`). A looks-back head's item (D515's unchecked referent) is the
  card in its owner's graveyard - CR 400.7d, the trigger finds the card in the public zone it went to - and `exile`
  moves it from THERE: `moveTo` hardcodes `from: battlefield`, and the reducer's `removeFromZone` would have found
  nothing on the battlefield and left the graveyard array holding a card whose own zone said exile. A card that has
  left the graveyard before the trigger resolves is a new object (CR 400.7): nothing is exiled, and the line says so
  while the clause after it still runs. Proven on Patron of the Vein's landed script: the Bears its enters trigger
  destroys is exiled out of the graveyard (the zone arrays agree with the card; the move reads `from: graveyard`),
  both Vampires take their counter; the Bears taken back to hand while the trigger waits stays there, said, the
  counters still placed; the replay hash on each.
- **NO FUZZ CHANGE.** The move rides D436's shape; the rows ride the per-seed pools.

### The wave — six rows

The select offered nothing; the whole-leftover row maker (19,057 line-only rows, `d516/rows516-all.log`) rowed 9 with the item path open under a filtered head - the three it always rows and the six of D515's ledger: the five item referents under FILTERED combat-damage heads (Impostor Syndrome, Exsanguinator Cavalry, Rakish Heir, Aveline de Grandpré, White Widow) and Patron of the Vein (the card that died, exiled); the generator built the six - 6 suites, 13 tests, green after three generator fixes (the still fixtures reach the tests; the row's own dies head exiles the enters trigger's victim; the arm answers the enters trigger's targets). One card joins the ledger with its reason; six entries retire (landed). The tooling (`d516/patch516-tools.cjs`, `patch516-gen*.cjs`): the row maker's item gate admits
a FILTERED head where the generator can name its creature (D498's enters and block fires, the combat-damage fire's
still fixture - one source at a time, never the batched form - and the opponent's dies head's Cyclops); under a
filtered combat-damage head the row stamps the still fixture's suite variable (`itemVar`, first-seen order over the
row's still fixtures) and the base carries the fixture's printed p/t (`fixturePt`), so the item fixture IS the creature
the fire attacks with and the memo count is its printed power; the item refusal admits an `exile` under a looks-back
head; `armed` returns the still fixtures so the item asserts can read them; a destroy whose victim the row's own dies
head exiles is read in exile; the arm answers a row's own enters trigger's targets at the etb's fixture (the harness
would have picked the Cyclops the dies head's fire needs alive).

### Traps

- **A LATE-ENTERING ROW'S OWN ENTERS TRIGGER IS ANSWERED BY THE HARNESS.** For every test but the etb's, the arm moves the
  self onto the battlefield and the enters trigger fires there; the harness's `chooseTargets` answer is the FIRST
  legal target - the Cyclops - which Patron's second head then exiled before its own test could kill it (a card moved
  from exile to the graveyard by hand is no death: the head never fired). The arm now aims the etb where its test does.
- **A SECOND HEAD ON THE SAME CARD CHANGES WHERE THE FIRST HEAD'S VICTIM ENDS.** The enters destroy's suite read its
  victim in the graveyard; the dies head exiled it. A destroy whose victim the row's own looks-back item head exiles is
  read in exile (`exiledByDies`) - the two heads are one card, and the suite proves the card.
- **THE STILL FIXTURE WAS NEVER RETURNED.** D379's still fixtures were fire-only (a tap, an untap, an attack), so `armed`
  never returned them; the first item assert on `stillFix0` failed to compile. A fixture an assert reads must be
  returned, typed and in the `used` scan.

## D517 — THE SCOPED QUOTED GRANT: `<scope> have "<ability>"` as a row, with the commander scope and the land scope (2026-09-22)

**12,053 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,034
(+19: 18 rows - Zombie Master, Constricting Sliver, Lavabelly Sliver, Crypt Sliver, Harmonic Sliver, Screeching Sliver, Dormant Sliver, Capricious Sliver, Candlekeep Sage, The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale, Vile Consumption, Flaming Fist, Pendrell Mists, Poultice Sliver, Magus of the Tabernacle, Chromatic Lantern, Joiner Adept, Bootleggers' Stash; the probe diff is the 19 - the 18 rows and Zombie Master's second printing name - nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,877 → **7,895**. The REFUSED ledger 1,841 → **1,874** (+40: the scoped quoted grants' family by its reasons - the Backgrounds' unread bodies (Far Traveler, Haunted One, Shameless Charlatan, Popular Entertainer, Clan Crafter, Passionate Archaeologist, Noble Heritage, Inspiring Leader, Scion of Halaster, Veteran Soldier, Tavern Brawler, Hardy Outlander, Dragon Cultist, Cloakwood Hermit, Guild Artisan, Agent of the Iron Throne, Sword Coast Sailor, Folk Hero, Dungeon Delver, Feywild Visitor, Acolyte of Bahamut, Master Chef, Agent of the Shadow Thieves, Street Urchin), the Slivers' costs and bodies (Frenetic, Opaline, Mistform, Dementia, Mesmeric, Mindwhip, Taunting, Regal, Psionic, Vampiric, Fungus), the three suite shapes not proven (Plague Sliver, Spiteful Sliver, Magma Sliver re-reasoned), Dionus, Breath of Dreams; -7: Magma Sliver's D479 line and six landed Slivers' D367-era entries (Crypt, Harmonic, Screeching, Dormant, Capricious, Poultice - stale, found by the ledger's own staleness test)). Fixtures 8,923 →
**8,941**. `scriptableToday` 1,907 → **1,901**; the ladder `[1901, 1915, 3202, 4672, 5823]`. Bot reach **4,966** from **384**.
A tooling decision on Opus 5 with its engine already in the tree (D367/D368's grant carrier, D454/D456's attached
grant reader, D371's scoped anthem): no engine change - the row maker reads a shape the engine has run since D367,
and two scopes the grammar lacked.

### The measurement chose it — the sole-line shapes, read back

The whole-leftover row maker's tail is flat, and the top of the sole-line shape ranking (`d516/shapes516.cjs`) was
quoted grants over a scope: `Commander creatures you own have "…"` 25 (the Backgrounds), `All Slivers have "…"` 14,
`Sliver creatures you control have "…"` 6, `Lands you control have "…"` 3, `All creatures have "…"` 4 - 201 rows in all
whose line ends at `have`, 45 of them over a scope the anthem grammar already read. The attached shape
(`Enchanted creature has "…"`) has been a row since D454; the SCOPED one had only D367's one-off generator (the Slivers
of that decision) and no row kind. The measurement script (`d516/measure-grants516.cjs`) counted the bodies the
vocabulary reads: 20 readable-looking across the scopes.

### The tooling (`d517/patch517-tools.cjs`, `patch517-lands.cjs`, `patch517-gen.cjs`, `patch517-gen2.cjs`, `patch517-refuse.cjs`)

- **THE SCOPED QUOTED GRANT ROW.** `SCOPE_LINE` already split `<scope> <body>`; a body `have "<quoted>"` is read by
  `readQuotedGrant` (D454's reading, factored: a mana ability the engine's reader takes, a trigger the walk reads as the
  host's own line, or an activated ability whose cost is mana and/or {T} and whose effect the vocabulary reads) and
  returns the anthem static with `grantQuoted`, `who: 'scope'` and the scope fixture's printed base (`hostBase`). The
  emitter's `grantModify` already wrote the three carriers onto the derived object for any static with a grant; the
  anthem-grant static's `modify` now names `self` (the provider) for a trigger or an activated grant.
- **THE HOST IS THE SCOPE'S FIXTURE.** Every place the attached grant said `bearsB` - the granted trigger's fire and
  asserts (`hostSubject`), the granted activation's offer (`legalActions … x.card === yes && x.grantRef`), the tap
  assert, the mana grant proof (`manaGrantAssert`, now shared with the attached shape) - reads `hostVar(a)`: `yes` for a
  scoped grant. The vocabulary's `~` under a granted row is the host with the host's base (`SELF`, `SELF_BASE`), and a
  scoped granted ACTIVATION's whole fire is rewritten onto the host too (Zombie Master's regenerate proof aimed its
  Murder at the row's card).
- **THE COMMANDER SCOPE** (`Commander creatures you own` - the Backgrounds): `(ctx.state.players[ctx.query.controllerOf(self)
  ?? '']?.commanderIds ?? []).includes(candidate)` - ownership, never the candidate's controller (CR 903.3); the suite
  names the Bears as p1's commander (`commanders: [['Grizzly Bears']]`) and the arm moves it onto the battlefield from
  the command zone; the Cyclops on p2 is outside it.
- **THE LAND SCOPE** (`Lands you control`): the anthem static's type conjunct reads the scope (`typeOf` - a land, not a
  creature), the fixture is a Forest, and only a quoted grant rides it. Chromatic Lantern's and Joiner Adept's mana
  grants tap the Forest for its granted colour; Bootleggers' Stash's Treasure activation is offered on it.
- **A GRANTED ENTERS TRIGGER IS THE HOST'S.** The row's card stays on the battlefield granting (`hasEtb` and the arm's
  late-entry list skip a granted etb); the fire takes the host off the battlefield - to the command zone for a
  commander (no zone-change prompt), to the hand for any other fixture - and puts it back, so it enters under the grant
  (Candlekeep Sage, Dormant Sliver, Harmonic Sliver, Constricting Sliver, Lavabelly Sliver).

### The wave — eighteen rows

The select offered nothing; the whole-leftover row maker (19,051 line-only rows, `d517/rows517-all.log`) rowed 21 once a scoped line with a quoted body read as the anthem static with a granted ability - the three it always rows and 18 scoped quoted grants: eleven Slivers (Crypt, Poultice, Screeching, Harmonic, Dormant, Constricting, Lavabelly, Capricious, Zombie Master's Zombies among them), two Backgrounds on the new commander scope (Flaming Fist, Candlekeep Sage), the four Tabernacles on the all-creatures scope (The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale, Magus of the Tabernacle, Pendrell Mists, Vile Consumption) and the three land grants on the new land scope (Chromatic Lantern, Joiner Adept, Bootleggers' Stash); three rowed and were refused by name after their suites failed (Plague Sliver - the row's own card fires the granted step head too; Spiteful Sliver - the block recipe is the row card's; Magma Sliver - a counted payload counts the scope's members); the generator built the 18 - 18 suites, 59 tests, green after four generator fixes. Forty cards join the ledger with their reasons (the family's whole residue, read by name); seven entries retire (one re-reasoned, six landed - stale since D367).

### Traps

- **A GRANTED ENTERS TRIGGER IS NOT THE ROW'S ETB.** The etb machinery starts the row's card in the graveyard and moves it
  onto the battlefield as the etb test's fire; a GRANTED etb under a scope inherited that, so the row's card was never
  on the battlefield during the test and the host never re-entered - five suites walked the game out. A granted etb
  keeps the card on the battlefield and re-enters the HOST.
- **THE SCOPE'S OWN MEMBERS INCLUDE THE ROW'S CARD.** A Sliver granting every Sliver an upkeep trigger fires it twice
  (itself and the fixture); a Sliver granting a counted pump counts itself. The suite proves one host; the rows whose
  count or fire the card itself moves are refused by name until the suite counts the card.
- **THE GRANTED ACTIVATION'S PROOF WAS AIMED AT THE ROW'S CARD.** Only a granted TRIGGER's fire and asserts were
  rewritten onto the host; a granted activation's regenerate proof cast its Murder at `self` (the Zombie Master, not
  the Zombie). Every fire and assert of a scoped granted row is the host's.

## D518 — THE GRANTED OFFER'S COSTS: a quoted grant that sacrifices its host, sacrifices fodder or discards (2026-09-22)

**12,061 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,053
(+8: 8 rows - Mortarpod, Lunarch Mantle, Compulsory Rest, Clan Crafter, Chamber of Manipulation, Firewake Sliver, Street Urchin, Immobilizing Ink; the probe diff is the 8, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,895 → **7,903**. The REFUSED ledger 1,874 → **1,869** (+5: Cautery Sliver (a prevention body outside the vocabulary), Animal Boneyard (the sacrificed creature's toughness - a stat read of a cost's fodder), Sinking Feeling re-reasoned (a counter cost the host cannot pay the suite way), Mindlash Sliver re-reasoned (each player discards - a queue under a grant), Mindwhip Sliver re-reasoned (a random discard); -10: the seven landed rows' old entries and the three re-reasoned). Fixtures 8,941 →
**8,949**. `scriptableToday` 1,901 → **1,896**; the ladder `[1896, 1910, 3197, 4667, 5818]`. Bot reach **4,969** from **384**.
A tooling decision on Opus 5, no engine change: the engine has charged a granted activation's cost the way it charges
a printed one since D367 (`handlers.ts` takes the grant's ability past the ref and pays it the same way); the quoted
reader refused every cost piece past mana and {T} because the SUITE could not pay it on the host.

### The measurement chose it — the quoted-cost refusals, read back

D517's whole-leftover run refused 13 quoted grants for `a quoted cost the host cannot pay the suite way`: six that
sacrifice the host (`Sacrifice this permanent` / `this creature`), four that sacrifice fodder (`an artifact`, `a
creature`, `a permanent`, `another creature or an artifact`), two that discard, one that puts a -1/-1 counter. The
row's own activated abilities have paid all of these since D371 (the fodder put on p1, the discard in hand, the picks
named on the intent, the graveyard and board accounting, the self-in-graveyard assert); the granted vocab row simply
never carried the fields.

### The tooling (`d518/patch518-tools.cjs`)

- **THE READER ADMITS THE THREE PIECES.** Both quoted readers (D517's factored `readQuotedGrant` and D454's attached
  branch) refuse `tapper`, `discardRandom`, `removeCounter`, `putCounter`, `exileGy`, `exileSelf`, `untap`, `payLife`,
  `returner`, `xCount`, `discardsSelf` still, and let `sacrificesSelf`, `sacrificeFodder` (+ count) and `discard` (+ count)
  through; the granted vocab row (`geff`) carries them as the row's own activations do.
- **THE GRANTED OFFER TAKES PICKS.** The `ActivateAbility` the suite submits on the host with the grant's ref now names
  `sacrifice: fodderK.slice(0, n)` / `discard: discK` / the rest, exactly as the row's own intent does.
- **EVERY GRANTED ROW IS HOST-REWRITTEN.** D517 rewrote the fires and asserts of granted triggers and scoped
  activations; an ATTACHED activation kept `self` (its regenerate proof and its self-in-graveyard assert aimed at the
  Aura). Now every granted row's fire and asserts read the host, with the attach (the Aura cast onto the Bears, which
  names `self` as the Aura) prefixed by the fires map before the rewrite instead of inside `fireLines`.
- **AN ENCHANTED HOST SACRIFICED DROPS ITS AURA.** One more permanent gone from p1's board and one more card in p1's
  graveyard (`boardAdj`, `gy1Adj`) beside the host's own.
- **TWO FRAGMENTS OF ONE TEXT RESOLVE TO TWO PRINTED LINES.** Cautery Sliver prints two `All Slivers have "…"` lines; the
  leftover reports both as the same fragment and the row maker resolved both to the first printed line (a duplicate
  `GRANT_0`). A fragment now takes the first printed line not already taken (`fragTaken`).

### The wave — eight rows

The select offered nothing; the whole-leftover row maker (19,045 line-only rows, `d518/rows518-all.log`) rowed 11 once a quoted grant's self sacrifice, fodder sacrifice and discard were admitted - the three it always rows and the eight of the cost family: five attached grants (Mortarpod's and Compulsory Rest's host sacrificed, Lunarch Mantle's permanent fodder, Chamber of Manipulation's and Immobilizing Ink's discard) and three scoped ones (Firewake Sliver's host sacrificed, Clan Crafter's artifact fodder and Street Urchin's creature-or-artifact fodder on the commander scope); Cautery Sliver rowed once its two same-text fragments resolved to two printed lines and was refused on its second body (a prevention shield outside the vocabulary); the generator built the eight - 8 suites, 28 tests, green first time. Five cards join the ledger with their reasons (three re-reasoned); ten entries retire (seven landed, three re-reasoned).

### Traps

- **THE HOST PAYS WHAT THE ROW'S CARD PAYS.** A granted activation's cost is charged on the RECIPIENT (CR 113.7a): the
  suite's fodder, discards and self-sacrifice machinery is the host's once the row carries the fields - nothing new to
  stage, only the `self` to rewrite.
- **THE ATTACH NAMES THE AURA AS `self`.** A host rewrite over the whole fire of an attached activation would cast the
  Bears onto the Bears. The attach is prefixed outside the rewrite.
- **A REPEATED FRAGMENT IS TWO LINES.** Two printed lines with the same opening (`All Slivers have`) arrive as two
  identical fragments; the first-match resolution read one line twice and emitted one grant twice.

## D519 — ENERGY: a player counter the engine tracks and charges (2026-09-22)

**12,097 of 31,692 Commander-legal cards now execute completely, up from 12,061
(+36: 36 rows - Bristling Hydra, Sage of Shaila's Claim, Decoction Module, Minister of Inquiries, Scrapper Champion, Lathnu Hellion, Consulate Turret, Shipwreck Moray, Aether Chaser, Dynavolt Tower, Thriving Skyclaw, Rogue Refiner, Consul's Shieldguard, Thriving Rats, Thriving Rhino, Conduit Goblin, Thriving Turtle, Eddytrail Hawk, Tempest Harvester, Whirler Virtuoso, Gonti's Machinations, Smelted Chargebug, Shielded Aether Thief, Aether Theorist, Aether Swooper, Thriving Ibex, Inspired Inventor, Aether Poisoner, Longtusk Cub, Maximus, Knight Apparent, Spontaneous Artist, Thriving Grubs, Static Prison, Aether Inspector, Aether Herder, Solstice Zealot; the probe diff is the 36, nothing regressed).**
`SHIPPED_SCRIPTS` 7,903 → **7,939**. The REFUSED ledger 1,869 → **1,929** (+60: the energy family's rows the row maker still refused, by reason - 32 payloads outside the vocabulary (the pay-any-amount shapes: Aether Spike, Die Young, Territorial Aetherkite, Lightning Runner; `You get that many {E}`; `Scry 2, then you get {E}{E}`; the get-heads `Whenever you get one or more {E}` and `If you would get one or more {E}`), 13 spells with a line outside the vocabulary, 5 costs, 5 heads not in the library, 4 lines that are neither an activated ability nor a library trigger, 1 activated line the engine does not index; -0). Fixtures 8,949 →
**8,985**. `scriptableToday` 1,896 → **1,898**; the ladder `[1898, 1912, 3199, 4669, 5820]`. Bot reach **4,984** from **385**.
A NEW SUBSYSTEM on Fable 5.1 (the model rule: a resource the engine did not have), built the D168 way against the
biggest family the measurement had left: three proofs, the row maker, the wave.

### The measurement chose it — the family ranking after D518, read back

The mechanical tail is flat (every family the row maker could take was 3-8 cards); the biggest family left was
ENERGY - 119 leftover rows whose every unread line carried `{E}`: 42 lines of `When this creature enters, you get
{E}{E}`, ~17 `Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, ...`, ~11 `{M}, Pay {E}: ...` activations,
24 sole-line rows. The poison counter was the precedent for every piece: a player number with an event, a reducer case,
an invariant, a projection field, a plate chip and a wrench tool.

### The seam (`src/engine/types/state.ts`, `events.ts`, `reducer.ts`, `invariants.ts`, `project.ts`, `src/view/types.ts`, `src/ui/hud/PlayerPlate.tsx`, `src/engine/manual.ts`, `src/ui/game/ManualTools.tsx`, `src/data/effectParse.ts`, `src/data/activatedParse.ts`, `src/engine/effects.ts`, `handlers.ts`, `legal.ts`, `src/ui/game/PromptBar.tsx`, `src/bot/awaiting.ts`)

- **THE COUNTER** (`energy.test.ts`). `players[p].energy` (0 at setup), `EnergyChanged { player, delta, to }` (the
  PoisonChanged shape, the reducer applying the total), never negative (an invariant), projected as `SeatView.energy`,
  shown on the plate while any is held (⚡, the poison chip's reason), set by hand with `ManualSetEnergy` (floored at
  zero, the real delta on the event). D122's rule both ways: a resource the engine charges has to be READABLE where it
  is spent and adjustable by the wrench.
- **THE PAYLOAD.** `You get {E}{E}.` is `gainEnergy` (one counter per symbol printed), paid by the executor with a
  running ledger across the clauses of one resolution (`You get {E}{E}. You get {E}.` → 2 then 3) and said in the log.
- **THE PRICE, READ AS ENERGY.** `you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, ...` and `... unless you pay {E}{E}` carry `energy` on
  the `PaySpec` (REQUIRED, 0 elsewhere - D355/D356's rule) and on the `payMana` prompt (absent when none, so every
  older prompt is byte-identical); the prompt is raised only when the counters are held (D369: an unpayable price is not
  a question), the answer charges them, the bot pays only from energy it has. ⚠️ Until this decision `{E}{E}` fell
  through the mana parser as an EMPTY cost - a FREE price the vocabulary read whole; latent only because no landed script
  carried it (the vocabulary probe held 30 such payloads).
- **THE ACTIVATED COST.** `Pay {E}{E}` is a cost piece (`energyCost`) charged in `finishAbility`'s cost batch beside the
  tap; the activation is refused and the offer withheld short of the counters (`legal.ts`'s `affordable`, beside the
  mana and the life).
- **THE FUZZ.** `energyGained` / `energyPaid` counters; Sage of Shaila's Claim, Bristling Hydra and Aether Chaser three
  a seat (the enters gain, the activation the offer withholds, the attack prompt with an energy price); the floors ask
  for a gain and a payment at gate size (10 energy gains and 3 payments over the first 60 seeds, fuzz60-519 - the staples Sage of Shaila's Claim, Bristling Hydra and Aether Chaser three a seat).

### The tooling (`d519/patch519-tools.cjs`, `patch519-tools2.cjs`)

The row maker reads `Pay {E}{E}` as the activation's `energy`; the generators grant the energy every ability of the row
needs at the arm (a `ManualSetEnergy` on the payer's side BEFORE the baselines, so `energy0` holds it and every assert
reads the payment against it), read `energy0`, assert `gainEnergy` (`energy1`) and every energy paid (an activation's
cost through `energyAdj`, a prompt's price on p1). And THE REMINDER TEXT BLANKED MID-LINE: `When this creature enters,
you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).` reached the leftover as `... you get {E}{E}                      .` (the probe
blanks a parenthetical with spaces; the row maker's printed lines drop it), so the line resolved to none - 47 enters
lines, 3 enchantments, 3 artifacts, 2 Vehicles, 2 Equipment refused as "a leftover line not among the printed lines" -
and the harvested payload carried the spaces. The leftover's spaces collapse before the printed lines are asked again
(`fragTaken`'s sibling), and the three harvesters' `strip` collapses them too.

### The wave — thirty-six rows

The select offered nothing; the whole-leftover row maker (19,045 line-only rows, `d519/rows519-all.log`) rowed 4 with the energy seam alone - the three it always rows and Gonti's Machinations - and 39 once the reminder text blanked MID-LINE resolved (`you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).` reached the leftover as `you get {E}{E}          .`, so the printed line never matched and the harvested payload carried the spaces): the three it always rows and 36 of the energy family - 23 enters gains (Sage of Shaila's Claim, Bristling Hydra, Rogue Refiner, Longtusk Cub, Whirler Virtuoso, the Thriving cycle ...), the Pay {E} activations (Minister of Inquiries' mill, Dynavolt Tower's damage, Aether Hub's kin Decoction Module, Consulate Turret, Bristling Hydra's counter), the attack prompts with an energy price (Aether Chaser's Servo, Scrapper Champion's counter, Consul's Shieldguard, Eddytrail Hawk, Thriving Skyclaw), Gonti's Machinations' first-time head; the generator built the 36 - 36 suites, 126 tests, green first time. Sixty cards join the ledger with their reasons (the family's whole residue, read by name); nothing retires.

### Traps

- **A REMINDER TEXT MID-LINE HIDES THE LINE.** Every other reminder text sits at the END of its line, where `trim` hid
  the difference between the probe's blanking and the row maker's dropping; energy's sits before the period. The energy
  seam alone rowed ONE card; the line fix rowed thirty-six.
- **AN UNKNOWN SYMBOL IS AN EMPTY MANA COST.** `parseManaCost` warns on `{E}` and returns a zero cost; a price built
  from it is free. A symbol the engine does not charge must be refused by the reader that would price it, never handed
  to the mana parser.
- **A RESOURCE MUST BE SEEN AND SET.** The poison counter shipped enforced and invisible once (D68); energy shipped with
  its plate chip and its wrench tool in the same decision.
